abstract: The invention discloses a crotch structure of a humanoid robot. The crotch structure comprises waist-crotch connecting plates, large gears, servo rotary arms, thigh outer skeletons and first motors, output shafts of the first motors are connected to speed reducers, output shafts of the speed reducers penetrate through the waist-crotch connecting plates which are horizontally arranged to be connected to pinions and drives the pinions to rotate, the pinions mesh with the large gears, the large gears rotate to drive the thigh outer skeletons to rotate together with turbine frames, worm wheel frames are fixedly arranged at the lower ends of the large gears, rotating shafts are arranged in the worm wheel frames and are connected to the worm wheel frames through second bearings, the lower ends of the worm wheel frames and the rotating shafts are distributed perpendicular to each other, worms are arranged in the lower ends of the worm wheel frames, the outer walls of the two ends of the wormsare sleeved with first bearings and are connected to the worm wheel frames in a rotating mode, worm wheels are arranged on the rear sides of the worm wheel frames and sleeve the outer sides of the rotating shafts, and the bottom ends of the worm wheels mesh with the worms. The crotch structure of the humanoid robot have the advantages of being reasonable in structure, high in simulation performance, multiple in running direction and large in power.
title: Crotch structure of humanoid robot

abstract: According to the wrist system of the humanoid robot, the machining difficulty and the machining cost of parts are reduced, mounting and dismounting are easy and convenient, the impact resistance of a wrist is high, the axial back clearance is reduced, the movement precision and reliability are improved, a planetary roller screw rod is small in size and large in thrust, and therefore the size of the wrist is smaller, and the load capacity is large. The device comprises a forearm sleeve (1), a wrist base (2), a base end fixing shaft, a force sensor (4), a planetary roller lead screw (5), a planetary roller lead screw (6), a supporting shaft, an output end fixing shaft and a rotating base (8).
title: Wrist system of humanoid robot

abstract: The invention provides a safety protection method and device for a robot and the robot, and relates to the technical field of robots and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps that operation data of motors in the robot are obtained; and overload detection is carried out on the motors, if the motors are detected to be overloaded, overload categories of the motors are obtained according to the operation data of the motors and pre-trained overload classification models of the motors, and corresponding overload safety processing strategies are executed according to the overload categories. The technical scheme can be applied to consumer robots such as household robots used for accompanying and educating children or accompanying the old and robots such as industrial robots, commercial robots and specialized robots, and the safety protection method can improve the anthropomorphic performance capability of the applied robots.
title: Safety protection method and device for robot and robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A real-time humanoid control system and a control method thereof are provided to easily and freely control a humanoid using an upper body exoskeleton robot. CONSTITUTION: A real-time humanoid control system comprises an upper body exoskeleton robot(10) and a humanoid device(20). The upper body exoskeleton robot measures information about the rotational angle of each joint of an upper body through multiple sensors(11,12) and estimates the movement of the joints of the upper body using the measured information. The upper body exoskeleton robot transmits a lower body control signal matching the estimated movement to the humanoid device. The humanoid device powers the joints of the lower body depending on the transmitted lower body control signal.
title: Real Time Humanoid Control System and Method Thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to a robot joint module and a robot, the robot joint module comprises a first mounting seat, a first motor, a fixed rod, a second mounting seat, a rotating part and a connecting rod, the first motor is fixedly mounted on the first mounting seat, and the first motor is provided with a first output shaft; the fixed part of the fixed rod is fixedly connected to the first mounting seat; the second mounting seat is rotatably mounted on the connecting part of the fixed rod around a rotating axis parallel to the first output shaft; the rotating piece is fixedly sleeved on the first output shaft; the first end of the connecting rod is hinged to the rotating part around a first axis, the second end of the connecting rod is hinged to the second mounting seat around a second axis, and the first axis and the second axis are parallel to the first output shaft; the connecting rod is not overlapped with the rotating piece, the first output shaft and the fixed rod in the axis direction of the first output shaft. According to the technical scheme, the technical problem that the swing angle range of a joint module needing to swing on the humanoid robot is limited due to mutual interference of rod pieces can be solved.
title: Robot joint module and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a local boar remote semen collection training method based on simulation human interaction, and particularly relates to the technical field of artificial auxiliary breeding, the method comprises the following steps: obtaining environment parameters, calculating a situation interaction adaptation index, and when the situation interaction adaptation index accords with a preset condition, carrying out remote semen collection on a local boar; executing a humanoid behavior path, collecting boar response data to construct behavior cognition connection indexes, inputting the two indexes into a training model to output a cognition transition prediction score, if the score is lower than a threshold value, reconstructing the behavior path and performing re-evaluation, and if the score is continuously higher than the threshold value for m times and the fluctuation of the connection indexes is smaller than a set range, triggering a real person intervention process; according to the method, quantitative evaluation of pig house environment adaptability, dynamic perception of target boar behavior response and training decision closed-loop control based on double indexes and a machine learning model are achieved, it is ensured that semen collection training is efficiently promoted under the conditions of high environment adaptability, sufficient individual response and stable cognitive trust, and the semen collection efficiency is improved. The training success rate and the intelligence level are improved.
title: Local boar remote semen collection training method based on simulation human interaction

abstract: The present invention provides a humanoid robot hand that is improved so that the motion of flexing and extending the finger joints of the robot hand resembles the motion of actual muscles. The robot hand of the present invention comprises a palm plate (1) on which a thumb (2), an index finger (3), a middle finger (4), a ring finger (5), and a little finger (6) are arranged at predetermined positions. The thumb (2), index finger (3), middle finger (4), ring finger (5), and little finger (6) are each formed by a finger assembly (7). Furthermore, the long joint frame (8), the middle joint frame (9), and the short joint frame (10) of the finger assembly (7) are axially connected by first to third central two-row pulleys (12), (14), and (16), which are axially supported by first to third pivot axes (13), (15), and (17).
title: Humanoid robot hand

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot which comprises a sliding plate and a humanoid robot body; the humanoid robot body comprises two leg parts which can swing in a crossed manner, and two foot parts which are arranged on the bottoms of the two leg parts which can swing in the crossed manner; the two foot parts are detachably arranged on the sliding plate; a drive control system is arranged in the sliding plate; a control system for controlling motion of the humanoid robot is arranged inside the humanoid robot body; the control system is connected to the drive control system in a wired manner or a wireless manner for sending a control instruction of controlling the motion of the sliding plate to the drive control system; and the drive control system is used for receiving the control instruction and driving the motion of the sliding plate according to the control instruction. The humanoid robot solves the problem that a double-foot travelling type robot, a crawler type robot, a roller type robot and a robot with a double-foot travelling type structure have respective defects for different terrains in the prior art, and can be adaptive to the different terrains to select proper motion modes.
title: Humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a three-freedom-degree series-connection low-frequency mechanical humanoid robot foot, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots.The foot comprises a mechanical shank, a tarsal bone, a metatarsal bone, toes, a metatarsal skeleton, an arch-shaped foot sole, an instep plate, an ankle shaft, a tarsal shaft and a toe shaft; the two ends of the tarsal bone are each provided with a notch and connected with the metatarsal bone and the mechanical shank through the tarsal shaft and the ankle shaft respectively; a thin plate with a certain radian is adopted as the arch-shaped foot sole, the arch-shaped foot sole is installed at the bottom of the metatarsal skeleton, and the instep plate is installed on the top of the metatarsal skeleton; the metatarsal bone is installed on the metatarsal skeleton and connected with the toes in a hinged mode through the toe shaft; the ankle shaft, the tarsal shaft and the toe shaft are installed in parallel.The humanoid robot foot is reasonable in structure, has three freedom degrees and the low-frequency characteristic and is in a series mode.
title: Three-freedom-degree series low-frequency mechanical humanoid robot foot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a control method and device of a humanoid robot, the robot and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that after the whole body state of the humanoid robot is updated, the target position of an operation object in whole body reachability space information of the humanoid robot is acquired; determining a target motion mode according to the target position and the reachability subspace information of each movable part; according to the target motion mode, the target movable part is controlled to execute the target operation, efficient decision making is conducted on the motion modes of the humanoid robot, the ability of the humanoid robot to flexibly switch the motion modes in the factory environment is improved, and the control accuracy of the humanoid robot is improved.
title: Humanoid robot control method and device, robot and medium

abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet. The anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet comprises a trunk skeleton, a waist, a right leg and a left leg; the waist is connected with the trunk skeleton through a waist rotating platform; the left side and the right side of the waist are connected with the left leg and the right legthrough double-degree-of-freedom hip joints; the lower part of the trunk skeleton is fixedly connected with the waist rotating platform of the waist; a waist rotating mechanism drives the waist rotating platform to rotate so as to drive the trunk skeleton to rotate around a Z axis and realize Z-axis rotation freedom degree of the waist; an X-axis driving motor of the hip joint drives a hip jointball through a hip joint straight gear group to rotate around the X axis to realize the X-axis rotation freedom degree of the hip joint; a Y-axis driving motor realizes vertical reversing from X-axisrotation to Y-axis rotation through a bevel gear pair; and a planetary wheel speed-reducing mechanism drives a tail end connecting flange to rotate around the Y axis to realize Y-axis rotation freedomdegree of the hip joint. The 13 degrees of freedom enable the upright walking posture of the robot to imitate the action of human beings.
title: Anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid five-finger dexterous hand based on space connecting rods and planetary gear trains, which comprises a palm, a thumb and four fingers, four groups of space connecting rod mechanisms are arranged on the palm and are correspondingly in driving connection with the four fingers, and the freedom degree of bending and side swaying of the fingers is realized; a transversely-arranged miniature electric cylinder is installed at the bottom of the palm, and the miniature electric cylinder drives the thumb to achieve the freedom degree of palm swing through a gear and rack assembly. According to the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand, a space connecting rod mechanism and a planetary gear train mechanism are introduced, and the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand has the advantages of being high in degree of freedom, small in size, reasonable in structural design, high in coupling precision and stable in coupling force.
title: Human-simulated five-finger dexterous hand based on space connecting rod and planetary gear train

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm motion planning method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps that according to a kinematic model of a left arm and a right arm of the humanoid robot, forward kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly, and on the basis of the forward kinematic equations, inverse kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; according to the inverse kinematic equations, the quadratic programming problem expressions of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; and then quadratic programming indexes of the left arm and the right arm are combined with a constraint to obtain a standard quadratic programming problem expression of the humanoid robot; three motion planning judgment methods of the humanoid robot are set according to the standard quadratic programming problem expression; and thethree motion planning judgment methods are combined to resolve the standard quadratic programming problem expression, and the optimal solution is output. According to the method, the left arm and theright arm of the humanoid robot which can be controlled is well completed; and the double-arm motion planning method of the humanoid robot has the characteristics of being clear in mind, strong in logicality, simple and clear, effective, and the like.
title: Double-arm motion planning method of humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses an extensible robot humanoid precise grabbing skill learning method and system, and relates to the crossing field of artificial intelligence and robotology, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the grabbing motion track of a robot imitation demonstrator; a robot grabbing skill model is established according to the grabbing motion trail of the simulation demonstrator; learning and optimizing parameters of the robot grabbing skill model to obtain a grabbing reference track guided by experience knowledge of the demonstrator; the grabbing reference track is converted into a linear dynamic system, and parameter optimization is conducted on the linear dynamic system so that global convergence of the robot grabbing skill can be achieved; and reconstructing the robot grabbing skill model by using the intermediate point so as to realize rapid expansion of the robot grabbing skill. According to the method, the problems of poor expansibility and low accuracy in a robot grabbing path planning process in an unstructured environment can be solved.
title: Extensible robot humanoid precise grabbing skill learning method and system

abstract: The invention provides a mechanical thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. Wherein the mechanical thumb comprises a hinge seat, a first knuckle and a second knuckle, and the hinge seat is used for being rotationally connected with a palm structure of the dexterous hand around a first axis; the first knuckle comprises a knuckle shell and a first driving assembly arranged in the knuckle shell, and the knuckle shell and the hinge seat are rotationally connected around a second axis; the second knuckle is rotationally connected with the knuckle shell around a third axis; the first driving assembly is used for driving the knuckle shell to rotate around a second axis and driving the second knuckle to rotate around a third axis; the second axis and the third axis are both spatially intersected with the first axis, so that the mechanical thumb realizes three-degree-of-freedom movement, a more complex and natural action track can be generated, the action of a real thumb is simulated, and the action simulation degree is improved; the knuckle shell integrates the transmission function and the appearance shell, the first driving assembly is arranged in the inner space of the shell, the protection effect is achieved, and the appearance simulation degree of the mechanical thumb is improved.
title: Mechanical thumb, dexterous hand and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention provides a hip and waist joint structure and a humanoid robot. The hip and waist joint structure comprises a waist support, a waist driving assembly arranged in the middle of the waist support and two hip driving assemblies arranged on the two sides of the waist support correspondingly; the hip driving assembly comprises a hip side module, a hip side transmission assembly, a hip rotation module and a hip front module which are fixedly connected to the waist support, the hip side transmission assembly is used for connecting the rotation movement end of the hip side module and the hip rotation module, and the rotation movement end of the hip rotation module is connected with the hip front module. According to the hip and waist joint structure and the humanoid robot, part of modules of the hip driving assembly are located at the waist joint, and the overall mass center of the hip driving assembly is increased. According to the leg structure, the hip side module is located at the transmission front end of the hip joint through the hip side transmission assembly, the hip rotation module only needs to drive the hip front module to rotate, the rotational inertia is small, the hip side module and the hip rotation module can be located at the waist joint, and the overall mass of the leg structure is reduced.
title: Hip and waist joint structure and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a seven-axis humanoid mechanical arm, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The mechanical arm comprises seven joint modules, four connecting pieces, a load support and two connecting rods. The output end of the first joint module and the second connecting piece, the output end of the second joint module and the third connecting piece, the output end of the third joint module and the first connecting rod, and the output end of the fourth joint module and the fourth connecting piece are connected through jaw profiles. The first joint module, the second joint module and the third joint module are arranged in a three-axis orthogonal mode, the fifth joint module, the sixth joint module and the seventh joint module are arranged in a three-axis orthogonal mode, the axis of the third joint module coincides with the axis of the fifth joint module, the axis of the fourth joint module is offset, and it is guaranteed that the rotating motion range of the fourth joint module is 0-170 degrees through the offset amount of the fourth joint module. The problems that an existing mechanical arm modular joint shell and connecting rod structure is not high in reuse degree, installation is tedious, a tail end joint is not tight and reachable, and the working space is small can be solved.
title: Seven-axis humanoid mechanical arm

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot object interaction method guided by a diffusion model based on key frames. Comprising the following steps: S1, generating interaction between a human body and an object based on a diffusion model of a key frame; s2, guiding the humanoid robot to interact with the object based on the contact instruction; and S3, interaction between the humanoid robot and the object based on the action generation guidance. According to the method, in an action generation stage, key frames of a robot and an object within a period of time are predicted according to a current state, a motion sequence is recovered by using interpolation, and then a universal robot and object interaction strategy is finely adjusted based on a generated and simulated closed-loop structure and a fixed diffusion model weight. The interaction strategy is rewarded due to accurate simulation of aligned movement and contact information and successful object control, the gap between the output of the diffusion model and the training data set of the simulation environment is made up, and the reward does not need to be designed for a specific task.
title: Method for interacting objects by humanoid robot guided by diffusion model based on key frame

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a joint module and a robot, and solves the problem that the torque of the joint module is still small under certain size limitation. The joint module comprises a motor shell, a center shaft, a first sun gear, a plurality of first planet gears, an inner gear ring, a first planet carrier, a rotor, a connecting sleeve and a stator. The rotor is arranged on the inner ring of the stator, the stator is fixedly connected with the motor shell, only a gap needs to be reserved between the rotor and the stator, and the radial size of the joint module is reduced. In addition, the rotor is arranged on the outer sides of the first sun gear and the first planet gear in a sleeving mode, the rotor and the first sun gear are connected through the connecting sleeve, and the axial size of the joint module is reduced. Namely, the radial size and the axial size of the joint module are reduced, and the torque capable of being borne by the joint module can be increased under the condition that the space of the joint position of the humanoid robot is limited.
title: Joint module and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a similarity measurement-based mechanical arm humanoid motion demonstration method. According to the method, the angle of an elbow joint of a bent human arm is obtained; the elbow joint of a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is defined through the similarity measurement of a human arm and the mechanical arm; the other joint angles of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm are calculated; and humanoid motion is achieved. With the method adopted, operation can be simplified; the humanoid motion of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm with the undetermined joint number and joint length is achieved; and a calling program is packaged into a function module, so that the method is suitable for most robot platforms, and therefore, the universality of the robots is improved.
title: Similarity measurement-based mechanical arm humanoid motion demonstration method

abstract: The invention provides a finger assembly and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The finger assembly comprises a support, a finger piece, a first driving assembly, a second driving assembly and a third driving assembly. The first driving assembly, the second driving assembly and the third driving assembly are arranged on the support and connected with the finger piece and can drive the finger piece to move in three degrees of freedom. The first driving piece, the second driving piece and the third driving piece are located outside the finger piece, so that the space in the finger piece is not occupied, the structure of the finger piece is more compact, and the finger piece moves more flexibly. When the first driving piece, the second driving piece and the third driving piece break down and need to be detached and maintained, the first driving piece, the second driving piece and the third driving piece can be conveniently detached from the support, the finger piece does not need to be detached, and the detaching and maintaining difficulty of the finger assembly is reduced.
title: Finger assembly and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of manipulators, and discloses a high-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand based on shape memory alloy direct drive, which comprises a palm seat and a plurality of fingers arranged on the palm seat side by side, and each finger comprises a plurality of semiconductor refrigeration modules, a plurality of SMA wires, a plurality of bias reset springs and a plurality of knuckles hinged to each other, each knuckle is driven by the corresponding semiconductor refrigeration module and the two corresponding SMA wires to swing, and rapid reset is achieved under the action of the offset reset spring. The dexterous hand has the advantages of being high in degree of freedom, good in flexibility, rapid in response and light in weight, and fine and flexible grabbing actions can be achieved.
title: High-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand based on shape memory alloy direct drive

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a multi-rotational-degree-of-freedom ankle joint thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a cross shaft, an ankle support. an ankle joint first transmission shaft and an ankle joint second transmission shaft, wherein the cross shaft comprises a first direction shaft and a second direction shaft which are perpendicular to each other, the first direction shaft is used for being rotatably mounted on a lower connecting part of a shank shaft, and the second direction shaft is a hollow shaft with a through hole; and the ankle support is provided with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is inserted into the through hole of the second direction shaft, so that the ankle support rotates around the second direction shaft. According to the ankle joint, two rotational degrees of freedom of the ankle joint or a foot can be realized, and a multi-direction swinging function at a simulated human ankle is realized by a relatively simple and innovatively designed structure.
title: Humanoid robot and multi-rotational-degree-of-freedom ankle joint thereof

abstract: The invention relates to an information processing method and device, head-mounted equipment and a medium, the information processing method is applied to the head-mounted equipment, the method comprises the steps that at least one frame of face image is acquired, the face image comprises an eyebrow image and an eye image, the eyebrow image is acquired by an eyebrow tracking camera, and the eye image is acquired by an eye tracking camera; determining expression information of the user based on the facial image and an expression detection network; and obtaining and displaying an anthropomorphic image, wherein the expression of the anthropomorphic image is related to the expression information. The head-mounted device is provided with the eyebrow tracking camera and the eye tracking camera, it is guaranteed that even if the position and distance between the head-mounted device and the face of the user are changed, the complete face image of the user can be obtained, the eye tracking robustness of the user is effectively improved, and the user experience is improved. The anthropomorphic image generated based on the expression information realizes the real simulation of the expression of the user, enhances the interestingness and vividness of display, and improves the use experience of the user.
title: Information processing method and device, head-mounted equipment and medium

abstract: A humanoid robot has mobility, has many freedom degrees, comprises two arms, a neck, a waist, two legs and the like, and can complete more complex tasks. If these joints need to be connected togetherand subjected to unified coordination control, higher requirements for reliability and real-time performance of a control system are put forward. The invention provides a robot joint servo control system comprising a central controller and a joint controller. The joint controller comprises a controller shell and a controller circuit board. The top face of the controller shell is fixed to a rectangular shell through screws. Installation parts are arranged at the positions of the four corners of the bottom face of the rectangular shell correspondingly. Aviation plugs are arranged on the two opposite side faces of the rectangular shell correspondingly. The controller circuit board is located in the rectangular shell. Special conditioning circuits are designed in lvdt displacement sensor connectors and force sensor connectors. Meanwhile, excitation signal circuits matched with the corresponding conditioning circuits are further arranged in the force sensor connectors.
title: Robot joint servo control system

abstract: The invention discloses a shank structure, a lower limb assembly, a robot, a biped robot and a humanoid robot, the shank structure comprises a shank provided with a first mounting cavity and a second mounting cavity penetrating in the thickness direction of the shank, a first mounting seat arranged on one side of the shank, and a second mounting seat arranged on the other side of the shank; the first mounting seat is provided with a third mounting cavity and a fourth mounting cavity; the second mounting seat is arranged on the other side of the shank, a fifth mounting cavity and a sixth mounting cavity are formed in the second mounting seat, the third mounting cavity and the fifth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the first mounting cavity, and the fourth mounting cavity and the sixth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the second mounting cavity. Therefore, the area, occupied by the first foot joint module and the second foot joint module, of the shank body can be reduced, the radial size of the shank can also be reduced, and the situation that large space of the shank in the radial direction is occupied can be avoided.
title: Shank structure, lower limb assembly, robot, biped robot and humanoid robot

abstract: A humanoid robot includes an upper region includes a head and neck assembly having a neck portion and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. Said head portion includes: a frontal shell having a rear edge, a rear shell having a frontal edge, and an electronics assembly. The electronics assembly includes various components and devices used in the operation of the humanoid robot.
title: HEAD AND NECK ASSEMBLY OF A HUMANOID ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of driver built-in type dexterous hand structures, in particular to a thumb mounting device and a driver built-in type dexterous hand. The thumb mounting device comprises a thumb mounting frame, a motor, a worm gear, a worm and a modular thumb, the thumb mounting frame comprises a connecting piece, a first mounting piece and a second mounting piece, the connecting piece is assembled on a palm mounting plate, and the first mounting piece and the second mounting piece are fixedly connected with the upper end and the lower end of the connecting piece respectively; the worm gear is fixedly connected with the second mounting piece, the worm is meshed with the worm gear, and the first mounting piece is fixedly connected with the modular thumb; the extension direction of the base joint of the modular thumb is parallel to the transverse direction of the palm mounting plate, and one end of the base joint of the modular thumb is fixedly connected with the first mounting piece. And the driving mechanism, the worm, the worm gear and the thumb mounting frame are arranged, so that the modularized thumb has the palmar freedom degree, the flexibility of the modularized thumb is improved, and the humanoid effect of the driver built-in dexterous hand is improved.
title: Thumb mounting device and driver built-in dexterous hand

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a foot structure which comprises two thighs mounted at the lower end of a robot body, shanks mounted at the lower ends of the thighs and soles mounted at the lower ends of the shanks, connecting ports are formed in the middles of the upper surfaces of the soles, and air suction ports are formed in the bottom surfaces of the connecting ports in a penetrating mode. The upper surface of the sole is fixedly connected with a connecting frame, the upper surface of the connecting frame is connected with a flow dividing assembly, the other end of the flow dividing assembly is connected with the side wall of the sole, and a reverse blowing opening penetrates through the side wall of the sole. The humanoid robot comprises a robot body and further comprises the leg structure. According to the leg structure and the humanoid robot, the standing stability can be improved in the walking stage and the static stage of the robot body; when the robot body walks, if leaves and other sundries with large area and light weight are carelessly adhered to and blocked at the air suction ports of the soles, the blocking objects can be blown away before the soles step on the ground, so that the blocking probability is reduced.
title: Foot structure and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand and a robot, and solves the problem that the dexterous hand cannot give consideration to both dexterous property and anthropomorphic property at the same time. The dexterous hand comprises a palm base plate, a metacarpal bone driving assembly, a metacarpal finger driving assembly, a first thumb knuckle, a second thumb knuckle, a first tendon rope, a first tendon rope driving assembly, a plurality of side swing assemblies, a plurality of first knuckles, a plurality of knuckle assemblies, a side swing driving assembly, a plurality of bending driving assemblies, a plurality of second tendon ropes and a plurality of second tendon rope driving assemblies. Under the condition that the dexterous hand is provided with five fingers consistent with a human hand, the dexterous hand can have at least 12 active degrees of freedom, belongs to dexterous hands with medium and high degrees of freedom, and is high in dexterous performance. The driving assemblies are arranged into three layers on the palm base plate, the space of the palm base plate is reasonably utilized, the size of the dexterous hand is reduced, the size of the dexterous hand is closer to the human hand, and the anthropomorphism of the dexterous hand is improved.
title: Dexterous hand and robot

abstract: According to the elbow structure of the humanoid robot, the control precision is improved, the impact resistance is high, the service life is long, the installation position error is greatly reduced, self-adaptive angle change can be conducted after stress is conducted, in this way, large deformation generated when an elbow is subjected to overturning moment can be avoided, disassembly and assembly are convenient, the machining precision is higher, the installation precision is better, and the practicability is high. And the installation is more convenient. The robot comprises a large arm assembly, an elbow joint assembly and a small arm assembly. The big arm assembly comprises a big arm adapter plate (11), a big arm sleeve (12), an elbow joint main shaft (14) and a driver (16) which are connected with one another; the elbow joint assembly comprises an elbow joint base (21), a main driving shaft (22) and an angular contact ball bearing (24); the small arm assembly comprises a small arm adapter sleeve (31) and a rotary joint (32).
title: Elbow structure of humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand, and relates to the field of humanoid robots, the fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand comprises variable-rigidity flexible fingers, a palm body, a palm cover, an electric control unit and a six-way combined fluid valve, and mounting holes in the variable-rigidity flexible fingers are correspondingly mounted in the upper end face and mounting groove holes of the palm body; the electric control unit and the six-way combined fluid valve are arranged in a cavity of the palm body side by side, and the palm cover is fixedly connected with the palm body. According to the fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand, the multi-section sub-control type design is adopted, a plurality of electric control fluid micro-valves are arranged in the flexible finger bodies, and independent control over the flexible finger joints is achieved; a rigidity adjusting layer is arranged, so that the object grasping stability of the flexible hand is further improved; an electromechanical integration mode is adopted, the palm body internally comprises an electric control unit and a six-way combined fluid valve, the constraint of redundant cables is reduced, and the working efficiency is further improved.
title: Fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot motion control method based on footprint planning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly constructing a strategy network which comprises an input layer, two serial circulation hidden layers, and a linear output layer; designing a reward function; then, based on a reward function, a mujoo simulation platform is used for training the constructed strategy network, the posture and the terrain of the robot are initialized, and different footstep sequences are preset for different terrains; updating the policy network by using a PPO algorithm; and carrying out motion control on the humanoid machine by utilizing the trained strategy network. Under the condition that a target footstep sequence is known, cross-terrain stable walking is realized through a strategy network and a sliding window observation mechanism, and closed-loop control from environmental understanding to action generation is realized; the designed reward function can effectively guide the robot to form stable and natural gait behaviors, and the trained strategy network can be directly migrated to an actual robot platform.
title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on footprint planning

abstract: The invention discloses a joint connection structure for a humanoid robot and belongs to the technical field of robots. The structure comprises a steering engine, a steering wheel and a support; the steering wheel is connected with a steering engine spline output shaft by the aid of a key and rotates synchronously with the steering engine spline output shaft; the support comprises a bottom plate, wing plates and lug plates; the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the steering wheel; the two wing plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to wide edges of the bottom plate in a diverged manner in directions opposite to the steering wheel; and ends, far away from the bottom plate, of the wing plates are fixedly connected with the lug plates. With the connection manner, defects of poor rigidity and easiness in abrasion with traditional connection manners are overcome, the force transmission stability of the steering engine is improved, the movement balance of the humanoid robot is improved, and the service life of the humanoid robot is prolonged.
title: Joint connection structure for humanoid robot

abstract: Controlling interactions between real robots in a real environment and virtual robots in a virtual environment, wherein the interactions depend on positions of the real robots in the real environment and positions of the virtual robots in the virtual environment. Real robots may be represented by avatars eg. humanoid character, group of figures. Robots may be toys for entertainment or part of an interactive video game eg. role-playing game. Real robot behaviour may be modified – eg. changing speed or motion direction – in response to interaction with virtual robot, eg. collisions in racing games, combat in fighting games. Real and virtual robot actions may mirror or compliment each other. Sensor data from either the real or virtual robot may be used to control actions of the other robot. Real robots may comprise a camera to map and navigate, eg. using simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM). Virtual objects and robots may be superimposed on displayed images of the real environment. Real or simulated robots may be user controlled. Real robots may be powered by an inductive charging loop or solar panels. Robots may communicate with each other. LED or LCD display elements may provide visual feedback on robot status.
title: Apparatus control system and method

abstract: An all-terrain mobile robot comprising a mobile robotic platform, having either wheels or tank-treaded-like legs capable of navigating over rough terrain, wherein the robotic platform utilizes dynamic balancing behavior; a hydraulic powered anthropomorphic torso and articulated arms, wherein the hydraulic system possesses a pressure sensor for enabling the anthropomorphic torso and articulated arms to lift a payload using acute and delicate movements that reduce the chance of causing structural harm to the payload.
title: Mobile extraction-assist robot

abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot palm structure which comprises a palm skeleton, a plurality of connecting rod mechanisms which are rotatably mounted on the palm skeleton and are used for simulating fingers and driving motors which are arranged on the palm skeleton and are in driving connection with the corresponding connecting rod mechanisms through ball amplitude connecting rods, wherein one of the five driving motors is arranged on the palm center side, and the four driving motors are arranged on the palm side and are tightly arranged up and down. For the humanoid robot palm structure disclosed by the invention, through reasonable layout of the driving motors of the fingers, a width, a length and the size in a height direction of the palm are reduced, so that the size of the palm better conforms to the size of a palm of a real person; and the driving motors drive the corresponding connecting rod mechanisms to act through the ball amplitude connecting rods, so that motor shafts of the driving motors and rotating shafts of the connecting rod mechanisms are not located on a same plane, the space problem of layout of the driving motors can be solved, and thus the size of the palm is effectively reduced.
title: Humanoid robot palm structure

abstract: In a joint mechanism having at least one joint member connected to a connectable member via a joint to be rotatable in a range between an extended position and a bent position, it is configured to have a movable cover constituting a part of a joint member cover that covers the joint member and the movable cover is moved into interior of remaining portion of the joint member cover as the joint member is rotated relative to the connectable member about the joint from the extended position to the bent position. The joint mechanism can be suitably used in fingers of a hand of a humanoid robot.
title: Joint mechanism and robot having the same

abstract: Belonging to the technical field of anthropomorphic robots, an underactuated modularized anthropomorphic robot hand device with crossed tendons is similar to a human hand, the structures of an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger are the same, each finger applies a motor to drive three joints to rotate, the palm applies a motor to drive the root of the thumb to sway sidewise and rotate, and the thumb applies a motor to drive two joints to rotate. The device has five independently controlled fingers, fifteen joint freedom degrees, six driving joints and nine underactuated joints; the underactuated joint of each finger applies a crossed tendon and gear transmission mechanism with the same or approximate structure, a socketed middle finger section and a spring part with a multi-joint decoupling function, so, not only is the cost reduced, but also maintenance is convenient; the motors and the transmission mechanisms are hidden into the hand, the structure is simple, the weight is light, control is easy, and the degree of integration is high; the appearance, size and motion of the whole device imitate a human hand, and the device can automatically grasp objects with different shapes and sizes.
title: Chiasma tendon rope under-driven modularized anthropomorphic robot hand device

abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining and assigning a task to a remotely located expert (36), and to a corresponding computer program, a device (10) and a system (18). According to the invention, by means of a task creation from a request, a suitable expert (36) is searched for and found in an automated manner, wherein the expert (36) processes the task creation from a remote location in a virtual environment. For example, the machines (40) of a plant are monitored by an AI system (42) and a task to be carried out on the machines is stored in a backlog system or a memory (44). A further AI system (46) identifies a suitable expert (36), who then performs an activity (e.g. maintenance or error correction) on the machines (40) in a virtual environment, for example by means of a sensor glove (24), a VR input device or a sensor suit (38). The expert (36) can also control a humanoid robot (32) in order to perform the activity.
title: ASSIGNING A TASK TO A REMOTELY LOCATED EXPERT

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a universal humanoid five-finger dexterous hand which comprises a palm part, a thumb unit, an index finger unit, a middle finger unit, a ring finger unit and a little finger unit. The palm part comprises a palm bracket, and a thumb tendon rope driving unit, an index finger tendon rope driving unit, a middle finger tendon rope driving unit, a ring finger tendon rope driving unit and a little finger tendon rope driving unit which are arranged on the palm bracket; the thumb unit, the index finger unit, the middle finger unit, the ring finger unit and the little finger unit are respectively connected with the palm bracket; the thumb tendon rope driving unit, the index finger tendon rope driving unit, the middle finger tendon rope driving unit, the ring finger tendon rope driving unit and the little finger tendon rope driving unit are connected with the thumb unit, the index finger unit, the middle finger unit, the ring finger unit and the little finger unit in a one-to-one correspondence mode. According to the invention, the humanoid dexterous property of the dexterous hand is ensured, the highly integrated design of the dexterous hand is realized, the universality of the dexterous hand is enhanced, and the design cost is reduced.
title: Universal humanoid five-finger dexterous hand

abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical arm comprises a small arm assembly, the small arm assembly comprises a small arm, a wrist framework, a first wrist joint driving piece and a second wrist joint driving piece, the small arm is provided with an elbow joint end and a wrist joint end, and the first wrist joint driving piece, the wrist framework, the second wrist joint driving piece and the wrist joint end are sequentially connected. The first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially arranged in the axial direction of the forearm, the first wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the hand assembly to rotate around a first reference axis, and the second wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the wrist skeleton to rotate around a second reference axis; the first reference axis, the second reference axis and the axis of the small arm are perpendicular to one another. According to the mechanical arm, the mode that the first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially connected in series is adopted to replace a traditional motor parallel connection and connecting rod transmission matching scheme, the structure of the small arm assembly is simplified, and the weight of the mechanical arm is reduced.
title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control. The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control method and system, a medium, a product and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: taking a forward observation point of a humanoid robot as a centroid projection expected pose, obtaining the slope of the forward observation point according to the difference value between the centroid projection expected pose and the centroid projection actual pose, and calculating the motion of the humanoid robot. The forward linear speed of the humanoid robot is obtained according to the slope of the forward observation point, and the humanoid robot is controlled according to the forward linear speed to reach the position of the forward observation point; according to the method, an off-line track library does not need to be established, online control is achieved, the calculated amount is small, the requirement for calculation power is low, the influence of modeling errors of a motion model on robot control is reduced, the pose of the robot can be controlled more accurately, and the control precision and stability are improved.
title: Humanoid robot motion control method, system, medium, product and equipment

abstract: The invention provides a novel biped humanoid robot system based on pneumatic artificial muscles, belongs to the technical field of robots, and in particular relates to a biped robot having powerful athletic ability and flexible humanoid characteristics. The biped humanoid robot system comprises a mechanical body and an electrical control system; the biped humanoid robot system is characterized in that the mechanical body is mainly composed of seven parts, namely a waist, a hip joint, thighs, knee joints, shanks, feet and the like, and has 13 degrees of freedom in total; in the 13 degrees of freedom, 3 degrees of freedom of the waist are realized by virtue of the cooperation of four pneumatic muscles and the waist spine, and the single degree of freedom of each of the hip joint, the knee joints and the ankle joints is realized by use of one pneumatic muscle and one spring which are pulled to each other to produce opposed rotating force. According to the design of the novel biped humanoid robot system, a control platform is provided; the system relates to the fields of control science and intelligent control in addition to robotics, and is capable of meeting the requirements of scientific research and teaching of a plurality of disciplines.
title: Novel biped humanoid robot system based on pneumatic artificial muscles

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent data processing method and system for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the analysis and processing of various external sound data based on a data processing terminal, and determining a plurality of groups of sound instructions; and based on the data processing terminal, performing priority analysis on the multiple groups of sound instructions, and determining a priority sound instruction set. According to the method, sound data of the surrounding environment of the humanoid robot is collected through an auditory sensor, then semantic analysis, instruction priority analysis, instruction completion degree analysis, energy demand analysis and instruction recheck processing are performed on the sound data, and whether the humanoid robot executes a first execution sound instruction or not is determined; according to the mode, the problem that the humanoid robot cannot perfectly complete the instruction can be avoided, the problem that the instruction cannot be completely completed due to insufficient energy can also be avoided, in addition, the instruction is rechecked, the problem of energy waste of the humanoid robot caused by mistaken instruction sending can also be avoided, and the cost is indirectly reduced.
title: Humanoid robot intelligent data processing method and system

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot situational social behavior expression method, which comprises the following steps of: sensing user behaviors by adopting multiple sensors, constructing a multi-layer interactive situation sensing structure, and establishing association between a human-computer interaction situation and the user behaviors; self-adaptive layered isolated word recognition and voice emotion recognition based on an optimized neural network are adopted, user voice features are fully utilized, a matching relation between user emotion and robot situational social action emotion is constructed, and an emotion-fused robot situational social behavior expression decision is provided. Therefore, the multi-modal social behavior expression of the humanoid robot, which can express emotions while implementing an interaction task, is realized. According to the method, the relationship between the user behavior and the interaction situation and the relationship between the interaction situation and the social behavior of the humanoid robot are constructed, the problem that in the prior art, the emotion interaction is less when the humanoid robot executes the social task is solved, and the environment situation and the user emotion are fully considered; and a multi-situation social expression realization path of the humanoid robot is provided.
title: Humanoid robot situational social behavior expression method

abstract: The present invention relates to a humanoid robot performing boxing. The humanoid robot according to the present invention is optimized in a boxing game by increasing destructive power when performing a punch and relieving impact when being punched. The present invention includes an upper body in which a head unit is mounted on the upper end; a lower body connected to the lower part of the upper body to be able to rotate; an arm unit formed with a plurality of individually operated joints and mounted on both sides of the upper body; and a leg unit formed with the individually operated joints and mounted on the lower end of the lower body; and a control unit controlling rotation between the upper body and the lower body, operation of the joints in the arm unit, and the operation of the joints in the leg unit.
title: HUMANOID BOXING ROBOT

abstract: A robot may include a torque generator to generate a torque, and a leg system including one or more legs movably coupled to and supporting the torque generator. Each leg of the one or more legs may include a first leg member, a second leg member, a first joint movably coupling the first leg member and the second leg member, and a first linear elasticity element coupled between the first leg member and the second leg member across the first joint. The first linear elasticity element may be disposed to provide a first force when the first linear elasticity element is actuated that, in combination with the torque, facilitates maintaining an upright position of the bipedal robot.
title: Legged Robot with Joint-Augmented Stability Control

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot head which comprises a humanoid robot body, the humanoid robot comprises eyes, ears, a nose and mouth organs of the face, and the humanoid robot further comprises a face blinking transmission mechanism which comprises silica gel eyelids and a controller for driving the eyelids to move up and down; the eye driving mechanism comprises a rotating eyeball mechanism and a columnar shell, the columnar shell is connected with an eye hemisphere through an eye body, the inner side of the eyeball mechanism comprises a camera device, the columnar shell comprises a first control device and a second control device, eyeballs are controlled to rotate all around, and meanwhile the structure is compact, the control precision is high, friction is small, and the response speed is high. According to the humanoid robot head, through the corresponding design of the traction rope, the first control device, the second control device, the camera, the motor and the like, rotation of the eyes of the robot in the up-down direction, the left-right direction and the like can be achieved, good control can be achieved, the structure is compact, and practicability is high.
title: Humanoid robot head

abstract: The invention provides an integrated ankle joint drive mechanism for a humanoid robot. The integrated ankle joint drive mechanism comprises an ankle joint control unit, a shank assembly, ankle joint pitching/side-turning mechanism and detection units and a foot portion. The ankle joint control unit is connected with the ankle joint pitching/side-turning and detection units through the shank assembly. The foot portion is connected with the shank assembly and the ankle joint pitching/side-turning and detection units at the same time. The ankle joint control unit comprises a first hydraulic servovalve, a second hydraulic servo valve, a first end cover and a pressure sensor. The first hydraulic servo valve and the second hydraulic servo valve are mounted at the upper end of the first end cover. The pressure sensor is mounted at the lower end of the first end cover. The first end cover is connected with the shank assembly.
title: Integrated ankle joint drive mechanism for humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a thread connecting rod type two-degrees-of-freedom robot thumb root joint device belonging to the technical field of humanoid hands. The thread connecting rod type two-degrees-of-freedom robot thumb root joint device comprises a palm base, a thumb, a joint shaft, a thumb swinging mechanism and a thumb snapping mechanism, wherein the thumb swinging mechanism comprises a first speed reducer, a first bevel gear and a second bevel gear; and the thumb snapping mechanism comprises a second speed reducer, a third bevel gear, a fourth bevel gear, a screw rod, a nut, a sleeve, a lantern ring, a snapping connecting rod and a thumb connecting rod. Two motors, the screw rod, the nut, the sleeve, the lantern ring, a lambda-shaped connecting rod mechanism and the like are adopted in the thread connecting rod type two-degrees-of-freedom robot thumb root joint device, independent swinging and snapping two-degrees-of-freedom flexible actions of the thumb root are comprehensively realized, and swinging and snapping two-joint-degrees-of-freedom are vertically crossed. Meanwhile, the thread connecting rod type two-degrees-of-freedom robot thumb root joint device has the advantages of simple and compact structure, low cost, stability in transmission, short transmission chain, small transmission clearance and high transmission efficiency, is easy to control and is suitable for anthropomorphic robot hands. Flexibility and stability of grabbing objects by the root hand are enhanced, so that the robot hand can realize more gestures and is more anthropomorphic.
title: Thread connecting rod type two-degrees-of-freedom robot thumb root joint device

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot two-degree-of-freedom series high-frequency mechanical foot and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The humanoid robot two-degree-of-freedom series high-frequency mechanical foot comprises a metatarsus plate, an upper cover plate installed on the upper portion of the metatarsus plate, a foot soleplate installed on the lower portion of the metatarsus plate, a toe installed on the metatarsus plate through a toe joint hinge B, an ankle joint hinge B for connecting a shin with the metatarsus plate, a toe joint pinion, a toe joint big gear, an ankle joint big gear, an ankle joint pinion, a toe joint motor and an ankle joint motor. The toe joint big gear is in engagement transmission with the toe joint pinion and is installed on an output shaft of the toe joint motor and is installed on the metatarsus plate through a toe joint hinge A. The ankle joint big gear is in engagement transmission with the ankle joint pinion and is installed on an output shaft of the ankle joint motor and is installed on the metatarsus plate through an ankle joint hinge A. The humanoid robot foot is simple in structure and smooth and steady in operation and has two degree of freedom of high-frequency dynamic responses.
title: Humanoid robot two-degree-of-freedom series high-frequency mechanical foot

abstract: The invention provides a control method and device based on an emotion cumulative value, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of: determining a corresponding to-be-monitored event according to a current personality type of a robot, and monitoring whether the to-be-monitored event occurs or not, wherein the current personality type is from a to-be-selected personality type of the robot; and if monitoring that the to-be-monitored event occurs, according to the monitored to-be-monitored event and the current personality type, adjusting an emotion value of a corresponding emotion dimension in a plurality of emotion dimensions of the robot. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the influence of past events on emotions is fully reflected, so that the change of the emotions better fits the real emotions of human beings; and meanwhile, when the to-be-monitored event is determined and an emotion value is adjusted, the personality type of the robot is fully considered, so that the difference between events concerned by different people and the personalized difference between emotion change modes are reflected, and the authenticity of simulating the real human beings by the robot is effectively improved. Therefore, the robot can be more intelligent and humanoid.
title: Control method and device based on emotion cumulative value, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a hip connecting assembly of a humanoid robot, the humanoid robot and a robot. The hip connecting assembly comprises a swing leg connecting piece and a butt joint piece, the swing leg connecting piece comprises a first side wall and a joint mounting seat, the joint mounting seat comprises a rotating leg joint flange, the rotating leg joint flange is used for assembling a rotating leg joint, and a first assembling seat is arranged on the outer side face of the first side wall; the butt joint piece comprises a flange part and an assembling part. The flange part is used for being detachably assembled to an output flange of the swing leg joint. The assembling part is detachably assembled to the first assembling base. The leg swinging joint is convenient to disassemble.
title: Hip connecting assembly of humanoid robot, humanoid robot and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a flexible part crank block type parallel coupling underactuated robot finger device, and belongs to the technical field of anthropomorphic robot hands. The device comprises a base, a near joint shaft, a first finger segment, a far joint shaft, a second finger segment, a connecting rod, a drive plate, a motor, a flexible part and a spring. The device can achieve the transmission effect combining coupling rotation and underactuated rotation, can realize anthropomorphic grasp through coupling, and also has the underactuated adaptive function. The whole finger has the advantages of concise structure, low manufacturing and processing cost, natural decoupling by utilizing block moving contact mode, no need of power consumption of the motor and high energy utilization rate. A crank block mechanism of the second finger segment can realize large-angle rotation of the second finger segment by moving very short distance of an active block. The device is similar to a human finger in appearance, can be used as one finger or a part of the finger of a robot hand, also can be combined with a plurality of the fingers into the robot hand so as to achieve the good effect of high degree of freedom of joints and high adaptivity of the anthropomorphic robot hand.
title: Flexible part crank block type parallel coupling underactuated robot finger device

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot non-grabbing type mobile pushing task control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: building a system interaction force model based on the pose information of the interaction among a humanoid robot, a target object and an environment, and then building the dynamics models of the humanoid robot and the target object; establishing a system speed constraint model and a system force constraint model based on speed and force constraint conditions satisfied by pairwise interaction among the humanoid robot, the target object and the environment; robot joint angular acceleration constraint conditions are obtained according to the established system speed constraint model, the established system force constraint model and the dynamical models of the humanoid robot and the target object; and obtaining a system motion boundary condition based on the established robot joint angular acceleration constraint condition, and executing a non-grabbing type mobile operation task according to the condition that the motion trail of the humanoid robot meets the system motion boundary condition.
title: Humanoid robot non-grabbing type mobile pushing task control method and system

abstract: According to the present invention, a humanoid robot is formed between a lower limb and an upper limb to minimize an impact and vibration, and comprises a series elastic actuator formed to manually and actively control the upper limb and the lower limb. The upper limb and the lower limb can be actively controlled by using a rotational force of a drive motor. The upper limb and the lower limb can be manually controlled in accordance with a force applied between the upper limb and the lower limb by means of an independent spring arranged inside a housing.
title: HUMANOID ROBOT HAVING COMPACT SERIES ELASTIC ACTUATOR

abstract: The invention provides a cross-joint transmission mechanism and a mechanical finger, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the cross-joint transmission mechanism is used for driving a fingertip joint to bend or stretch, the cross-joint transmission mechanism comprises a base joint rack and a near knuckle rack which are arranged in sequence, and the near knuckle rack is rotatably connected with the base joint rack; the first universal joint coupler is arranged between the base joint rack and the near knuckle rack; the first lead screw pair comprises a first lead screw and a first nut which are in threaded fit, the first nut is fixedly connected with the near knuckle rack, one end of the first lead screw is in sliding connection with the output end of the first universal joint coupler, and the other end of the first lead screw is in sliding connection with the output end of the second universal joint coupler. And the input end of the first universal joint coupling is in driving connection with the first rotating driving piece. According to the invention, the size of the fingertip joint can be reduced as much as possible, the adaptability of the fingertip joint to the humanoid robot is improved, and the influence of pitching or side swinging of the near knuckle on the angle of the fingertip joint is avoided.
title: Cross-joint transmission mechanism and mechanical finger

abstract: The invention concerns a head and an automated mechanized method with vision, the head comprising a pressure base which is provided with lateral, opening and closing apertures, encloses the machine tool and is associated with a vertical displacement device provided with a mechanical unit, vision equipment connected to data-processing equipment and a communications module. The invention has the principal advantage of providing an anthropomorphic robot, conceived originally for the automotive industry and having a relatively low degree of precision, with considerably greater mechanical precision, equivalent to far more precise equipment or to robots of the type having parallel kinematics, thus compensating in real time and continuously for decentring and loss of perpendicularity owing to the pressure of the pressure base, which are common in conventional heads and a source of errors and lack of precision.
title: HEAD AND AUTOMATED MECHANIZED METHOD WITH VISION

abstract: The invention relates to a tension integral type bionic shoulder joint system and a motion trail planning method thereof. The system comprises a bottom plate, a fixed platform, a movable platform, an active tension unit, a passive tension rope unit, a flexible tension spring unit, a plurality of groups of driving units and a control unit. The bionic shoulder joint component and the passive tension rope unit are integrally of a Y-shaped structure, the fixed platform and the control unit are fixed to the bottom plate, and the movable platform and the fixed platform are connected through the active tension unit, the passive tension rope unit and the flexible tension spring unit. The control unit controls the multiple sets of driving units to achieve abduction and adduction, anteflexion and posterior extension and extorsion and intorsion movement of the bionic shoulder joint by planning the movement track. Aiming at the defects that a traditional structure is large in mass, complex in structure, poor in flexibility and the like, the morphological structure of the shoulder joint and the tensegrity structure are organically fused, the bionic shoulder joint system with adaptability and flexibility is obtained through bionic mapping, and the bionic shoulder joint system is compact in structure, convenient to control and widely applied to humanoid robot joints.
title: Tensioning integral type bionic shoulder joint system and motion trail planning method thereof

abstract: A humanoid robot that uses lighter than air gas contained within at least one airtight bladder for stability and support is disclosed. In many embodiments, the humanoid robot includes a body and an airtight bladder associated with the body. The airtight bladder is filled with a sufficient amount of lighter than air gas to make the body buoyant in atmospheric air. In several embodiments, feet that are heavy enough to hold the body to the ground are attached to the body by legs. A variety of locomotion mechanism can be employed by humanoid robots that uses lighter than air gas contained within at least one airtight bladder can be utilized in accordance with different embodiments of the invention including mechanisms that propel the feet of the robot, and/or mechanisms that propel the body of the robot.
title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR IMPLEMENTING HUMANOID BALLOON ROBOTS

abstract: According to the lower limb structure and the humanoid robot, the lower limb structure comprises a yaw driving part, a pitching driving part, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, the pitching driving part is connected with the yaw driving part, the yaw driving part is used for driving the pitching driving part to rotate around a yaw shaft, and the thigh assembly comprises a thigh shell and a driving mechanism; the thigh shell comprises a first shell and a second shell, the first shell and the second shell are connected in the first direction, one end of the second shell is connected with the pitching driving piece, the pitching driving piece is used for driving the thigh assembly to rotate around the pitching axis, and the driving mechanism is installed in the end, close to the pitching driving piece, of the thigh shell. The connecting face of the first shell and the second shell is a plane, the yaw axis coincides with the connecting face, the pitch axis intersects and is perpendicular to the yaw axis, the shank assembly is rotationally connected with the end, away from the yaw driving piece, of the thigh shell and connected with the driving mechanism, and the static stability and the dynamic stability of the humanoid robot are improved.
title: Lower limb structure and humanoid robot

abstract: A machine (1) for the machining of railway wagons comprising: a holding structure (2) having a first upright (3) and a second upright (4) that extend along respective first direction (5) and second direction (6) substantially parallel and adapted to be arranged on the opposite side with respect to a wagon (7) to be machined; sliding means (10, 11) of the structure (2) along a main direction (9); machining means (14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19) of the wagon (7) comprising at least a first anthropomorphic robot (14) associated sliding with the first upright (3), and at least a second anthropomorphic robot (15) associated sliding with the second upright (4).
title: MACHINE FOR THE MACHINING OF RAILWAY WAGONS

abstract: A system, method, and device for generating Pepper's Ghost artifices from two-dimensional sources including Augmented Reality (“AR”) or Virtual Reality (“VR”) environments such that the Pepper's Ghost artifices appear to be a natural addition to a three-dimensional virtual environment. By employing virtual Pepper's Ghost projections onto varying size and shaped screens in the virtual three-dimensional environment, a reduction in bandwidth and costs are realized particularly when displaying humanoid characters in an AR and/or VR environment. While the methods disclosed with the present invention could be of utility to any type of virtual environment, the benefits are particularly acute for dynamic VR environments.
title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR GENERATING A PEPPER'S GHOST ARTIFICE IN A VIRTUAL THREE-DIMENSIONAL ENVIRONMENT

abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom linear drive humanoid robot ankle joint system, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot precision joint driving. The system comprises three torque output units fixed to a shank frame in a concentrated mode, four sets of independent transmission cables, an actively-driven toe joint structure and a dynamic tensioning structure. Through deployment of an overhead driving unit, design of a precision line transmission path and integration of a toe driving framework, three-degree-of-freedom cooperative movement of ankle introversion/extroversion, heel dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and toe dorsiflexion/plantar flexion is realized; according to the invention, the defects of lack of active toe joints, heavy structure and large tail end inertia in the prior art are overcome, the active toe joint has the characteristics of compact structure, light weight and low inertia, the dynamic response performance, the energy efficiency and the terrain adaptability of the robot can be obviously improved, and the active toe joint is suitable for high-dynamic motion scenes.
title: Ankle joint system of three-degree-of-freedom line-driven humanoid robot

abstract: The invention relates to an indoor explanation system based on a humanoid robot and a method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot. The method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot comprises the steps that the robot calibrates a corresponding explanation position point through an explanation route of the robot, and after the robot arrives at the explanation position, corresponding infrared sensing module sends out request in a request receiving mode when the robot moves to the position of a corresponding infrared sensing module; and after the robotreceives the request of the corresponding infrared sensing module, the robot starts to adjust the position of the robot and then carries out corresponding scene explanation. Compared with the prior art, the method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot has the advantages that the working pressure of an explainer is reduced, it is guaranteed that the explaining is clear and accurate, the movement position of the robot is mastered in all directions, and the movement position of the robot is more accurate during explaining.
title: Indoor explanation system based on humanoid robot and method of indoor explanation system based on humanoid robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot facial expression control mechanism and a robot comprising same. The robot facial expression control mechanism comprises a humanoid skull shell, a humanoid silicone skin, a lip motion control mechanism and at least one eyebrow motion control mechanism; each eyebrow motion control mechanism comprises a first mounting substrate, a first power output component and a first transmission component; each first power output assembly drives the corresponding first transmission component to move; the first transmission components penetrate through eyebrow track grooves andare connected with eyebrow portions of the humanoid silicone skin; the lip motion control mechanism comprises a second mounting substrate, a second power output component and a second transmission component; the second power output component drives the second transmission component to move; and the second transmission component penetrates through a lip track groove and is connected with the lip portion of the humanoid silicone skin. By applying the technical scheme, the problem that in the prior art, robot expression control mechanisms are bulky, and other functions of robots are limited canbe solved.
title: Robot facial expression control mechanism and robot comprising same

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid piano playing robot which can comprise paws, arms, a waist, a neck, legs, a control system and a base, the neck corresponds to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch, the waist corresponds to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch, and the legs correspond to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch. According to the humanoid piano playing robot, the positions of the keys can be accurately positioned through the visual perception unit, the content of a music score can be intelligently recognized, and piano playing can be automatically carried out according to the music score.
