Through the two degrees of freedom of the waist and the head and control over the poses of the two mechanical arms, the piano playing robot in the specification can play a piano skillfully and intelligently.
title: Humanoid piano playing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom parallel shock resisting mechanical foot of a humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The mechanical foot comprises a metatarsal frame, a foot back plate, a foot bottom plate, parallel toes, a rubber column A, a rubber column B, a tensile spring A, a tensile spring B, a locking spring A and a locking spring B; the rubber column A and the rubber column B are mounted between the metatarsal frame and the foot back plate; two ends of the tension spring A and the tensile spring B are respectively mounted on the metatarsal frame and the foot back plate; the rubber column A and the rubber column B are mounted between the tensile spring A and the tensile spring B; the foot bottom plate is an elastic sheet with an upwards projected middle part, and two ends thereof are respectively connected with the metatarsal frame through the locking spring A and the locking spring B; the parallel toes are mounted on the metatarsal frame through toe shafts; the metatarsal frame is provided with a mechanical calf through an ankle shaft; and the metatarsal frame includes a metatarsal rod A and a metatarsal rod B mounted in parallel. The humanoid mechanical foot is simple in structure, and has two degrees of freedom, shock resistance and a parallel mode.
title: Two-degree-of-freedom parallel shock resisting mechanical foot of humanoid robot

abstract: An autonomous humanoid robot configured to overcome limited maneuvering issues by offering a more efficient autonomous humanoid robot that autonomously operates to interact with users and interact with other robots, and includes a computing system configured to provide instruction and programming for estimating and controlling pivotal movement of body components involving arms, legs and a waist module which are configured to support the body and reposition the body such that the autonomous humanoid robot can step, walk, roll or skate or perform various handling maneuvers to complete tasks.
title: AUTONOMOUS HUMANOID ROBOT

abstract: A humanoid hugging assembly includes a humanoid animatronic that has a torso, a pair of arms and a pair of hands each is disposed on a respective one of the arms. The arms are positionable in a resting position having the arms extending downwardly along the torso and having a palm of each of the hands facing the torso. Each of the arms is positionable in a hugging position has each of the arms is crossed in front of the torso wherein the pair of arms is configured to embrace the user. A motion sensor is integrated into the humanoid animatronic to sense motion of the user approaching the humanoid animatronic. A motion unit is integrated into the humanoid animatronic and the motion unit actuates each of the arms into the hugging position when a predetermined duration of time has passed when motion sensor senses motion.
title: Humanoid hugging assembly

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot obstacle avoidance method based on model prediction control. Scanning a road in front of the humanoid robot through a laser scanner arranged at the head of the humanoid robot, forming a coordinate point cloud according to a scanning result, and drawing a terrain map of the road in front of the humanoid robot; the height of the obstacle is calculated through a depth camera arranged on the humanoid robot part; and when the height of the obstacle is smaller than the leg length of the humanoid robot, the humanoid robot is controlled to walk to the front of the obstacle, and upside-down overturning obstacle crossing operation is executed. According to the method, a forward upside-down obstacle crossing mode is combined with a model-based prediction algorithm, so that the working efficiency and the stability are improved while a specific environment task can be completed, and the application prospect is wide.
title: Model predictive control-based humanoid robot obstacle avoidance method

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot type humanoid robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and is characterized in that a robot head is arranged on a robot main body and can be used for visual perception; the tool magazine is arranged on the robot main body and is used for storing operation tools and a hand driving wheel with a hub motor; the two mechanical legs are arranged on the robot body, and leg driving wheels with hub motors are arranged at the foot ends of the mechanical legs. The two mechanical arms are arranged on the robot body, and quick-change connectors are installed at the tail ends of the mechanical arms. In the two-wheel-foot state, the ends of the leg driving wheels on the two mechanical legs are supported on the ground; in the four-wheel-foot form, the circumferential faces of the leg driving wheels on the two mechanical legs are supported on the ground, the two mechanical arms are provided with the hand driving wheels through the quick-change connectors, and the wheel-foot type robot bends to enable the circumferential faces of the hand driving wheels at the tail ends of the mechanical arms to be also supported on the ground. According to the wheel-foot type humanoid robot, the moving and operating capabilities of the humanoid robot are enhanced.
title: Wheel foot type humanoid robot

abstract: The invention relates to a method and a related device for the actuation of a follower member (30) in a robotic apparatus, such as a humanoid robot, a gripping arm for industrial applications, and the like. The method envisages a clutch (20) interposed between an electric drive (10) and the follower member (30), which, in addition to allowing limiting the resistant torque (Tl) transmitted by the follower member (30) in case of sudden overloads, is also used for connecting and/or disconnecting the drive (10) and the follower member (30) to/from each other for controlled time intervals during the operation of the robotic apparatus. In this way it is possible to attain energy savings and exploit regenerative energy in order to recharge the batteries or supercapacitors associated with the apparatus.
title: CONTROLLED-CLUTCH ACTUATOR DEVICE AND METHOD, IN PARTICULAR FOR ROBOTIC APPLICATIONS

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a palm skeleton, a thumb driving mechanism and a joint mechanism, the palm skeleton comprises a guide rail fixing seat, a skeleton body, a four-finger structure, a thumb and a driving mounting groove; the thumb driving mechanism comprises a side swing driving assembly and a bending driving assembly. One end of the bending driving assembly is embedded into the driving mounting groove, the other end of the bending driving assembly is connected with the joint mechanism through the guide rail fixing seat, and the bending driving assembly is slidably connected with the guide rail fixing seat; and the side swing driving assembly is embedded into the driving mounting groove, is connected with the joint mechanism through the guide rail fixing seat, and is in sliding connection with the guide rail fixing seat. The joint mechanism is controlled through the side swing driving assembly and the bending driving assembly respectively, then the thumb is controlled to move through the joint mechanism, free movement can be conducted in two direction dimensions, and the flexibility of the thumb is greatly improved.
title: Humanoid dexterous hand and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a force feedback exoskeleton and a humanoid robot imitation learning method. The force feedback exoskeleton comprises a bearing part, an arm exoskeleton part and a data glove part. The number of the arm exoskeleton parts is two, the two arm exoskeleton parts are symmetrically connected to the backpack part, and the number of the data glove parts is two so as to collect position and posture information of the left hand and the right hand respectively. The humanoid robot imitation learning method is based on same double-arm characteristics and operator visual angle image input, is combined with nodal topology correlation organization of human joints, integrates multi-modal data information, and outputs control quantity which is almost the same as expert operation. The system is applied to the technical field of exoskeletons, high-quality data acquisition can be realized while the exoskeleton is lightweight and integrated, the number of degrees of freedom of data acquisition of traditional exoskeletons is greatly increased, and the system can be used for guiding collaborative movement of double mechanical arms and further effectively applied to flexible operation tasks of humanoid robots.
title: Force feedback exoskeleton and humanoid robot imitation learning method

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of mobile robots and artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to an intelligent service robot hand-eye cooperation system and an operation method. The system comprises a sensor module, algorithm modules and a grabbing module, and the sensor module is mainly composed of a depth camera and used for obtaining RGB data and three-dimensional point cloud dataof objects to be grabbed; the algorithm modules can process the RGB data and the three-dimensional point cloud data so as to obtain the shapes, the poses and the categories of the objects to be grabbed, and data such as the distance, the direction, the force and the angle needed by grabbing are provided for the grabbing module; and the grabbing module comprises a humanoid palm and a humanoid arm and is used for completing the grabbing action. According to the intelligent service robot hand-eye cooperation system and the operation method, through cooperation of the depth camera, the multiple algorithm modules and the grabbing module, the objects in various shapes and located at various positions can be accurately grabbed, and the objects are recognized.
title: Intelligent service robot hand-eye cooperation system and operation method

abstract: The invention relates to a virtual reality technology-based humanoid robot remote control system and method, the system comprises a VR device and a humanoid robot, and the VR device comprises a head-mounted device, a hand device, a visual information sampling unit, a hand device sampling unit and a visual information imaging unit; the humanoid robot comprises a robot system communication unit, a robot system planning control unit, a visual sensor and a joint motor execution unit. The technical problems that existing robot control mainly depends on field teaching operation of workers, so that the mechanical arm control threshold is high, and the field limitation is large are solved, and the beneficial effects of being low in threshold, high in interactivity, low in delay, high in safety, high in flexibility and the like are achieved.
title: Humanoid robot remote control system and method based on virtual reality technology

abstract: The invention discloses a three-freedom-degree parallel low-frequency humanoid mechanical foot and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The three-freedom-degree parallel low-frequency humanoid mechanical foot comprises a mechanical shank, a tarsal bone, a metatarsal bone board A, a metatarsal bone board B, a toe, an ankle joint, a tarsometatarsal joint and a toe joint. The mechanical shank is connected with the tarsal bone through the ankle joint. The tarsal bone is connected with the metatarsal bone board A and the metatarsal bone board B through the tarsometatarsal joint. The toe is connected with the metatarsal bone board A and the metatarsal bone board B through the toe joint. The right end of the tarsal bone is in a U shape, and the left end of the tarsal bone is in a rod shape. The ankle joint comprises an ankle shaft, a driving shaft A, a large gear A, a pinion A and a motor A. The tarsometatarsal joint comprises a tarsal bone shaft, a driving shaft B, a pinion B, a large gear B and a motor B. The toe joint comprises a toe shaft, a driving shaft C, a large gear C, a pinion C and a motor C. The humanoid mechanical foot is reasonable in structure, has three motion freedom degrees and a low-frequency response characteristic and is in a parallel mode.
title: Three-freedom-degree parallel low-frequency humanoid mechanical foot

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot attitude estimation method based on physical information constraint. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an attitude estimation network model; step 2, constructing a loss function; step 3, training the attitude estimation network model, and then performing attitude estimation by using the attitude estimation network model; step 4, calculating a state prediction value and a covariance matrix thereof; 5, calculating a gain matrix of the attitude estimation network model; step 6, calculating a posteriori estimation value of the state and a covariance matrix of the state; 7, calculating the state estimation result to obtain the joint posture estimation of the humanoid robot at the current moment; and step 8, repeatedly executing the step 4 to the step 7 to obtain attitude estimation results at all moments. The structure driven by the hybrid model can effectively avoid the conditions that the network model has large demand on annotation data and is easy to fall into local optimum and the like, and can provide an accurate attitude estimation result.
title: Humanoid robot attitude estimation method based on physical information constraint

abstract: A finger joint transmission structure of an anthropomorphic robot hand includes a first finger segment and a second finger segment that are pivotally connected to each other. A toothed rack in an arc shape is provided at the joint of the first finger segment and the second finger segment. The second finger segment has a speed reducer and a motor connected to the speed reducer therein. The speed reducer has a transmission shaft extending toward the toothed rack. A transmission gear meshing with the toothed rack is provided on the transmission shaft. When the motor drives the transmission shaft to rotate via the speed reducer, the transmission gear is synchronously driven to move along the toothed rack, so that the second finger segment is driven to be pivoted upward or downward at a predetermined angle relative to the first finger segment.
title: FINGER JOINT TRANSMISSION STRUCTURE OF ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention discloses a robot autonomous assembly method and system based on imitation learning, a storage medium and computer equipment, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a universal expert strategy suitable for polygonal shaft hole assembly through analyzing and summarizing the polygonal shaft hole assembly experience of an expert; according to the strategy, task type images and human assembly demonstration data including assembly force/torque and assembly actions are collected; modeling a human assembly skill into a universal assembly skill model based on shared knowledge and specific knowledge; using a loss function guidance algorithm to train and optimize the general assembly model; and deploying the optimized general assembly model into a control system of the robot so as to drive the robot to execute humanization-like assembly. According to the method, the problems of poor generalization performance, slow convergence of an end-to-end learning mode and high cost of an imitation learning method can be solved, rapid learning of human skills can be realized, and humanoid robot autonomous assembly is realized.
title: Robot autonomous assembly method and system based on imitation learning, storage medium and computer equipment

abstract: The biped robot comprises a hip support, two legs are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of the hip support, and each leg comprises a hip ball joint, a thigh, a knee joint, a shank, an ankle ball joint and a sole which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; a second driving mechanism and a third driving mechanism are arranged on the hip ball joint, the second driving mechanism controls the hip ball joint to drive the thigh to perform side-sway motion by taking a second straight line as a rotating shaft, the third driving mechanism controls the hip ball joint to drive the thigh to perform pitching motion by taking a third straight line as a rotating shaft, and the second straight line and the third straight line are orthogonal; a fifth driving mechanism and a sixth driving mechanism are arranged on the ankle ball joint, the fifth driving mechanism controls the ankle ball joint to drive the foot sole to perform side-sway motion by taking a fifth straight line as a rotating shaft, the sixth driving mechanism controls the ankle ball joint to drive the foot sole to perform pitching motion by taking a sixth straight line as a rotating shaft, and the fifth straight line and the sixth straight line are orthogonal. The shape and gait of the robot are more anthropomorphic, coupling linkage does not exist between degrees of freedom, and the control difficulty is reduced.
title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent manufacturing method and system based on man-machine collaboration, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing. The system comprises a man-machine joint operation module, a humanoid learning module, a behavior safety module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the man-machine joint operation module estimates a task state through visual information so as to drive a robot to do corresponding adjustment in real time and meet collaboration needs of users; the humanoid learning module learns operation experience of human through the visual information acquired by the robot; the behavior safety module performs overlapping at the terminal of the robot by using a method of estimating virtual force based on man-machine distance through building a man-machine dynamics fusion module so as to ensure that the man-machine safety in the collaboration task; and the man-machine interaction module can realize information interaction between the human and the robot. According to the method and system disclosed by the invention, an operation mode is divided into supervision disposal, man-machine interaction module and man-machine joint operation modes according to the situation that whether people is required to participate in the operation task scene, so that the operation efficiency of the man-machine joint operation is improved, and the needs for manufacturing personalized customization products can be met.
title: Intelligent manufacturing method and system based on man-machine collaboration

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot wrist and a control method thereof.The humanoid robot wrist comprises a connecting disc, a universal joint mounting disc and a power source fixing frame, a reset mechanism and a universal ball joint are arranged between the connecting disc and the universal joint mounting disc, one end of the universal ball joint is rotationally connected with the connecting disc, and the other end of the universal ball joint is connected with the universal joint mounting disc; a power source is fixed to the power source fixing frame and fixed to the lower end of the universal joint mounting disc, a connecting rod is arranged between the power source and the connecting disc, and the two ends of the connecting rod are connected with the power source and the connecting disc respectively. By introducing the universal ball joint and a connecting rod mechanism, the degree of freedom of the wrist is remarkably increased, the wrist can perform more complex and diversified actions, it is ensured that power transmission is more direct and higher in efficiency, and the response speed and motion precision of the wrist part are improved. And the reset mechanism can automatically reset the wrist part to the original or preset position after any external force is eliminated, so that the repeatability and the accuracy of operation are enhanced.
title: Humanoid robot wrist and control method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, and provides an electrical system of a heavy-load humanoid manipulator and the heavy-load humanoid manipulator, and the electrical system comprises a sensor module, a central processing module, a driving execution module, a power management module and a communication module, the central processing module is used for receiving and processing a sensor signal and generating a control instruction, the driving execution module is used for executing the instruction of the central processing module and driving a manipulator joint to move, the power supply management module is used for providing a stable power supply for each module, and the communication module is used for realizing data interaction between the system and external equipment. High-precision sensing and intelligent control are achieved through cooperation of multiple modules, the sensor module integrates a multi-axis inclination angle sensor, a six-dimensional force sensor and a binocular vision sensor, joint angles, grabbing force and object vision information can be collected in real time, and object recognition, grabbing strategy optimization and motion track planning are achieved.
title: Electrical system of heavy-load humanoid manipulator and heavy-load humanoid manipulator

abstract: The invention discloses an AR intelligent helmet device capable of achieving gesture interaction. The AR intelligent helmet device comprises an AR helmet and a gesture recognition module. Wherein the AR helmet is composed of a multi-camera module, an SoC computing board, a binocular micro display screen and an optical machine module, the multi-camera module collects gesture images, gesture action control instructions are recognized through gesture recognition processing on the SoC computing board based on the ARM + NPU architecture, function selection, clicking, quitting and page changing actions are carried out, and the gesture images are displayed through the binocular micro display screen and the optical machine module. The images are synchronously displayed on the binocular micro display screen and the ray machine module; the gesture recognition module runs on the SoC computing board and is used for carrying out hand detection and static gesture recognition on the gesture images collected by the multi-camera module, and a hand detection network based on RetinaHand is adopted for hand detection. Compared with the prior art, the method can achieve gesture interaction recognition, has the advantages of being short in time delay, accurate in hand action recognition and capable of supporting real-time interaction, and has important significance in communication between people, between people and machines and even between humanoid intelligent machines.
title: AR (Augmented Reality) intelligent helmet device capable of realizing gesture interaction

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, and provides a lightweight humanoid musculoskeletal mechanical arm which comprises a base, a driver module, a sensing information acquisition module, an artificial muscle unit assembly and an arm assembly, and the driver module is arranged on the base; the sensing information acquisition module is arranged on the base and is electrically connected with the driver module; the artificial muscle unit assembly is arranged on the base and is connected with the driver module, so that the driver module transmits a signal to the artificial muscle unit assembly; one end of the arm assembly is movably connected with the base and is in transmission connection with the artificial muscle unit assembly through a pipeline transmission structure; wherein the artificial muscle unit assembly drives the arm assembly to act through the pipeline transmission structure. The invention aims to provide a musculoskeletal arm hardware platform simulating the human upper limbs, which has flexibility and safety.
title: Lightweight humanoid musculoskeletal mechanical arm

abstract: PURPOSE: A finger module and a multi-fingered robot hand device for a humanoid robot are provided to facilitate maintenance and repair by quickly replacing a standardized drive part. CONSTITUTION: A finger module(30) comprises a finger housing part(35). The finger housing part has the shape of a finger module. Plural joints which are integrated are formed in the finger housing part. A pin hole is formed on both ends of the joints. A link is connected between the joints. A drive part moves a link structure in the finger housing part.
title: A finger module and a multi-finger hand device for a humnanoid robot thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a subject humanoid robot. The subject humanoid robot is characterized in that the subject humanoid robot comprises a trunk, a driving system, a sensing system and a control system; the trunk comprises a skeleton, limbs, joints and appropriate body soft tissue; the skeleton and the limbs form a framework; the joints connect different components or different parts; the body soft tissue can play a role in component connection and buffering; the driving system is used for driving all components of the trunk to move; the sensing system comprises a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor; the pressure sensor is used for measuring and sensing changes of pressure generated when the humanoid robot makes contact with the ground; the temperature sensor is used for measuring and sensing temperature changes; the humidity sensor is used for measuring and sensing humidity changes; the control system can control the subject humanoid robot to imitate the scenes that a real person moves, falls and slips; research is carried out on falling and slipping of the person; accordingly, movement security of people is guaranteed by carrying out detailed experiments on the moving, falling and slipping actions of the person.
title: Subject humanoid robot

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot reinforcement learning training method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a model file of a humanoid robot; analyzing the model file to obtain a position relation of two feet of the humanoid robot and part constraint information of the humanoid robot, and establishing a reference coordinate system according to the position relation of the two feet; according to the reference coordinate system and the component constraint information, a parallel ankle joint mechanism model of the humanoid robot is constructed, and inverse kinematics information is determined according to the parallel ankle joint mechanism model; and training a reinforcement learning strategy of the humanoid robot according to the inverse kinematics information and the component constraint information. According to the method, series-parallel connection conversion in a resolving mode in the training process is avoided, the operation efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the requirement for reinforcement learning parallel sampling efficiency is lowered, the training process is simplified, and the convergence speed of reinforcement learning strategies is increased.
title: Humanoid robot reinforcement learning training method, device and equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a method for real-time simulation of human motion through anthropomorphic robot based on multiple working chains. The method for real-time simulation of human motion through anthropomorphic robot based on multiple working chains comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and optimization; S2, coordinate mapping; S3, forward kinematic model establishment; S4, reverse kinematics solving of the multiple working chains; S5, filtering processing of angle values; and S6, angle value limiting..The real-time humanoid robot simulation method absorbs advantages of existing various technologies, realizes real-time imitation of the human body motion through the anthropomorphic robot, and has high application and promotion value.
title: Method for real-time simulation of human motion through anthropomorphic robot based on multiple working chains

abstract: The invention relates to a sixteen-freedom-degree humanoid robot head and neck mechanism. The sixteen-freedom-degree humanoid robot head and neck mechanism comprises a pair of eyebrow units, a pair of eye and eyelid units, a lower jaw unit, a structure connection unit and a neck unit. The lower end of the structure connection unit is connected with the upper end of the neck unit. The pair of eye and eyelid units are installed on the left side and the right side of the upper portion of the structure connection unit correspondingly. The pair of eyebrow units are correspondingly connected with the pair of eye and eyelid units correspondingly. The lower jaw unit is installed on the structure connection unit. The sixteen-freedom-degree humanoid robot head and neck mechanism is good in overall action harmony, and flexible movement of various head and neck organs is accurately, coordinately and rapidly achieved through a head and neck control mechanism so that various expressions of robots can be expressed.
title: Sixteen-freedom-degree humanoid robot head and neck mechanism

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly provides a robot, a motion control method and device thereof and a storage medium. The robot motion control method comprises the steps of obtaining plantar force of a supporting leg when the robot moves, determining the deformation quantity of a leg elastic piece of the robot according to the plantar force, determining the knee joint compensation amount for robot mass center height compensation according to the deformation quantity, and controlling a knee joint motor of the robot according to the knee joint compensation amount. In the embodiment of the invention, the knee joint motor is subjected to compensation control through the deformation quantity of the leg elastic piece of the supporting leg of the robot, so that the control precision of the supporting leg is effectively improved, the problem of body height reduction caused by deformation of the supporting leg elastic piece in the walking process of the robot is eliminated or relieved, and the body height of the robot is kept constant; and the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.
title: Robot, motion control method and device thereof and storage medium

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a passive safety impedance mechanism with feedback and damping functions. The passive safety impedance mechanism comprises a bearing, an elastic device and a detection device, wherein the bearing comprises an outer ring and an inner ring; the elastic device is used for being connected with the outer ring and the inner ring; and the detection device is used for detecting the relative rotation amount of the outer ring and the inner ring. The passive safety impedance mechanism with the feedback and damping functions can be applied to a robot joint, a mechanical arm, a humanoid robot and other scenes. The passive safety impedance mechanism with the feedback and damping functions has the advantages of being simple in structure, high in precision, large in bearing capacity, high in universality, easy to install and low in cost.
title: Passive safety impedance mechanism with feedback and damping functions

abstract: The invention provides a natural language control method for a humanoid robot. By constructing the simple skill library and the complex skill library of the robot, the dependence on a large amount of operation data in a specific field is effectively reduced. According to the method, a large language model is used as a base of a task planner, and the capabilities of scene learning, semantic understanding and common sense reasoning of the task planner are brought into full play. By introducing a visual model in the field of computer vision, high-level semantic information and low-level spatial information of the environment can be obtained, and an accurate scene graph is constructed to serve as environment state representation. According to the voice interaction interface constructed by the invention, the naturalness of man-machine interaction is improved, so that a user can more conveniently communicate with the robot and input instructions, the user experience is effectively improved, and popularization of the humanoid robot in an actual application scene is facilitated.
title: Natural language control method for humanoid robot

abstract: A mobility surrogate includes a humanoid form supporting at least one camera that captures image data from a first physical location in which the first mobility surrogate is disposed to produce an image signal and a mobility base. The mobility base includes a support mechanism at least one prosthetic device supported by the humanoid form; and with the humanoid form affixed to the support on the mobility base and a transport module that includes mechanical drive mechanism and a transport control module including a processor and memory that are configured to receive control messages from a network and process the control messages to control the transport module according to the control messages received from the network.
title: MOBILITY SURROGATES

abstract: The invention discloses a labyrinth feature recognition and walking method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the specific steps that step 1, a camera at the head of the humanoid robot collectsan image; step 2, the humanoid robot performs image processing and image feature extraction on collected image information, wherein the processes include edge detection, circle detection, straight line detection and line splicing to identify the features of the labyrinth; step 3, the humanoid robot identifies intersection types according to the features of the labyrinth; and step 4, the humanoidrobot passes through the current intersection according to the intersection types and walking strategies. The method uses vision, sonar and information of fewer markers, obtains the relative positioninformation of the robot in the labyrinth, identifies the intersection types in the labyrinth and develops corresponding walking strategies according to different intersection types to make the humanoid robot successfully pass the intersections, realize the labyrinth navigation and realize the direction calibration when deviation occurs during the walking.
title: Labyrinth feature recognition and walking method of humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a voice interaction method based on a public display device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining voice of a user by the public display device; converting the obtained voice of the user into corresponding character information; detecting whether the character information obtained through conversion includes a preset keyword or not to obtain a detection result; determining the intention of the user according to the obtained detection result; and performing interaction response on the user through the voice according to the determined intention of the user. By using the mode, the goals of determining the intention of the user by obtaining the voice of the user and doing the humanoid interaction of the voice response by the publicdisplay device can be achieved.
title: Voice interaction method based on public display device and equipment

abstract: The invention provides a rigid-flexible coupling multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand. The rigid-flexible coupling multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand comprises flexible fingers, a rigid supporting shell, a rigid metacarpal joint, a rigid wrist joint and a driving control system, wherein the flexible fingers, the rigid metacarpal joint and the rigid wrist joint are fixed tothe rigid supporting shell to form a physical structure main body of the dexterous hand, and the driving control system receives serial port data and sends control signals to a pneumatic driver and anelectric driver according to the serial port data to conduct coordinated control on the movement of the flexible fingers, the rigid metacarpal joint and the rigid wrist joint. Compared with a traditional rigid humanoid hand, the rigid-flexible coupling multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand is low in manufacturing cost, simple in transmission, higher in adaptability to grabbing differentobjects and better in system robustness, and compared with a common soft humanoid hand, the rigid-flexible coupling multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand is high in grabbing load capacity and more stable in grabbing.
title: Rigid-flexible coupling multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot switchable humanoid robot leg configuration. The humanoid robot leg configuration comprises a left side leg configuration and a right side leg configuration which are symmetrical and have the same structure; wherein the left leg structure comprises a right thigh assembly, a robot right knee hub motor module, a right shank assembly, a right shank driven wheel module and a right foot assembly from top to bottom; the right leg structure comprises a left thigh assembly, a left knee hub motor module, a left shank assembly, a left shank driven wheel module and a left foot assembly from top to bottom. According to the design that the wheel state and the foot state can be switched, the maneuverability of the humanoid robot on a long straight road or a slow slope or other specific road conditions is improved.
title: Humanoid robot leg structure with switchable wheels and feet

abstract: The invention discloses a virtual character voice regulation and control method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: determining an initialized voice parameter after a virtual character is activated according to environment voice, and feeding back an initialized voice to a user according to the initialized voice parameter; acquiring a second demand voice which is sent by a user and is associated with the first demand voice, and adjusting the first voice content, the first voice tone, the first voice volume and the first voice orientation according to the second voice content, the second voice tone, the second voice volume and the second voice orientation in the second demand voice, and generating and outputting a second feedback voice associated with the first feedback voice. According to the invention, a humanized virtual character voice regulation and control scheme is realized, so that the interaction between the virtual character and the user has a more humanoid feeling, the efficiency of voice interaction between the user and the virtual character is improved, and the use experience of the user is enhanced.
title: Virtual character voice regulation and control method and device and computer readable storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a robot trajectory planning method based on a fourth-order cubic B-spline function, and a humanoid robot platform. Through the method, specific movements required by various joints are planned, a complete trajectory generation control system is established, and stable control on a humanoid robot under a ZMP stable condition is ensured. The trajectory planning part of the method comprises the steps of construction of a B-spline function, mathematical model deduction of the B-spline function, solution of the fourth-order cubic B-spline function, and densification of a joint trajectory. After an expected trajectory is derived, corresponding movement functions are edited to a raspberry Pi system according to to-be-solved data points, corresponding instructions are sent through smartphone application software to call the corresponding movement functions to complete the expected planning trajectory. With the adoption of the fourth-order cubic B-spline function for planning the movement trajectory, no sharp corner problem is caused at places between adjacent joints, vibration of a joint mechanical arm is avoided, and the stability of the humanoid robot in a movement process is improved.
title: Robot trajectory planning method based on fourth-order cubic B-spline function and humanoid robot platform

abstract: The invention provides a mapping method applied to humanoid robot double-hand motion imitation. The mapping method comprises the steps that positions of double shoulders, double elbows, double knees and a head of a human body in a world coordinate system are obtained, and corresponding target motions of double arms, double legs, a trunk and the head of a humanoid robot are calculated by utilizinga rotation matrix; the posture of human hands in the world coordinate system is obtained through a VR game handle and is converted into the human body hand posture of the human body relative to the coordinate system; and the human body hand posture of the human body relative to the coordinate system is the same as humanoid robot hand target posture RhandJ of the robot relative to the coordinate system, the RhandJ is decomposed into humanoid robot wrist posture RwristA and humanoid robot forearm posture RarmJ, a value expressed by an XYZ euler angle corresponding to the RwristA is taken as a target value of a humanoid robot wrist driving device, and human body wrist rotation is made to be accurately mapped to humanoid robot wrists.
title: Mapping method applied to humanoid robot double-hand motion imitation

abstract: The invention discloses a robot driver, and relates to application of a robot in the field of traffic life, in particular to the robot driver. The robot driver is a humanoid robot and comprises a headassembly, a neck upper body assembly, a hand assembly, a butt assembly, a leg and foot assembly, a sensor system assembly, a control system assembly and a power supply assembly. According to the invention, artificial intelligence and Internet of Things technologies are applied; most functions of intelligent automatic driving are realized; problems that long-distance driving fatigue occurs and designated driving of drivers is needed, families need full-time drivers without paying salary, and patrol vehicles in freight yards, ports, airports, tourist districts and roads are needed for work aresolved and drivers can be owned without paying salary, and problems that human drivers cannot be competent due to the fact that the vehicles need to be transported back and forth for 24 hours for standby or work on the fixed line are solved; therefore, the implementation of the robot driver accelerates the coming of intelligent life, brings convenience for enjoying the intelligent automatic driving automobile to families and groups, and solves many problems of life and travel.
title: Robot driver

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a four-finger humanoid dexterous hand based on tumbling-pitching degree-of-freedom metacarpophalangeal joints, which comprises a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger and a ring finger, the thumb is arranged on the inner side of the palm, and the index finger, the middle finger and the ring finger are arranged on the top of the palm. The four fingers are independently controlled, each finger is provided with three joints, and the movement of the near-end knuckle joint and the movement of the far-end knuckle joint are coupled through a crossed four-bar mechanism. Three fingers except the thumb adopt rolling-pitching type double degrees of freedom different from that of a traditional yawing-pitching type at metacarpophalangeal joints and are driven by different motors respectively, so that bending and stretching of the fingers and rolling rotation around own axes can be realized; the metacarpophalangeal joints of the thumb are connected through a micro servo linear motor, so that the lateral swing degree of freedom is provided for the proximal phalanx. The dexterous hand is reasonable in structure, rich in grabbing posture, high in dexterous performance and capable of achieving various grabbing tasks.
title: Four-finger humanoid dexterous hand based on rolling-pitching type degree-of-freedom metacarpophalangeal joints

abstract: The invention discloses a peripheral-central sensitization touch sensing device based on an electric double layer theory. The sensing device is mainly formed by combining an ionization sensor, an LM sensor and a synaptic transistor. Wherein the ionization sensor is connected in series with the grid electrode of the synaptic transistor, and the voltage input of the grid electrode of the synaptic transistor is adjusted through the ionization sensor so as to indirectly realize the regulation and control of the synaptic stimulation excitation current EPSC; and the LM sensor is connected in series with the source and drain electrodes of the synaptic transistor to directly regulate and control the synaptic stimulus excitation current EPSC between the source and drain electrodes. The characteristics of the ionization sensor, the LM sensor and the synaptic transistor are fully combined, the plastic characteristic and the sensitization characteristic are combined at the same time, and the humanoid robot can be endowed with the acute sensing ability and the injury stimulation prevention ability.
title: Peripheral-central sensitization tactile sensing device based on double electric layer theory

abstract: A humanoid robot includes a base, a robotic torso coupled to the base, at least one robotic arm, at least one robotic shoulder coupling the at least one robotic arm to the robotic torso, a robotic neck coupled to the robotic torso, and a plurality of actuators configured to move at least a portion of at least one of the robotic torso, the at least one robotic arm, the at least one robotic shoulder, and the robotic neck. Each of the robotic torso, the at least one robotic arm, the at least one robotic shoulder, and the robotic neck is defined by one or more proportions that deviates less than 25% from respective proportions of a human envelope.
title: HUMANOID ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot moving by wheels. The humanoid robot comprises a main connecting piece, starting steering engines, starting moving pieces, support pieces, driving motors, themain connecting piece is arranged at the top of the humanoid robot, one ends of the starting steering engines are fixedly connected with a bottom portion of the main connecting piece, each of the starting moving pieces is provided with a starting moving opening, the other ends of the starting steering engines are rotatably arranged in the starting moving openings, the driving motors are fixedly connected with the support pieces, and power output ends of the driving motors are connected with driving wheels of the humanoid robot. The support pieces are detachably connected with the starting moving pieces, or a plurality of moving connecting parts are arranged between the starting moving pieces and the support pieces, the moving connecting parts comprise moving steering engines, U-shaped fixed pieces and U-shaped moving pieces, the starting U-shaped fixed pieces of the moving connecting parts are detachably connected with the starting moving pieces, and terminating U-shaped moving piecesare detachably connected with the support pieces. The humanoid robot moving by wheels is capable of adapting to different landforms.
title: Humanoid robot moving by wheels

abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid soccer robot gait plan based on cubic spline interpolation. The humanoid soccer robot gait plan comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a kinematic modelaccording to the structure of a robot; (2) planning the gait of the robot on the basis of the kinematic model by using the space cubic spline interpolation method; and (3) optimizing the gait of the robot according to a stability control algorithm for vibration suppression. According to the humanoid soccer robot gait plan, the defect of instability in walking of the robot is improved, so that therobot has good robustness so as to implement behaviors such as walking and kicking the ball; the cubic spline interpolation planning method is adopted, so that the geometrical relationship between alljoints can be preferably guaranteed in the NAO robot soccer gait plan, and the later stability is conveniently optimized; and the angle of deviation and the distance of deviation during walking are greatly reduced through new gait planning and algorithm optimization, and the walking accuracy and stability of the robot are greatly increased.
title: Humanoid soccer robot gait plan based on cubic spline interpolation

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a two-degree-of-freedom modular humanoid robot joint thereof, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The two-degree-of-freedom modular humanoid robot joint comprises two groups of same driving and transmission mechanisms, wherein the driving and transmission mechanisms are characterized in that a motor shaft is connected with one end of a lead screw, a middle hole of a sliding block is meshed with the lead screw, a through hole in the lower end of the sliding block is connected with one end of a connecting rod I in a sleeving mode, the other end of the connecting rod I is connected with one end of a connecting rod II through a cross shaft assembly I, the other end of the connecting rod II is fixedly connected with a joint bearing assembly, and the joint bearing assembly is fixedly connected with the execution end of a U-shaped frame. According to the humanoid robot and the two-degree-of-freedom modular humanoid robot joint thereof, the rotational inertia of the mechanism can be reduced when the arm or leg joint of the humanoid robot moves, the structure is stable, the flexibility is high, and different types of lead screws can be selected according to different use requirements for targeted design.
title: Humanoid robot and two-degree-of-freedom modular humanoid robot joint thereof

abstract: The invention discloses an integral structure humanoid foot and foot plate system of a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of foot plates of biped robots. The problems that an existing biped robot with a single-degree-of-freedom foot mechanism is poor in terrain adaptability and stiff in walking gait are solved. A sole corresponding section and a heel corresponding section of a rubber foot pad are respectively provided with a film pressure sensor; the sole section and the heel section of the humanoid foot skeleton are positioned on the film pressure sensor; a three-dimensional force sensor is arranged in the heel section and is connected with a shank of the robot through an ankle connecting piece; an IMU attitude sensor, a DSP information acquisition controller, a plantar pressure signal processing circuit and a three-dimensional force signal processing circuit are arranged in the humanoid foot skeleton; sensing signals are transmitted to the DSP information acquisition controller; the split type shell rear section and the split type shell front section are detachably connected and installed on the humanoid foot framework to form an integral shell. According to the invention, an integral structural design is adopted, so that better adaptability to terrains is achieved.
title: Humanoid foot and foot plate system with integral structure for biped robot

abstract: An extensible task engine framework for humanoid robots. Robot instructions are stored as tasks and skills. Tasks are designed so that they can be executed by a variety of robots with differing configurations. A task can refer to zero or more skills. A skill can be designed for a particular configuration of robot. A task can be transferred from robot to robot. When executed on a particular robot, the task makes calls to one or more skills that can take advantage of the capabilities of that robot.
title: Extensible task engine framework for humanoid robots

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cognitive modeling, in particular to an anthropomorphic agent framework and method based on a cognitive triangle psychological mechanism. Comprising the steps that a psychological mechanism agent is designed, specifically, a frame based on cognitive triangles is designed, emotion, thinking and behaviors interact, and a cognitive behavior structure of the agent is formed; the emotion module introduces a hierarchical emotion model, and the thinking module introduces a triple network model and reconstructs an existing agent framework. Compared with previous research, the method simulates more real agent emotion and thinking, and makes a contribution to human-like behavior simulation.
title: Anthropomorphic agent framework and method based on cognitive triangle psychological mechanism

abstract: The object of the invention is a humanoid robot (100) with a body (190) joined to an omnidirectional mobile ground base (140), equipped with : - a body position sensor, a base position sensor and an angular velocity sensor to provide measures, - actuators (212) comprising at least 3 wheels located in the omnidirectional mobile base, - extractors (211) for converting sensored measures into useful data, - a supervisor (500) to calculate position, velocity and acceleration commands from the useful data, - means for converting commands into instructions for the actuators, characterized in that the supervisor comprises: - a no-tilt state controller (501), a tilt state controller (502) and a landing state controller (503), each controller comprising means for calculating, position, velocity and acceleration commands based on a double point-mass robot model with tilt motion and on a linear model predictive control law, expressed as a quadratic optimization formulation with a weighted sum of objectives, and a set of predefined linear constraints.
title: Omnidirectional wheeled humanoid robot based on a linear predictive position and velocity controller

abstract: The invention relates to an anthropomorphic work order alarm system based on a voice instruction matching technology, and aims to improve work order processing efficiency and user experience. The system can receive and analyze a voice instruction of a user in real time through an advanced voice recognition technology, automatically generate a work order and carry out intelligent alarm. And the personification design enables the system to carry out natural conversation with the user and provide personalized services. The system not only can reduce the complexity of manual operation, but also can improve the response speed, is helpful for handling emergencies in time, and is suitable for work order management and alarm requirements of various industries.
title: Robot personification voice work order alarm system based on voice instruction matching technology

abstract: The invention provides a method for controlling the stability of a humanoid flexible arm system. The control method based on virtual damping and inertia parameters belongs to the field of humanoid flexible arm control. The method comprises the steps that in order to solve the problem that system damping is reduced due to introduction of flexible elements in a flexible joint and accordingly the stability of the system is reduced, a flexible joint model based on virtual damping and inertia is established by introducing virtual damping and the inertia parameters, a control equation for introducing virtual damping and the inertia parameters is constructed, virtual inertia and damping characteristics are increased for a flexible joint system, the system damping ratio is improved, and the systemstability is improved. According to the method, by introducing virtual damping and the inertia parameters, on the premise of not adding additional hardware structures and complex algorithms, the damping ratio of the flexible joint system is increased, the stability of the humanoid flexible arm system is improved, and the adaptability and practicability of the humanoid flexible arm are improved.
title: Method for controlling stability of humanoid flexible arm system

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of force sensors, in particular to a compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor. In order to solve the problems that the overload capacity of a traditional cantilever beam structure is insufficient, a novel I-shaped beam and II-shaped beam structure is difficult to miniaturize and the requirements of a humanoid robot for high overload capacity and a compact structure cannot be met at the same time, the following technical scheme is provided: the six-dimensional force sensor comprises an outer frame; the cross beam is mounted in the outer frame; the vertical beam is vertically arranged at the central position of the cross beam; the connecting block is arranged at one end, far away from the cross-shaped beam, of the vertical beam; the outer frame, the cross-shaped beam, the vertical beam and the connecting block are integrally designed; and the mounting plate is mounted on the connecting block. The mounting requirements of humanoid robot joints and other space-limited scenes are met, multi-time rated load impact can be borne, and the movement safety and the complex task execution capacity of a robot are improved.
title: Compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor

abstract: The invention concerns a spinal column for a humanoid robot, the column (20) comprising a lower base (11) intended to be fixed to a pelvis of the robot (10) and an upper base (13) intended to be fixed to a neck (14) of the robot (10), the spinal column (10) allowing two rotations of the upper base (13) relative to the lower base (11), a first taking place about a sagittal axis (21) and a second taking place about a transverse axis (22). According to the invention, the column (20) comprises a flexible band (25) and linear actuators (26, 27), the band (25) being embedded in a first of the ends (28, 30) thereof at a point (29) in a first of the bases (11, 13) and at least guided at a point (31) in a second of the bases (11, 13), the actuators (26, 27) both being anchored between the two bases (11, 13) at anchoring points (32, 33, 34, 35). For each of the bases (11, 13), the anchoring points (32, 33, 34, 35) of the two actuators (26, 27) and the embedding or guide point (29, 31) of the band (25) are spaced apart.
title: SPINAL COLUMN FOR A HUMANOID ROBOT

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of control, particularly relates to a musculoskeletal system control method and system based on speed precision balance and a device, and aims to solve the problem that an existing humanoid musculoskeletal robot control method cannot well perform antagonistic muscle collaborative contraction control. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring estimated motion precision of a musculoskeletal system through a Fitts' law; calculating a supervised item torque based on the estimated motion precision through a striatum inspired speed modulation strategy; calculating a muscle activation signal vector through a muscle activation signal network; and calculating an action award based on the muscle activation signal vector and the supervised item torque, then calculating a loss function, adjusting parameters of the muscle activation signal network based on the loss function, increasing the value of the action reward, and repeatedly iterating to obtain a muscle activation signal sequence required by control. According to the method, structural information of the musculoskeletal system is utilized, a universal antagonistic muscle cooperative contraction control strategy is constructed, and smooth movement is guaranteed.
title: Musculoskeletal system control method and system based on speed precision balance and device

abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom series-parallel shock resisting mechanical foot of a humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The mechanical foot comprises a metatarsal plate, an ankle shaft and toe shafts mounted on the metatarsal plate, an ankle shaft gear mounted on the ankle shaft, an ankle power shaft engaged with the ankle shaft gear, an ankle motor connected with the ankle power shaft through an output shaft, parallel toes and toe shaft gears mounted on the ankle shaft, toe power wheels engaged with the toe shaft gears, toe motors connected with the toe power wheels through output shafts, calf springs for connecting mechanical calves with the metatarsal plate, and toe springs for connecting the parallel toes with the metatarsal plate; the ankle shaft gear is fixedly connected with the mechanical calves; the toe shaft gears are fixedly connected with the parallel toes; the ankle shaft can freely rotate on the metatarsal plate; and the toe shafts can freely rotate on the metatarsal plate. The humanoid mechanical foot is simple in structure, and has two degrees of freedom, shock resistance and a series-parallel mode.
title: Two-degree-of-freedom series-parallel shock resisting mechanical foot of humanoid robot

abstract: The lower limb device is used for the humanoid robot and comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly, a first matching ring and a second matching ring, the hip joint assembly comprises a pitching driving part, a transverse rolling driving part, a yaw driving part and a first matching part, the pitching driving part is rotationally connected with the transverse rolling driving part, the transverse rolling driving part is rotationally connected with the yaw driving part, and the first matching part is rotationally connected with the thigh assembly. The first matching part is connected with the yaw driving part, the thigh assembly comprises a second matching part, one of the second matching part and the first matching part is provided with a protrusion, the other one of the second matching part and the first matching part is provided with a groove, and the protrusion is matched with the groove so that the second matching part and the first matching part can be relatively fixed in the circumferential direction of the yaw driving part. The first matching ring and the second matching ring are arranged on the periphery of the second matching piece and the periphery of the first matching piece in a sleeving mode correspondingly, the first matching ring and the second matching ring are detachably connected, so that the second matching piece and the first matching piece are fixedly connected in the axial direction of the yaw driving piece, and the convenience degree of disassembly and assembly of the hip joint assembly and the thigh assembly is improved.
title: Lower limb device and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic mechanical hand which comprises a finger skeleton unit, a finger joint driving unit, a palm skeleton unit and a palm opening and closing rotation unit, wherein the finger joint driving unit and the palm opening and closing rotation units are gel drivers; the finger skeleton unit is connected with the finger joint driving unit to form mechanical fingers, and the palm skeleton unit is provided with the palm opening and closing rotation units; the palm opening and closing rotation units are respectively arranged at the position under a thumb, of the palm skeletonunit and at the position under a little finger and a ring finger, of the palm skeleton unit; and the mechanical fingers are connected with the palm skeleton unit to form the bionic mechanical hand. Each finger joint of the mechanical hand can be individually controlled, so that the mechanical hand has high sensitivity and flexible movement. By using gel materials, the mechanical hand can achieve ahighly anthropomorphic state. The mechanical hand can be used as a robotic hand, can also be used as an artificial limb for people with disabilities, and can also be used as a rehabilitation glove toassist hand rehabilitation. The mechanical hand is widely used and is of great significance to the society.
title: Bionic mechanical hand

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid quantum robot capable of magnetizing a human body magnetic field through handshake, which comprises a humanoid robot body, a magnetization module, a sensing module, a quantum computing processor and a cloud server, the magnetization module is used for magnetizing a biological magnetic field of the hand of a user when the user is handshaken, and the sensing module is used for carrying out multi-modal data acquisition on the user; a cloud server; according to the rotating magnetic field design of the magnetization module, the physical handshake action is combined with the magnetic field adjusting technology, the magnetic field adjusting technology is combined with the magnetic field adjusting technology, the magnetic field adjusting technology is combined with the magnetic field adjusting technology, and the magnetic field adjusting technology is combined with the magnetic field adjusting technology. A new'contact-type magnetic therapy interaction 'normal form is created, the change of a biological magnetic field is sensed in real time through the magnetic field intensity feedback unit, and the interestingness and the sense of science and technology are remarkably improved.
title: Humanoid quantum robot capable of magnetizing human body magnetic field through handshake

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a joint thereof, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The joint of the humanoid robot comprises a joint frame with an integrated structure, a first driving module, a second driving module, a connecting rod transmission module, a synchronous belt transmission module and a cross shaft joint module, wherein the first driving module, the second driving module and the cross shaft joint module are sequentially fixed inside the joint frame in the direction of the execution end, and the connecting rod transmission module and the synchronous belt transmission module are located on the two sides of the joint frame. The joint of the humanoid robot has the advantage that a parallel structure enables the driving modules to be away from the execution end so as to reduce the rotational inertia, and meanwhile, different configuration schemes are adopted for different degrees of freedom according to working requirements in a serial mechanism; and the whole structure has the characteristics of being high in modularization and integration degree, high in torque-to-weight ratio and high in structural strength.
title: Humanoid robot and joint thereof

abstract: The invention relates to layered CPG and application of the layered CPG in walking control of a humanoid robot. The layered CPG is passively motivated by an external sensing information to generate amotion time sequence signal loaded with a motion mode, the layered CPG comprises a rhythm generator layer and a pattern generator layer, different sensing information are transmitted to a corresponding layer through different feedback paths, the rhythm generator layer generates a fundamental rhythm signal according to the sensing information, and the pattern generator layer generates a motion mode control signal according to the sensing information; the application of the layered CPG in walking control of the humanoid robot is as follows, a center of gravity trajectory and a foot sole trajectory are planned in the working space of the robot; a double-leg time sequence signal loaded with the motion mode are output through the layered CPG, and a mass center track and a foot sole track are modulated; and inverse kinematics calculation is carried out on the modulated working space, and the adaptability of the working space is mapped to a joint space by utilizing a motion engine. Comparedwith the prior art, the layered CPG and application of the layered CPG in walking control of the humanoid robot has the advantages of being high in regulation and control instantaneity, low in engineering complexity and the like.
title: Layered CPG and application of layered CPG in walking control of humanoid robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control method based on point cloud clustering. Belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring at least two groups of continuous image information about a target object; obtaining target point cloud information corresponding to the image information, and performing clustering processing on the target point cloud information based on a target clustering algorithm to obtain first point cloud information corresponding to the target object; determining the state of the target object according to the image information; the state is static or dynamic; determining position information and direction information of the target object according to the first point cloud information and state corresponding to the target object; determining grabbing control information of the end effector according to the position information and the direction information of the target object; and controlling the end effector to grab the target object according to the grabbing control information. According to the method, the problem that the success rate of object grabbing of a current humanoid robot is low is solved.
title: Humanoid robot control method based on point cloud clustering

abstract: The invention relates to a bending self-locking pneumatic under-actuated robot finger device, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot hands. The device comprises a first finger section, a second finger section, an under-actuated joint, a motor, a transmission mechanism, a locking mechanism and a first spring piece. The transmission mechanism comprises a tendon rope and a winding reel. The locking mechanism comprises a ratchet wheel oscillating bar, a pawl, a rotating shaft and a second spring piece. The device achieves a self-adaptive under-actuated effect by adopting a pneumatic mode; one-way bending is achieved by adopting a ratchet wheel and the pawl, and an object is prevented from getting loose when an counteraction face is withdrawn or vibration interference occurs; stable grasping force applied to the object by the second finger section is generated through the deformation of the spring pieces, and thus form sealing and force sealing grasping is achieved; the restraint to the ratchet wheel by the pawl is relieved through the motor, and thus the object is released; the device is simple in structure, small in size, low in weight, low in manufacturing and maintaining cost and similar to the fingers of the human hands.
title: Bending self-locking pneumatic under-actuated robot finger device

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid dexterous hand with a variable-shape palm, which comprises the palm and three-five fingers connected with the palm, wherein the palm is constituted by a closed spherical five-connecting rod mechanism formed by sequentially connecting a palm arm connecting rod, a palm connecting rod I, a palm connecting rod II, a palm connecting rod III and a palm connecting rod IV; and each finger comprises a finger base, a finger base connecting rod, a finger intermediate connecting rod and a finger tail end, in each finger, the adjacent ends of the finger intermediate connecting rod and the finger tail end are sequentially connected by rotation through a rotating shaft, the finger base is fixedly connected on the connecting rod for constituting the palm, three rotatingshafts on each finger are connected with a rotary driving device, and the finger base connecting rod, the finger intermediate connecting rod and the finger tail end can rotate around the respective rotating shaft lines of the three rotating shafts under the drive of the rotary driving device. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises the palm in variable degrees of freedom and shapes; furthermore, the structure is simple and the volume is small.
title: Humanoid dexterous hand with variable-shape palm

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a bipedal robot where the miniaturization of an actuator, the improvement of rigidity and the acceleration of actions can be performed and the improvement of accuracy in positioning the toe sections of leg sections can be expected as compared to a conventional one.

SOLUTION: The leg section 4 is constructed by connecting two parallel mechanisms 28, 29 in series. The parallel mechanism 28 is constructed by a base 30, an intermediate member 31 and six motion sections 32 disposed therebetween. In addition, the parallel mechanism 29 is constructed by the intermediate member 31, a toe section 33 and the six motion sections 34 disposed therebetween. And, the leg section 4 is operated by the respective telescopic motions of the motion sections 32, 34.

title: ROBOT AND ROBOT OPERATION SYSTEM

abstract: The invention discloses a special double-degree-of-freedom flexible knee joint for a humanoid robot. The special double-degree-of-freedom flexible knee joint for the humanoid robot belongs to the field of humanoid robots, and is formed by a thighbone hemi-joint formed by a joint shell A, a flexible pad A and a back plate A, a tibiofibular hemi-joint formed by a joint shell B, a flexible pad B anda back plate B, an anterior cruciate ligament and a posterior cruciate ligament connected with the joint shell A and the joint shell B in an intercrossing way, a fibula spring with two ends being connected with a mechanical thighbone and a mechanical fibula, a tibia spring with two ends being connected with the mechanical thighbone and a mechanical tibia, and a flexible seal ring arranged betweenthe joint shell A and the joint shell B. The joint shell A and the joint shell B have the completely same structure and are symmetrically arranged; a spherical groove is formed in a part on which themiddle parts of the joint shell A and the joint shell B are close to each other; and a joint ball and a joint fluid are arranged in the spherical groove. The invention relates to the flexible knee joint which has no fixed hinge connection, has bending and twisting degrees of freedom, and is capable of producing tiny joint deformity.
title: Special double-degree-of-freedom flexible knee joint for humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged. The anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged comprises an upper half body frame, mechanical supporting arms, a seat integrated device, a lower half body frame, a half body lifting device, a wheelbase increasing device, a displacement power device and a control system; two groups of mechanical supporting arms are arranged; the two groups of mechanical supporting arms are rotationally connected to the left side and the right side of the upper half body frame; the seat integrated deviceis connected to the bottom of the upper half body frame; the bottom of the upper half body frame is connected with the lower half body frame through the half body lifting device; and the upper half body frame can lift under the action of the half body lifting device; the wheelbase increasing device is used for increasing the stability of the walking assisting robot accompanying the aged; the displacement power device realizes the movement of the walking assisting robot accompanying the aged; and the control system realizes automatic control of the walking assisting robot accompanying the aged.The anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged has the characteristics of high safety, walking assistance, flexible movement and the like, and solves the faced difficulty of the aged in daily life.
title: Anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of rotary actuators, in particular to a servo motor rotary actuator for a humanoid robot, which comprises a rotary actuator body, a mounting sleeve is fixedly connected to the bottom of the outer wall of the rotary actuator body, a base is inserted into the bottom of the outer wall of the mounting sleeve, and a clamping mechanism is movably mounted at the bottom of the inner cavity of the base. An ejection mechanism is movably installed in the position, below the clamping mechanism, of an inner cavity of the base. The rotary actuator body is fixed in the inner cavity of the mounting sleeve, the mounting sleeve is inserted into the inner cavity of the base, the insertion rod of the clamping mechanism is matched with the sliding block for clamping, and the first spring abuts against the sliding block and does not move, so that the mounting sleeve can be stably mounted in the base, and the rotary actuator body can be conveniently and stably mounted; the effect of improving installation convenience of the rotary actuator body is achieved, and the problem that installation is not convenient enough due to the fact that the rotary actuator body is fixedly installed through bolts is solved.
title: Servo motor rotation actuator for humanoid robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to an integral casting structure of a humanoid robot framework, the integral casting structure comprises a bearing mechanism, a potential energy storage and release mechanism, a bionic gait mechanism and a dynamic balance mechanism, the bearing mechanism comprises a main shell, a vertical beam, a cross beam and a bottom plate; when the bearing mechanism inclines forwards, the potential energy storage and release mechanism breaks and stores gravitational potential energy and converts the potential energy into initial mechanical power for starting walking; when the potential energy storage and release mechanism starts to release initial mechanical power, the bionic gait mechanism is automatically driven to work, and the two bottom plates are driven to simulate human gaits to walk alternately; when the bionic gait mechanism works and drives the two bottom plates to walk alternately, the dynamic balance mechanism is automatically driven to work, balance recovery is carried out on the whole structure during alternate walking, and the problem that the reliability of continuous walking is insufficient due to the fact that the bionic gait mechanism is high in energy consumption, poor in environmental adaptability and poor in balance performance is solved.
title: Integral casting structure of humanoid robot framework
