abstract: The full-drive dexterous hand comprises a palm mechanism, a thumb mechanism and a finger mechanism, the thumb mechanism comprises a metacarpal bone, a thumb near knuckle and a thumb far knuckle which are sequentially distributed, the metacarpal bone obtains bending and rolling freedom degrees through gear transmission, and the thumb near knuckle and the thumb far knuckle both obtain bending freedom degrees through motor direct drive; the finger mechanism comprises a finger near knuckle, a finger middle knuckle and a finger far knuckle which are sequentially distributed, the finger near knuckle obtains bending and side-sway freedom degrees through gear transmission, and the finger middle knuckle and the finger far knuckle obtain bending freedom degrees through motor direct drive. A full-drive humanoid manipulator framework is adopted, high-precision motion mapping is achieved through 20 independent controllable degrees of freedom, the bionic core is that the ball joint design is adopted, the composite motion capacity of human fingers is highly simulated, fine actions such as grabbing, kneading and rotating of a human hand can be accurately reproduced, and the flexibility degree of the human hand is deeply restored.
title: Full-drive dexterous hand

abstract: The invention discloses a facial expression quantitative representation method and system and a medium, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out the face detection, obtaining a faceimage, carrying out image preprocessing on the face image, extracting facial expression features, wherein the facial expression features comprise expression area shape features and expression area intensity features, carrying out facial expression classifier model training by adopting the facial expression features, and constructing a facial expression detection model comprising expression regionshape features and expression region strength features. According to the method, the characteristics of different facial expressions can be quantified, a data basis can be provided for similarity detection of the same facial expression, a data reference is provided for driving control of the facial expression motion unit of the humanoid robot, and the method can be widely applied to the technicalfield of facial expression representation.
title: Facial expression quantitative representation method and system and medium

abstract: The invention provides an integrated security patrol robot. According to the robot, multiple security technologies are integrated in a robot platform, by the aid of the multi-source information fusionand artificial intelligence technology, the security robot has man's wisdom, meanwhile, through wireless transmission, audios, videos and alarm information are transmitted to the far end, and the security efficiency is improved. The robot comprises a humanoid robot; the humanoid robot comprises a head, a body, arms and a chassis; the body is supported at the upper part of the chassis; the head issupported at the upper part of the body; the arms are arranged on the two sides of the body; the head comprises a head body, eyes, a nose, a mouth and ears; the eyes include a binocular depth cameraand an infrared thermal imager; the nose comprises a sensor; the mouth is provided with a loudspeaker module; the ears include a group of sound detectors; and a data forwarding module is arranged inside the back side of the head body.
title: Integrated security patrol robot

abstract: The disclosed visual RRC-humanoid robot is a computer-based system that has been programmed to reach human-like levels of visualization Artificial Intelligence (AI). Behavioral-programming techniques are used to reach human-like levels of identification AI, recognition AI, visualization AI, and comprehension AI. The system is programmed to identify, recognize, visualize and comprehend the full array of sizes, distances, shapes, and colors of objects recorded in the FOV of the system. The following innovative features have been incorporated into the system: (i) incorporation of the RRC, (ii) incorporation of the Relational Correlation Sequencer (RCS): A proprietary RRC-module, (iii) a paradigm shift in the analytical-programming methodology employed in computer vision systems, (iv) incorporation of a central hub of intelligence, (v) design of a “self knowledge” capability and Internalization of all data, and (vi) design of an interface circuit compatible with human-like levels of visualization-AI.
title: Intelligent visual humanoid robot and computer vision system programmed to perform visual artificial intelligence processes

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The driving mechanism is arranged on the mounting seat and comprises a first driving part and a second driving part; the inward turning and side swinging mechanism is movably arranged on the mounting seat; the knuckle module is connected to the side, away from the mounting base, of the inward turning and side swinging mechanism; the inward bending mechanism is arranged in the knuckle module and used for driving the knuckle module to bend inwards; the first driving part is used for driving the inward turning and lateral swinging mechanism, so that the knuckle module connected with the inward turning and lateral swinging mechanism performs coupling motion of lateral swinging and inward turning; the second driving piece is used for driving the inward turning side swing mechanism so that the knuckle module can conduct inward turning motion. Through decoupling transmission of the second driving piece and the first driving piece, lateral swinging of the thumb is achieved, and the thumb is allowed to be flexibly adjusted in a complex three-dimensional space. The thumb of the dexterous hand can achieve three-degree-of-freedom movement of inward turning, side swinging and bending, and the grabbing accuracy of the dexterous hand is improved.
title: Dexterous hand thumb, dexterous hand and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot four-limb trunk driver and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of motor control, the drivers are installed at joints of four-limb trunks or replace a skeleton of a robot, and each driver comprises a motor, a first tooth column, a second tooth column, a first inner gear ring and a second inner gear ring; a rotor of the motor is internally connected with a hollow motor shaft; the first inner gear ring and the second inner gear ring are arranged in the motor shaft; the first tooth column and the second tooth column are engaged with the first inner gear ring and the second inner gear ring correspondingly. The driver can serve as a human-shaped four-limb-like skeleton supporting structure and can also be combined to form a bionic muscle group; the functions of mechanical four-limb bionic muscle contraction and trunk supporting can be achieved; the structure is compact, response speed is high, efficiency is high, heat is little, and heat dissipation is convenient; in the aspect of control, a motor control method for adaptively setting PID controller parameters based on a BP neural network is adopted, and it can be ensured that high-precision torque is output in real time under different load conditions.
title: Driver of humanoid robot four-limb trunk and control method thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot decision planning. The invention provides a mobile robot strategy simulation method based on a decision Transform. The method comprises the steps that a mobile robot decision problem is modeled into a sequence problem, a data set of a mobile robot is played back in simulation, and then a humanoid control strategy simulating a human control strategy and having secondary smoothing is designed based on the data set existing in the field, a decision Transform and a trajectory optimization method. According to the embodiment of the invention, the open-loop data set is migrated to simulation to be played, so that a data interface can be conveniently subjected to modal and type change; the output rough plan is subjected to trajectory optimization secondary processing, so that a smooth trajectory is generated in deployment, and the motion unsmoothness of a mobile robot strategy is reduced; diversified strategies contained in a data set can be fully learned by adopting a decision Transform, and a required high-level strategy is induced through an expected reward.
title: Mobile robot strategy simulation method based on decision Transform

abstract: The invention relates to a hospital medical guiding humanoid robot and a control method thereof. The hospital medical guiding humanoid robot comprises a voice system, a vision system, a mobile system,a limb system and a monitor system. The hospital medical guiding humanoid robot realizes direct man-machine interaction through a voice control mode, enables information interaction to be timely andquick, improves information transmission efficiency, and is good in user experience. By using the hospital medical guiding humanoid robot, realization of medical guiding automation is facilitated, medical efficiency is improved, labor intensity of staff is reduced, meanwhile awkwardness caused by consulting medical guiding nurses for diseases related to patient privacy is avoided, reduction of lowquality repeated labor and work intensity is facilitated, and reduction of disease infection risk in working of the medical guiding nurses in hospital is facilitated.
title: Hospital medical guiding humanoid robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-space fusion man-machine skill migration and parameter compensation method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a multi-space skill parameter through human demonstration, decomposing a stiffness multi-space matrix into a feature value matrix and a feature vector matrix, converting a Riemannian space matrix into a quaternion, and representing the quaternion in an axial angle form; a multi-space fusion dynamic system, a regular system module and a linear weighted regression updating module are used for achieving skill parameter migration, the skill parameters are migrated to a robot humanoid variable impedance controller, and the robot reproduction effect obtained by comparing the corresponding skill parameters with the effect demonstrated by a demonstrator under the skill parameters. And importing the difference value under multiple demonstrations and the actual operation effect of the robot into a probability model for training, establishing a rule model between the actual value and the difference value, and performing skill parameter compensation according to the difference between predicted values obtained by robot end feedback and rule model regression in an actual scene. According to the invention, multi-space man-machine skill transmission can be realized, and an accurate reproduction effect is ensured.
title: Multi-space fusion man-machine skill migration and parameter compensation method and system

abstract: The embodiments of the invention provide a combined centroid state acquisition method and device, a humanoid robot and a readable storage medium. The combined centroid state comprises the speed of a combined centroid. The combined centroid state acquisition method comprises the following steps that the motion state of each real joint of the humanoid robot and the motion state of a floating base are acquired, wherein the floating base is equivalent to a plurality of virtual joints which are connected in sequence, the rotating shaft position, the mass center position and the rotating matrix of a single connecting rod in a world coordinate system are sequentially calculated based on a chain multiplication according to the positions of the corresponding joints, and then a Jacobian matrix of the mass center of the single connecting rod is solved; a Jacobian matrix of a combined mass center are calculated according to the Jacobian matrix of each connecting rod mass center and the combined mass; and the speed of the combined centroid is calculated according to the Jacobian matrix of the combined centroid and the like. According to the method, based on the motion state of the real joint and the motion state of the floating base, the Jacobian matrix and the derivative thereof are solved in a recursion mode, the calculation error rate can be reduced, and then great convenience is brought to related motion control of the robot.
title: Combined centroid state acquisition method and device, humanoid robot and readable storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait control method and system based on simulation and inverse reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the walking data of a human body or a simulation robot to construct a high-quality training data set, and calculating the similarity between the robot and expert data through a graph convolution structure; a multi-dimensional linear reward function is designed based on a task target, four types of indexes including stability, gait periodicity, trajectory similarity and energy efficiency are integrated, and multi-target optimization is achieved through weight distribution. A neural network is adopted to construct a strategy model, training is performed in combination with a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, and a strategy ratio cutting technology is utilized to constrain an update amplitude so as to improve learning stability. And meanwhile, a maximum entropy principle is introduced to dynamically update a reward function, so that the adaptability to expert strategies is enhanced. Finally, simulation verification is conducted through a MuJoCo physical engine, and visual analysis and performance evaluation of the highly-simulated human gait are achieved. According to the method, the problem that the robot gait self-adaptability and robustness are insufficient in a complex dynamic environment is solved.
title: Humanoid robot gait control method and system based on imitation and inverse reinforcement learning

abstract: A flexible part and slider type parallel robot finger device integrating coupling and under-actuation belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot hands. The device comprises a base, a near joint bearing, a first finger segment, a far joint bearing, a second finger segment, a motor, two flexible parts and spring parts. The device realizes the transmission effect of close integration of coupling transmission and under-actuated transmission, can couple humanoid grabbing and has the function of under-actuated adaptation. The whole finger has concise structure and low manufacturing cost. Coupling transmission and under-actuated transmission are organically integrated. Natural decoupling is realized by flexible contact of the slider, which does not consume motor power and is high in energyutilization rate. The device has appearance similar to that of the human finger, can be used as one finger or a part of the fingers of the robot hand and can combine a plurality of fingers to form the robot hand to achieve the excellent effects of high degree of freedom of joints and high adaptability of the humanoid robot hand.
title: Flexible part and slider type parallel coupled under-actuation robot finger device

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot control, and discloses a reinforcement learning motion control method and system for lower limbs of a linear joint humanoid robot, and the control method comprises the steps: structurally separating the physical coupling constraint of a linear motor and a rotary joint in a training environment; a reinforcement learning method is adopted, an actor-commentator method and privilege observation variables are supplemented, and multiple agents are trained in parallel; a trained strategy is deployed to a real machine, input and output of the strategy obtained through training are rotating joint information, actual robot control and collected data are linear joint motor side information, and the difference between simulation and reality can be overcome through the mapping relation of force, position and speed. Compared with a traditional position control method, the force control characteristic of the linear joint is used, and the higher adaptability is achieved; and meanwhile, a reinforcement learning method is used for training the linear joint humanoid robot, accurate modeling is not needed, and a global and long-term motility simulation algorithm stage and a deployment algorithm stage can be achieved.
title: Reinforced learning motion control method and system for lower limbs of linear joint humanoid robot

abstract: A bipedal robot having five degree of freedom leg assemblies is disclosed. The example leg assemblies each have a hip joint; a thigh link assembly rotatably coupled to the hip joint; and a knee joint coupled to the thigh link assembly. A calf link assembly is rotatably coupled to the knee joint. An ankle joint is coupled to the calf link assembly. A set of actuators is configured to control movement of the leg assembly. At least some of the actuators are positioned near the hip joint to concentrate mass of the leg assembly proximate to the hip joint. A transmission system is configured to transmit force from at least one of the actuators to either the knee joint or the ankle joint of the leg assembly.
title: A BIPEDAL ROBOT FOR DYNAMIC AND ROBUST LOCATION IN DIVERSE ENVIRONMENTS

abstract: The present invention relates to a PC-based module-type humanoid robot. A PC-based module-type humanoid robot platform includes: a main control device using one general PC or a plurality of general PCs for a plurality of users as a main control device; and a plurality of robot modules controlled on a bus by the main control device having an allocated original ID according to a communication protocol. Therefore, according to the present invention, since a PC operates as the main control device, the PC-based module-type humanoid robot platform, in which a humanoid robot can autonomously make determinations and perform actions according to the situation and surroundings thereof without a user operating a controller, is provided.
title: PC-BASED MODULE-TYPE HUMANOID ROBOT PLATFORM

abstract: Disclosed are robotic systems, methods, bipedal robot devices, and computer-readable mediums. For example, a robotic system may include a robotic body, a robotic hip connected to the robotic body, and a ball screw connected to the robotic hip. Further, the robotic system may include a robotic leg connected to the robotic hip parallel to the ball screw. Yet further, the robotic hip includes a motor that is linearly movable to one or more positions along the ball screw between one end of the robotic leg and an opposite end of the robotic leg.
title: Robotic leg parallel to a ball screw

abstract: The invention discloses an electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and comprises a palm and three fingers, namely a thumb, an index finger and a self-adaptive flexible finger; the thumb and the index finger are of three-degree-of-freedom structures and can be bent; the finger root part of the self-adaptive flexible finger is driven to rotate through the driving unit so as to be matched with the thumb and the index finger to grab an object, and the self-adaptive flexible finger can adapt to the shape of the object. The electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand adopts less active degrees of freedom, and more active degrees of freedom are distributed to the index finger and the thumb, so that the problem that the cost and the dexterous operation capability are difficult to balance due to the selection and distribution of degrees of freedom of the existing humanoid dexterous hand is solved.
title: Electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand

abstract: A method for performing telexistence, which may include receiving, by a processor, a request to control a humanoid from a remote user; determining, by the processor, acceptance of the request by a host; for the request being determined as accepted, verifying, by the processor, receipt of a set of initiating signals; for the set of initiating signals being received: receiving a humanoid mapping method chosen by the remote user, and controlling the humanoid based on the humanoid mapping method determined by the remote user; and for the set of initiating signals not being received, terminating, by the processor, the request to control the humanoid.
title: METHODOLOGY FOR SAFE REMOTE HUMANOID TAKEOVER FOR MULTI-USER TELEXISTENCE WITH MINIMAL HARDWARE USER REQUIREMENTS

abstract: PURPOSE: An upper platform of a humanoid robot, capable of the recognition of a visual sensor loaded in a head unit, is provided to efficiently express the similar motion as the motion of a human upper body. CONSTITUTION: An upper platform of a humanoid robot comprises an upper body unit(120), a head unit(110) and a lower body unit(130). The head unit is connected to the top of the upper body unit and is horizontally rotated in the upper body unit. The head unit is perpendicularly rotated based on the unit connected to the upper body unit. The head unit comprises a visual sensor(112).
title: UPPER PLATFORM OF HUMANOID ROBOT

abstract: The present invention provides a biped (two-footed) walking humanoid robot easily capable of such full body movement as, for example, protective action when tumbling down, arising action and rolling action. The body part (11) is configured with a waist part (11b) below, a breast part (11a) attached biaxially movably to said waist part, and a drive means (11d, 11e) to move said breast part biaxially, and a controller (50) makes full body movement performed by drive controlling each drive means in mutual coordination. A walk controller (50) drive controls each drive means in mutual coordination, whereby moving the breast part (11a) biaxially with respect to the waist part (11b), namely moving longitudinally or rotating horizontally, and thus makes it possible to move totally the upper part configured with the breast part and arm parts with respect to the lower part configured with the waist part (11b) and leg parts (12) by so-called stoop forward and twisting of a waist. Therefore, protective action when tumbling down, arising action, and rolling action are made possible. Also in case that full body movement is to be performed with the walk controller driving arm parts (13) and the breast part (11a) and utilizing the weight and the moment of inertia of these arm and a breast parts, a walk controller not only drives each part by each drive means, but also moves or rotates arm and a breast parts with respect to the waist part (11b), utilizes the weight and the moment of inertia of arm and a breast part with respect to the waist part, and thus makes it possible, for example, to jump. Further, balancing motion can be performed by utilizing such weight and moment of inertia of arm and breast parts, and by conducting three dimensional compensation of the motion utilizing the upper body. <IMAGE>
title: BIPEDAL HUMANOID

abstract: The invention discloses a motion posture learning method and device of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring posture information and environment information of a real human in a preset time period; determining a motion mode of the humanoid robot according to the attitude information and the environment information; obtaining at least one motion posture evaluation strategy corresponding to the motion mode; calculating the attitude information according to the motion attitude evaluation strategy to obtain at least one motion attitude evaluation value; matching the motion mode with a motion posture strategy library to obtain a matching evaluation value; performing weighted calculation according to the motion attitude evaluation value and the matching evaluation value to obtain a comprehensive motion attitude evaluation value, and calculating a loss function value by combining the real human motion space attitude measurement value and the comprehensive motion attitude evaluation value; and performing deep learning model training based on the loss function value. The humanoid robot can autonomously learn a human motion posture control strategy, and the comprehensive performance and adaptability of the humanoid robot are improved.
title: Motion posture learning method and device of humanoid robot

abstract: The invention relates to a virtual-real fusion driven humanoid robot walking training method, which comprises the following steps: S1, building a robot walking training scene, and collecting data when a robot walks; s2, constructing a data space containing a robot joint state and a target position according to data collected by a sensor in a physical world; s3, constructing a preliminary observation space according to the data of the physical space, and constructing an observation space after virtual-real fusion in combination with the sensor data of the simulation space; s4, on the basis of the observation space after virtual-real fusion, a reward function is constructed, and a robot walking strategy is corrected; and S5, deploying the corrected robot walking strategy on a real robot to carry out real ground walking adaptation, and feeding back information to a simulation space to carry out control strategy optimization. Compared with the prior art, the walking stability and safety of the humanoid robot are improved in the mode that physical data are fed back to the simulation environment observation space adjustment strategy.
title: Virtual-real fusion driven humanoid robot walking training method

abstract: A robot acoustic device, particularly an acoustic device in a humanoid robot or animal-type robot, which is provided with a noise generating source such as a drive mechanism in, for example, a humanoid robot (10), and which comprises a sound-proof enclosure (14) covering at least the head (13) of the robot, a pair of external microphones (16, 16a, 16b) provided on the outer side of the enclosure and at opposite ears' positions, for mainly collecting external sounds, a pair of internal microphones (17, 17A, 17B) provided on the inner side of the enclosure, for mainly collecting noises from internal noise generating sources, and a processing circuit (18) for canceling noise signals from the internal noise generating sources out of acoustic signals from the external microphones (16, 16a, 16b), whereby the robot acoustic device can collect sounds from external targets without being influenced by noises generated inside the robot such as in a drive mechanism to conduct an active perception.
title: ROBOT ACOUSTIC DEVICE

abstract: The invention provides a method for generating a smooth curve of the center of mass of a humanoid robot. The generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring the accelerated speed of the humanoid robot along with the time change in the walking process; obtaining first position data of the humanoid robot through integral calculation according to the acceleration; discretizing the first position data to obtain second position data corresponding to a plurality of time points at equal intervals; defining a basic spline primary function, and obtaining a high-order basic spline primary function through recursive calculation; fitting according to the high-order basic spline primary function and the second position data to obtain a basic spline function curve; according to the curve derivative of the basic spline function curve, a second spline coefficient is obtained, the second spline coefficient is substituted into the basic spline curve, the final mass center track is obtained, it is guaranteed that the mass center track of the humanoid robot in the walking process is smooth and continuous, the impact force of the robot in the double-foot switching process is reduced, and the walking efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved. And the movement stability and reliability are improved.
title: Humanoid robot mass center smooth curve generation method, storage medium and generator

abstract: The invention provides a lower limb assembly and a humanoid robot, the lower limb assembly comprises a machine body, a first turnover side-sway motor, a second turnover side-sway motor, a thigh pitching motor, a thigh connecting piece and a shank pitching motor, and the first turnover side-sway motor is fixedly connected with the machine body; the second turnover side-sway motor is rotatably connected with the first turnover side-sway motor; the thigh pitching motor is rotatably connected with the second turnover side-sway motor; the thigh connecting piece is fixedly connected with the thigh pitching motor, an avoiding part is arranged on the thigh connecting piece, and the avoiding part is used for preventing the thigh connecting piece from interfering with the second turnover side-sway motor; and the shank pitching motor is fixedly connected with the thigh connecting piece. The maneuverability of the robot is improved, and the motion space of the legs of the robot is increased.
title: Lower limb assembly and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a low-frequency series-connection humanoid four-degrees-of-freedom mechanical foot and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The low-frequency series-connection humanoid four-degrees-of-freedom mechanical foot comprises a toe, a metatarsal bone rod, a tarsal bone rod, a toe shaft connecting the metatarsal bone rod with the toe, a tarsal bone shaft connecting the tarsal bone rod with the metatarsal bone rod, an ankle joint shaft A connecting the metatarsal bone rod with a mechanical shank, an ankle joint shaft B, two bolts, a flange plate, a toe motor arranged on the metatarsal bone rod, a toe small gear arranged on an output shaft of the toe motor, a toe large gear in meshing transmission with the toe small gear, a tarsal bone motor arranged at one end of the tarsal bone rod, a tarsal bone small gear arranged on an output shaft of the tarsal bone motor, a tarsal bone large gear, an ankle motor A, an ankle motor B, an ankle small gear and an ankle large gear. The low-frequency series-connection humanoid four-degrees-of-freedom mechanical foot is a series-connection mode humanoid robot foot which is reasonable in structure and more lifelike in motion performance and has four degrees of freedom and low-frequency performance.
title: Low-frequency series-connection humanoid four-degrees-of-freedom mechanical foot

abstract: The invention provides a visual-sense-based rapid working whole-body planning and control method of a humanoid robot. After a target position is obtained based on visual information, whether the target is located in a motion range is determined to determine whether stepping is carried out and how to carry out stepping; and then a moving planning method of arm planning is implemented. According to the invention, for the rapid moving task of the robot, dynamic stable control of a soft landing controller and a swing leg vibration elimination controller is carried out and then rapid working of the robot is realized.
title: Visual-sense-based rapid working whole-body planning and control method of humanoid robot

abstract: A method and apparatus to generate a humanlike motion of a humanoid robot which is capable of performing a humanlike breathing motion. For example, the method includes calculating target rotational angles of respective rotary joints to perform a basic motion according to a user command, calculating rotational angles of respective rotary joints to perform a breathing motion, and generating the breathing motion by adding up the target rotational angles of the respective rotary joints to perform the basic motion and the rotational angles to perform the breathing motion and providing the angles obtained thereby to respective rotary joints constituting joint units related to the breathing motion, thus providing intimacy and aesthetic stability to users.
title: Method to generate humanlike motion of humanoid robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot and a leg structure thereof. The leg structure comprises a shank limb, and the first end of the shank limb is used for being connected with the thigh of the biped robot; a sole part; the driving assembly is fixedly mounted on the shank limb; the first output rotating shaft of the driving assembly is in driving connection with the first end of the first shank connecting rod, and the second end of the first shank connecting rod is rotationally connected with the sole part; the first shank connecting rod and the second shank connecting rod are arranged in parallel, a second output rotating shaft of the driving assembly is in driving connection with the first end of the second shank connecting rod, and the second end of the second shank connecting rod is rotationally connected with the sole part. By applying the technical scheme, the problems that the ankle joint is relatively bloated, the leg inertia is relatively large and the motion performance of the robot is influenced due to the fact that the crus mechanism of the current humanoid robot is mostly designed by adopting a serial mechanism are solved.
title: Biped robot and leg structure thereof

abstract: A system may include two character figurines, each of which may be an action figure. Each character figurine may have a body with a humanoid shape. The character figurines may include a first character figurine with a wireless transmitter that transmits a wireless signal, and a second character figurine with a wireless receiver that receives the wireless signal. The second character figurine may have an action system that causes the second character figurine to undertake a visually perceptible action when the wireless signal is received. The action system may include a motor, and the visually perceptible action may include motion of the second character figurine, driven by the motor, that approximates receipt of a wound inflicted by the first character figurine.
title: WIRELESSLY CONTROLLED ACTION FIGURES

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of welding, and provides a welding program generation method of a humanoid robot and related equipment.The welding program generation method of the humanoid robot comprises the steps that a first workpiece image of a to-be-welded workpiece is obtained, and segmentation masks of the to-be-welded workpiece and a welding seam are determined based on the first workpiece image; determining three-dimensional contour points of the welding seam according to the three-dimensional point cloud of the workpiece to be welded and the segmentation mask; welding task information is obtained, and welding steps are inferred according to the welding task information and the three-dimensional contour points; according to the welding steps, the segmentation masks, the three-dimensional contour points and the initial operation skill of the humanoid robot, welding process parameters are determined and written into an initial welding program; and the initial welding program is tested in the simulation environment corresponding to the to-be-welded workpiece, and the target welding program of the humanoid robot is obtained. Through the technical scheme provided by the invention, safe and automatic generation of the humanoid robot welding program is realized.
title: Welding program generation method of humanoid robot and related equipment

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arm control, in particular to an unmanned deinsectization humanoid robot based on machine intelligence, which comprises a robot camera, a robot head, a robot shell and robot arms. According to the invention, pest data are collected through the camera and the wind power sensor, the collected pest data are input into the control system, the control system analyzes the pest data, and catch-up and deinsectization tasks are carried out on pests according to an analysis result. By chasing and killing the pests, the pest killing efficiency of the robot on the pests in the surrounding environment is improved, meanwhile, the whole task process is autonomously controlled by the robot, and the purpose of unmanned robot intelligent pest killing is achieved.
title: Unmanned deinsectization humanoid robot based on machine intelligence

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic viscoelasticity control method of a robot joint. A robot suffers from unknown disturbance, joint angle deviation and joint angular velocity deviation between the current posture of the robot and the reference posture are acquired according to a posture sensor and joint coded disk data, and virtual moment which the robot suffers from is calculated according to a viscoelasticity model, so that expected joint angle track generated by the virtual moment is acquired and the robot is controlled by the track. By the bionic viscoelasticity control method of the robot joint, the flexibility of the robot joint can be improved, and the stability of the robot is maintained while joint movement maintains flexibility under the unknown additional disturbance. By the method, the operability of the robot can be enhanced and the application occasions of the humanoid robot are increased.
title: Bionic viscoelasticity control method of robot joint

abstract: The invention discloses a high-imitation humanoid robot and an internal system thereof. The high-imitation humanoid robot comprises a body shell and an internal system; the body shell is composed of 20 joint steering engines such as a head part, upper limbs and lower limbs; the internal system is provided with an AllInOne main control board and a development board; the AllInOne main control boardis connected with a posture module, a power module and a steering engine module, and the steering engine module is connected with the mechanical part of the robot; the development board is connected with a Bluetooth module, a game handle module, a gesture module, an LCD module, a touch screen module, a voice recognition module, a remote control module, an image recognition module, a depth scanningmodule, a laser radar module and an ultrasonic module; and the high-imitation humanoid robot is characterized in that the AllInOne main control board is connected with the development board, and theback of the body shell can be stacked into a plurality of development boards after being disassembled. The high-imitation humanoid robot provides the autonomous high-performance stable AllInOne main control board, superimposes various development boards such as arduino, liunx, android and the like, has a stable human-shaped control foundation, and has ultra-high usability, expansibility and compatibility.
title: High-imitation humanoid robot and internal system thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the field of automatic vending devices, in particular to a robot intelligent retail kiosk. The robot intelligent retail kiosk comprises a retail kiosk body, a rotating mechanism, mechanical arm lifting mechanisms, a conveying mechanism, a shopping display screen and at least one mechanical arm; the rotating mechanism is arranged in the retail kiosk body and is provided with a mounting stand column; the mechanical arm lifting mechanisms are installed on the mounting stand column, the mechanical arms are installed on the corresponding mechanical arm lifting mechanisms, acommodity outlet and a shopping display screen are arranged on the front side of the retail kiosk body, a material frame is arranged on the inner side wall of the retail kiosk body, and the conveyingmechanism is arranged in the retail kiosk body; and the commodities are taken down by the mechanical arms, then placed on the conveying mechanism and conveyed to the commodity outlet in the front side of the retail kiosk body through the conveying mechanism. According to the robot intelligent retail kiosk, the retail process is completed through automatic operation of a humanoid robot, 24-hour all-weather intelligent operation can be achieved, and a brand-new production and management mode is provided for the retail industry.
title: Robot intelligent retail kiosk

abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted robot anthropomorphic interaction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring facial data of a main driver, and determining the central position of the face of the main driver; determining a rotation control point, and determining the rotation control point according to the mapping relation between the image position and the rotation device control range; connecting with a user mobile phone to obtain a user schedule; and playing greeting words and displaying greeting expressions and schedules. According to the vehicle-mounted robot anthropomorphic interaction method and system disclosed by the invention, the optimal position adjustment of image acquisition is realized through the robot camera, the optimal image acquisition under a simple installation condition is realized, and thus greeting greeting and schedule display are realized; and the intelligent interaction capability of the in-vehicle welcome mode is improved.
title: Vehicle-mounted robot anthropomorphic interaction method and system

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and system, the system comprises a sensor module, a sensing module, a state representation module, a decision module, a motion control module, an actuator module and a feedback module, and the method comprises the following steps: step 1, data acquisition; step 2, environment perception; step 3, state representation; step 4, action selection; step 5, motion control; step 6, performing feedback and adjustment; according to the method, the hybrid model combining the ViT and the CNN is adopted for environment perception, the environment perception precision is improved, the error recognition rate is reduced, motion planning is carried out through reinforcement learning, the robot can autonomously learn the optimal motion strategy, decision making and adjustment can be autonomously carried out according to the environment change and the task target, and the robot experience is improved. The problem that a traditional motion planning algorithm is high in calculation complexity is solved, the robot motion planning efficiency, the autonomous decision-making ability and the environment adaptability are improved, and safe, efficient and autonomous motion of the humanoid robot in a complex dynamic environment is achieved.
title: Humanoid robot control method and system

abstract: The invention discloses a doraemon interaction system, which is characterized by comprising a timing trigger module, a receiving module and a time module. The timing trigger module is used for sendinggreeting voice at regular time in a specific time period and enabling the doraemon interaction system to be in a standby state in other time periods; the receiving module is used for receiving voiceor touch signals; if the voice signal and the touch signal are received at the same time, judging is conducted by using the voice signal; the judgment of the voice signal is to detect whether a keyword for triggering the signal exists or not, if not, entering an animal mode, and if yes, entering a keyword trigger mode, namely, an anthropomorphic mode; if the touch signal exists, entering an animalmode; and the time module is used for setting time limit for the completion of a request task, indicating that the request task is successful if the request task is replied within the specified time,and otherwise, indicating that the request task fails. The timing trigger module reminds people of the existence of a doraemon, the doraemon in an animal mode and an anthropomorphic mode is helpful for people to adjust psychological health, the contradiction caused by pet raising is reduced, and communication and interaction can be carried out.
title: Doraemon interaction system

abstract: The invention discloses an assembly type humanoid robot applying a helical gear steering engine, and belongs to the field of robot equipment. The robot comprises a chest, a neck assembled on the chest, a waist movably connected on the lower part of the chest, arms, legs, and a control circuit board. Two sides of the chest and two sides of the waist are respectively provided with steering engine modules X. The steering engine modules X are connected with joint steering engine boxes and can drive the joint steering engine boxes to rotate along front and back directions. The joint steering engine box is internally provided with a steering engine module Y which drives the arm and the leg to rotate along left and right directions. Middle joints of the arms and the legs are provided with helical gear steering engines which drive the joints to bend. The lower end of the arm is provided with a rotatable wrist. The lower end of the leg is provided with a foot which can rotate along front and back directions. The control circuit board is electrically connected with the steering engine modules X, a driving motor, the steering engine module Y, and the helical gear steering engines. The assembly type humanoid robot solves problems that joint movement fidelity of an existing robot is relatively low, and robot homogenization is serious.
title: Assembly type humanoid robot applying helical gear steering engine

abstract: The invention discloses a robot and a robot control method, and belongs to the technical field of robot equipment. An existing robot cannot perform complex dancing actions and is simple in function and poor in performance. The robot comprises a robot body and a rotary performance piece. The robot body is provided with arms used for assembling rotary performance pieces and a throwing motor used for throwing performance props. The rotating performance piece is assembled at the tail end of the arm, and the throwing motor can provide throwing power and provide kinetic energy for the performance prop to fly outwards, so that the robot at least can perform dancing actions such as rotation and throwing, the actions are rich, the operation demonstration effect is good, the performance performance is good, innovativeness is high, the posture is attractive, the anthropomorphic effect is good, the function is powerful, and the ornamental value is high. The robot can be popularized and applied conveniently, the blank of the robot performance technology is filled, and the robot can be used for large-scale humanoid robot dancing performance, especially for folk dance performance.
title: Robot and robot control method

abstract: The invention concerns a humanoid robot, said robot being capable of holding a dialogue with at least one user, said dialogue using two speech recognition modes, one open and the other closed, the closed mode being defined by a concept characterising a sequence of dialogue. The dialogue can also be influenced by events that are neither speech nor a text. The robot of the invention is capable of executing behaviour and generating expressions and emotions. Relative to the robots of the prior art, the invention provides the advantage of considerably reducing the programming time and latency of execution of the sequences of dialogue, which provides a fluency and a nature close to human dialogues.
title: ROBOT CAPABLE OF INCORPORATING NATURAL DIALOGUES WITH A USER INTO THE BEHAVIOUR OF SAME, AND METHODS OF PROGRAMMING AND USING SAID ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses an AI virtual robot state dynamic setting system which comprises an instruction receiving module, an instruction analysis module, an instruction response module and a state change feedback module. And the instruction receiving module is located at a client terminal of the AI virtual robot and is used for receiving instruction information sent by a user and transmitting theinstruction information to the instruction analysis module. According to the invention, a keyword recognition model is used for automatically recognizing the instruction intention of the effective keyword extracted from the voice instruction of the user to obtain the target state identifier matched with the instruction intention, and the AI virtual robot controls the terminal equipment to convertfrom the current state to the target state according to the target state identifier. A fixed instruction preset execution mode is replaced, the flexibility of user instruction intention recognition isimproved, and a more anthropomorphic service is provided for a user.
title: AI virtual robot state dynamic setting system

abstract: A humanoid appearing robot adapted for movement relative to a ground support surface includes a removable passenger carrying platform attached to a base portion thereof. The platform serves to both provide the robot with a passenger carrying capability that enhances the entertainment value of the robot and to enhance the stability of the robot during movement relative to a ground surface. The platform may be removed when the passenger carrying capability is not desired or when it is necessary to maneuver the robot in confined spaced, e.g., the interior of a passenger carrying aircraft. Arm-like members are articulatably connected to a torso portion of the robot and include articulatable hand-like members for grasping and releasing small objects. The arm-like members are articulatable to a forwardly extended position to provide lateral support for a passenger on the platform. An articulatable head-like module is mounted on the torso portion to complement the robot's humanoid form.
title: Remote control robot with person supporting platform

abstract: The invention relates to an emotion accompanying robot system based on multi-dimensional perception and an interaction method, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots. The system comprises a sensing module which captures micro-expression, voice, body temperature, touch and other multi-source data through a biological radar array, multispectral imaging and a touch sensing fabric; the decision-making module quantifies the emotion intensity by using an emotion state calculation engine, constructs a user personalized emotion file in combination with the dynamic knowledge graph, and generates a dynamic emotion graph; and the execution module realizes anthropomorphic emotion expression through bionic face driving, joint compliance control and thermal feedback. The interaction method comprises the steps of data capture, emotion file construction, dynamic graph generation, interactive execution and feedback adjustment, definition of an emotion intensity quantification formula, a graph edge weight model and the like. According to the method, physiological signals, environment situations and bionic expression are fused, multi-modal precise emotion perception and safe interaction are achieved, man-machine naturalness is improved, the method is suitable for elderly accompanying, psychological counseling and other scenes, and the emotion accompanying effect is enhanced.
title: Emotion accompanying robot system based on multi-dimensional perception and interaction method

abstract: The invention provides an anthropomorphic finger mechanism. The anthropomorphic finger mechanism comprises a finger base, at least one near-end knuckle, at least one middle knuckle, a far-end knuckle, a driver, a driving cable and a tension belt, wherein the at least one near-end knuckle is located on the outer side of the finger base; the at least one middle knuckle is located on the outer side of the near-end knuckle; the far-end knuckle is located on the outer side of the middle knuckle; the driver is located on the inner side of the finger base; one end of the driving cable is connected with the driver, and the other end of the driving cable sequentially penetrates through the finger base, the near-end knuckle and the middle knuckle and then is connected with the far-end knuckle; and one end of the tension belt is connected with the finger base, and the other end of the tension belt is connected with the far-end knuckle. According to the anthropomorphic finger mechanism, the finger base, the near-end knuckle, the middle knuckle and the far-end knuckle which are sequentially hinged are all arranged to be of an integrated structure, and the number of parts is decreased; and meanwhile, the tension belt and the driving cable which are of the integrated structure are combined, the grabbing control process of the anthropomorphic finger mechanism is simplified, the structure of the anthropomorphic finger mechanism can be simplified easily, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.
title: Anthropomorphic finger mechanism

abstract: The invention relates to a thumb mechanism of an artificial hand, in particular to a thumb mechanism of a humanoid hand and aims to solve the problem that a thumb of each of most existing artificial hand moves for grasp in one direction only. Rotation of a thumb of the thumb mechanism is achieved by worm-gear transmission. A function of bending for grasp is achieved for the thumb by worm-gear transmission and bevel gear transmission. A first knuckle and a second knuckle of the thumb are under-actuated by a plane four-bar mechanism. The thumb mechanism has the advantages that the thumb can rotate, bend for grasp and spatially move in a complex way during grasp motion of the thumb, the function of omnidirectional grasp can be achieved for the thumb, and various motion functions of a thumb of a human hand are achieved for the thumb of the thumb mechanism; a transmission mechanism of the thumb is in worm-gear transmission and has the self-locking function, and grasp torque of the thumb can be maintained after power failure of a motor; and the thumb mechanism is simple in structure, flexible to move, convenient to control, light in weight, small in size and large in thumb grasp strength.
title: Thumb mechanism of artificial hand

abstract: A system for installing a solar panel may include a first end-of-arm assembly tool coupled to a first robotic arm and part of a first assembly robot and a second end-of-arm assembly tool coupled to a second robotic arm and part of a second assembly robot. The first and the second end-of-arm assembly tools have different tooling and perform different functions to assembly solar panels to support structure. The first assembly robot and the second assembly robot may be located on autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles and the various components can be operated by a control system based on operation instructions received from a neural network.
title: Solar panel handling system

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a human-robot interaction method and device. The method comprises the steps that the interaction situation where a robot is located is monitored, and whether the interaction situation is matched with a current interaction situation set by the robot is judged; if the interaction situation where the robot is located is matched with the current interaction situation set by the robot, the robot is controlled to display an interaction expression corresponding to the current interaction situation; and if the interaction situation where the robot is located is not matched with the current interaction situation set by the robot, the current interaction situation of the robot is set to be the monitored interaction situation, and the robot is controlled to display an interaction expression corresponding to the monitored interaction situation. According to the human-robot interaction method and device, the device can respond according to the emotive information of an interaction object and generate an affectional resonance for the interaction object when communicates and interacts with the interaction object, the human-robot interaction effect is improved, and the user experience is improved.
title: Human-robot interaction method and device

abstract: This specification describes an adaptive robotic nursing assistant for physical tasks and patient observation and feedback. In some examples, the adaptive robotic nursing assistant includes an omni-directional mobile platform; a footrest on the omni-directional mobile platform; a handlebar located above the footrest such that a user standing on the footrest can grasp the handlebar; a display above the handlebar and at least one user input device; a robot manipulator comprising a robotic arm and an end effector on the robotic arm; and a control system coupled to the omni-directional mobile platform, the control system comprising at least one processor and memory storing executable instructions for the at least one processor to control the omni-directional mobile platform.
title: ADAPTIVE ROBOTIC NURSING ASSISTANT

abstract: Methods and systems are disclosed for efficient and accurate planning of multi-object robotic grasping operations. Such methods and systems allow for implementation of the concept of “only-pick-once”, in which multiple objects are picked by a robotic grasping mechanism according to a grasping plan. A picking plan for a robotic picking arm may be generated according to a desired picking characteristic (e.g., a number of objects per grasp, a goal of minimizing grasping actions, etc.). Sensor data indicative of a work environment may be used to generate a graph relating objects of interest. The objects may be clustered according to various attributes or connections, such as whether a group of objects is within the maximum grasping area of the robotic arm or collision avoidance. The clusters may be ranked, then a picking plan determined for picking clusters by ranking.
title: MULTI-OBJECT PICKING

abstract: A surgical robotic arm support system may include a base and at least one post and/or a connection for coupling a robot arm to the support system. The base may be configured to at least partially surround a surgical table. The at least one post may have a first end supported on the base and a second end configured to support a robotic arm. The at least one post may be configured to be coupled to a surgical table. The connection may support a mechanical and/or electrical connectivity between the support system and a coupled robot arm. Electrical connectivity may be configured to identify at least one of the robot arm connections to which at least one robot arm is connected. Each robot arm connection may be configured to maintain a portion of a connected robot arm at a predetermined position from the base.
title: SURGICAL ROBOTIC ARM SUPPORT SYSTEMS AND METHODS OF USE

abstract: The present approach relates to integrated planning of robot navigation and manipulator motion in performing tasks. In particular, as discussed herein sensor information, such as visual information, may be used for the robot to locate a target object when it arrives at a working location. Adjustments may be made based on this information that may include moving the robot and planning a manipulator arm motion.
title: Architecture and methods for robotic mobile manipulation system

abstract: A system and method of object manipulation and training including providing at least one robotic hand including a plurality of grippers connected to a body and providing a plurality of cameras disposed in a periphery surface of the grippers. The method also includes providing a plurality of tactile sensors disposed in the periphery surface of the grippers and actuating the grippers to grasp an object. The method further includes detecting a position of the object with respect to the robotic hand via a first image feed from the tactile sensors and detecting a position of the object with respect to the robotic hand via a second image feed from the cameras. The method also includes generating instructions to grip and manipulate an orientation of the object based on the first and the second image feeds for a visualization of the object relative to the robotic hand.
title: INCORPORATING VISION SYSTEM AND IN-HAND OBJECT LOCATION SYSTEM FOR OBJECT MANIPULATION AND TRAINING

abstract: A neurosurgical robot navigation and positioning system and method are disclosed. The system comprises: a motion executing device(101), a spatial position sensor(102), an equipped position marker unit(103) and a computer device(104); wherein the computer device(104) is connected to the motion executing device(101) and the spatial position sensor(102), and configured to create a surgery plan on a digital graphic image, the surgery plan comprising a lesion position which is precisely self-targeted and a motion path thereof; the spatial position sensor(102) is configured to capture the equipped position marker unit(103) such that the computer device(104) implements position mapping between different spatial coordinate systems; and the motion execution device(101) is mounted with a surgical instrument(111), and configured to generate a specific motion scheme according to the lesion position which is precisely self-targeted and the motion path thereof and the position mapping between the different spatial coordinate systems, precisely self-target a lesion position, and securely lock the surgical instrument(111) to support a surgical operation.
title: NEUROSURGICAL ROBOT NAVIGATION POSITIONING SYSTEM AND METHOD

abstract: A robotic device for operation in association with an appendage of a user, wherein the appendage of the user has an endpoint, the robotic device comprising: a base; and a robotic arm attached to the base and having an endpoint, the robotic arm having at least two active degrees of freedom relative to the base and being configured so that when the base is appropriately positioned relative to a user, the reference frame of the robotic device is oriented generally similarly to the reference frame of the user and motions of the endpoint of the appendage of the user are mimicked by motions of the endpoint of the robotic arm.
title: MULTI-ACTIVE-AXIS, NON-EXOSKELETAL REHABILITATION DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a robot finger device of a connecting rod gear sliding groove with a linear parallel grabbing function, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The device comprisesa base, a motor, a transmission mechanism, a first transmission wheel, a second transmission wheel, a connecting rod, a first finger section, a second finger section, a near-joint shaft, a far-joint shaft, a first shaft, a second shaft, a third shaft, a fourth shaft and a fifth shaft. According to the device, the function of linear parallel clamping of the robot finger is achieved; when the objectis clamped by the device, the second finger section always keeps a rectilinear motion trail, the second finger section can move with a linear parallel to grab the object, and the device is suitable for being used for grabbing a thin-plate-shaped object on a workbench; the device is large in grabbing range; two finger sections are driven by a driver, the driving mode is simple, and a complicated sensing and control system is not needed; and the device is compact in structure, small in size, low in manufacturing and maintaining cost, and the device is suitable for the robot hand.
title: Robot finger device of connecting rod gear sliding groove with linear parallel grabbing function

abstract: A system for wirelessly operating an end effector and a robotic arm of a robotic assembly includes a remote control having a sensor for generating movement data corresponding to a movement of the remote control by a user, and a primary switch operable to commence a logging of spatially defined points present in the generated movement data. The system also includes a receiver in wireless communication with the remote control, a processor communicably coupled to the receiver, and a controller communicably coupled to the processor, the memory, and an actuator associated with the robotic assembly. The receiver receives the movement data from the sensor. The processor logs the spatially defined points in a memory in response to the primary switch being actuated. The controller commands the actuator for initiating movement of at least one of the robotic arm and the end effector based on the logged spatially defined points.
title: SYSTEM FOR OPERATING A ROBOTIC ASSEMBLY

abstract: The present invention relates to a finger module and a robot hand using the same. The finger module according to the present invention comprises: a contact roller; a roller driving unit which rotates the contact roller with respect to the rotation axis of the contact roller; and a roller steering unit which controls an angle of the rotation axis of the contact roller. Therefore, the robot hand efficiently rotates an object to be sewed through a simple configuration.
title: Finger module and robot hand using thereof

abstract: The invention provides a parallel leg structure for a legged robot capable of running at a high speed, relating to a parallel leg structure. The parallel leg structure provided by the invention solves the problem of relatively large energy consumption of the existing legged robot capable of running at a high speed because of the movement rule of periodic acceleration and deceleration. Two joint leg loading and hoisting steel plates are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on outer walls of two sides of a scapula; the upper end of a thigh is articulated with the lower part of the scapula; the lower end of the thigh is articulated with the upper end of a shank; a sole is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the shank; a parallel short connecting rod is articulated with the upper part of the thigh; the other end of the parallel short connecting rod is articulated with the upper end of a parallel long connecting rod; a horizontal valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is installed on the scapula and is horizontally arranged; a hydraulic rod of the horizontal valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is connected with the articulated point of the parallel short connecting rod and the parallel long connecting rod; a vertical valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is installed on the scapula and is vertically arranged; and a hydraulic rod of the vertical valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is connected with the articulated point of the parallel short connecting rod and the parallel long connecting rod. The parallel leg structure provided by the invention is used for the legged robot.
title: Parallel leg structure for legged robot capable of running at high speed

abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom mechanical leg for a legged robot based on a self-locking worm and gear transmission pair, which comprises a thigh part and a shank part which are hinged through a knee pivot, and further comprises a transmission mechanism, and the transmission mechanism comprises a transmission rod and a connecting rod; the connecting rod is provided with a first end part hinged to the transmission rod through a connecting shaft I and a second end part hinged to the shank part through a connecting shaft II; the thigh part and the transmission rod are positioned on the same side of the shank part; the axis of the connecting shaft I, the axis of the connecting shaft II and the axis of the knee pivot shaft are parallel; the transmission rod is driven to be close to or far away from the knee pivot through the first transmission pair, so that the shank part is driven by the transmission rod to swing around the knee pivot through the connecting rod; the transmission mechanism further comprises a second transmission pair used for driving the thigh part to rotate in the set direction. Under the condition that the structure is simple, the large and accurate transmission ratio between the thighs and the shanks is met, the bearing capacity and the transmission efficiency are improved, and meanwhile, the bionic robot has the function of rotating in the set direction and better conforms to bionics.
title: Two-degree-of-freedom mechanical leg for legged robot based on self-locking worm and gear transmission pair

abstract: An apparatus and method for adaptive handling of slides using a robot arm. The apparatus includes at least a computing device comprised of a processor and a memory communicatively connected to the processor. The memory instructs the processor to receive a calibration procedure, wherein the calibration procedure is generated using a plurality of waypoints. The processor controls the at least a robotic arm as a function of the calibration procedure, wherein the calibration procedure is configured to cause the robotic arm to pick, using a pick waypoint of the plurality of waypoints, and place, using a place waypoint of the plurality of waypoints, a slide. The processor receives a plurality of feedback from the at least a robotic arm. The processor generates, using the plurality of feedback, an adapted pick waypoint. The memory instructs the processor to generate, using the plurality of feedback, an adapted place waypoint.
title: Apparatus and method for adaptive handling of slides using a robotic arm

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-foot-wheel walking robot which comprises a vehicle body, a steering unit and a multi-foot-wheel mechanism. The vehicle body comprises a main vehicle frame, an auxiliaryvehicle frame and a control room; the steering unit comprises a fixed plate, a steering motor and a steering driving gear; and the multi-foot-wheel mechanism comprises a fixed seat, a mounting seat,an eccentric shaft, a driving gear, a driven gear, a planet wheel disc, a foot rod, a foot rod mounting seat, a hinge shaft, a connecting piece and a steering driven gear. The multi-foot-wheel walkingrobot has the beneficial effects that the control is simple in the walking process of the robot, the passing capacity is good, and the practicability is high.
title: Multi-foot-wheel walking robot

abstract: A robotic arm system (1) for controlling the actions of a robotic arm (5), the system being provided with a ranking-determining unit (11) that determines the ranking of teaching information based on at least one of: perception information, which is information that a human (16) perceives concerning the environment around the robotic arm (5) and that the human uses to change the action of the robotic arm (5) by operating the robotic arm; reaction time information, which is time information from when the human (16) receives the perception information during operation of the robotic arm (5) until the human (16) operates the robotic arm (5); and variation information, which is information relating to the degree of variation in at least one of the teaching information or the perception information. Action information for the robotic arm (5) is generated from the teaching information and the ranking determined by the ranking-determining unit (11).
title: ROBOTIC ARM CONTROL DEVICE AND CONTROL METHOD, ROBOT, CONTROL PROGRAM AND INTEGRATED ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT

abstract: The invention discloses a self-walking robot. The self-walking robot comprises a radar device and a robot body, the radar device comprises a light-transmitting cover body, a first optical assembly, a second optical assembly and a driving assembly, and the first optical assembly and the second optical assembly are arranged in the light-transmitting cover body; the driving assembly drives the first optical assembly and the second optical assembly to rotate around the rotating shaft; the light-transmitting cover body comprises a first light-transmitting area and a second light-transmitting area, an assembling part is arranged on the machine body, and the radar device is assembled on the machine body through the assembling part; the assembling part is provided with a first avoiding opening, and the first light-transmitting area communicates with the outer portion of the front side of the machine body through the first avoiding opening. The first optical assembly and the second optical assembly are integrally arranged on the driving assembly, and the radar device is assembled on the assembly part of the machine body, so that the total height of the machine body is not increased too much, and good trafficability of the self-walking robot is guaranteed.
title: Self-walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a walking robot. The walking robot comprises a first machine frame, a first driving component for driving the first machine frame to slide, a plurality of first sets of bioniccontact pins which are telescopically arranged on the first machine frame and comprise first bionic contact pins and first drivers, a second machine frame slidably arranged above the first machine frame, a second driving component for driving the second machine frame to slide, a plurality of second sets of bionic contact pins which are telescopically arranged on the second machine frame and comprise second bionic contact pins and second drivers, and a control box which is in signal transmission with the first driving component and the second driving component, wherein the first drivers are inone-to-one correspondence with the first bionic contact pins; the second drivers are in one-to-one correspondence with the second bionic contact pins; and the control box is in signal transmission with the first drivers and the second drivers. According to the walking robot, the obstacle crossing ability of the walking robot can be improved.
title: Walking robot

abstract: A reconfigurable controller base for a robotic arm is provided. In one aspect, a robotic system includes a base supporting one or more articulating links, the base comprising: a main housing comprising an external structure that at least partly encloses an inner portion of the main housing, the external structure forming an opening at a back side and a bottom side of the main housing, a reconfigurable bracket configured to be removably attached to the external structure of the main housing in at least two configurations to cover the opening at the back and bottom sides of the main housing, and a controller mounted on the bracket and arranged within the inner portion of the main housing in each of the at least two configurations of the bracket, the controller configured to control actuation of the one or more articulating links.
title: RECONFIGURABLE CONTROLLER BASE FOR ROBOTIC ARM

abstract: The invention discloses a heavy-load robot balancing load device setting method. The method comprises the steps that a heavy-load robot is set; the total load m borne by the three-axis small arm is obtained; a balance load device is arranged, a balance load m1 is obtained, and the torque generated by the balance load m1 and the torque generated by the total load m are opposite in direction; in an initial state, obtaining a total gravity center O'and a distance L, and measuring a total load included angle alpha; obtaining a balance gravity center O ''and a distance L1, and measuring a balance included angle beta; and starting from the initial state, rotating the heavy-load robot by a rotation angle X, obtaining peak values of the motor torque N3 at different balance included angles beta, comparing the peak values of the motor torque N3 at different balance included angles beta, selecting the corresponding balance included angle beta when the peak value of the motor torque N3 is minimum, and balancing the position of the gravity center O ''according to the balance included angle beta. Compared with the prior art, the method for setting the balancing load device of the heavy-load robot has the advantages that the motor torque can be reduced, and the light weight of the robot is realized.
title: Setting method for balancing load device of heavy-load robot

abstract: The invention relates to a connecting-rod gear-rack linear parallel clamping indirect self-adaptive robot finger device, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The connecting-rod gear-rack linear parallel clamping indirect self-adaptive robot finger device comprises a base, two finger sections, two joint shafts, a gear rack, a plurality of gears, two driving wheels, a driving medium, a guiding rod, a spring piece and the like. The device achieves the function of linear parallel clamping and self-adaptive grabbing of fingers of a robot; a linear motion of a far joint shaft is achieved through a connecting mechanism, and a second finger section keeps a fixed posture relative to the base in a first grabbing phase by adopting the spring piece to be matched with a gear rack mechanism; when an object is in contact with a first finger section, the self-adaptive rotation of the second finger section around the far joint shaft is achieved through the gear rack mechanism; grabbing of objects with different shapes and sizes can be adapted; and the grabbing range is large, the grabbing is stable and reliable, the structure is simple, and the cost is low.
title: Connecting-rod gear-rack linear parallel clamping indirect self-adaptive robot finger device

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-information map navigation method for a legged robot based on field terrain type and physical characteristic visual inference, and relates to the technical field of map navigation. The invention aims to solve the problem of low accuracy of the existing field environment map navigation method of the foot-type robot. The method comprises the following steps: inputting an RGB image of a to-be-detected area into Fast-TerrienNet to obtain a terrain of the to-be-detected area, and obtaining a rigidity grade and a friction grade of the terrain of the to-be-detected area; utilizing the depth image of the to-be-detected area to obtain the pose of the foot-type robot; constructing a three-dimensional diagram of the to-be-detected area by using the terrain in the to-be-detected area, the rigidity grade and the friction grade of the terrain in the to-be-detected area, the depth image of the to-be-detected area and the pose information of the foot robot; projecting the three-dimensional diagram of the to-be-measured area to a horizontal plane by taking a preset height threshold value as a constraint, and then setting an impassable area based on a terrain type, a rigidity level and a friction level so as to obtain a final two-dimensional navigation map; and deploying the final two-dimensional navigation map into a Ros Native Stack (Region Navigation Stack). The method is used for field navigation of the multi-legged robot.
title: Foot type robot multi-information map navigation method based on field terrain type and physical characteristic visual inference

abstract: The invention provides a coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting idle stroke and transmission flexible pieces and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting the idle stroke and the transmission flexible pieces comprises a base, two finger segments, two joint shafts, a driver, two transmission wheels, the two flexible pieces, a transition transmission mechanism, a middle transmission mechanism, a shift wheel, a lug drive plate, a limiting drive plate, two spring pieces and a limiting lug.
