According to the coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting the idle stroke and the transmission flexible pieces, through the idle stroke between a driving lug on the shift wheel and a driven lug on the lug drive plate, a coupling and self-adapting composite grabbing manner is achieved; two joints can be in linkage to pinch an object, the purpose that the first finger segment is rotated and then the second finger segment is rotated to hold an object can also be achieved, and therefore the self-adapting grabbing effect on objects in different shapes and sizes can be achieved; only the one driver is used for driving the two joints, and a complicated sensing and real-time control system is not needed; and the coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting the idle stroke and the transmission flexible pieces is simple in structure, small in volume, light in weight and low in cost.
title: Coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting idle stroke and transmission flexible pieces

abstract: Various surgical systems are disclosed. A surgical system comprises a robotic system. The robotic system comprises a control unit; a robotic arm comprising an attachment portion; a first sensor system in signal communication with the control unit; and a second sensor system. The first sensor system is configured to detect a position of the attachment portion. A surgical tool is removably attached to the attachment portion. The second sensor system is independent of the first sensor system and is configured to detect a position of the surgical tool.
title: SENSING ARRANGEMENTS FOR ROBOT-ASSISTED SURGICAL PLATFORMS

abstract: The invention relates to a shopping robot and relates to the technical field of robots. The shopping robot comprises an armrest, a photographing device, a connecting rod, a machine body, a robot hand,an electric box, a seat, a shopping box and a chassis walking mechanism, wherein the photographing device is mounted on the armrest; the armrest is fixedly connected with the machine body through theconnecting rod; the machine body, the electric box and the shopping box are mounted on the chassis walking mechanism; the chassis walking mechanism is composed of two driving motors, two driving wheels, two steering universal wheels and a gear transmission mechanism. The shopping robot provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that a consumer issues an instruction to the robot throughintelligent communication equipment; after the robot receives the instruction, the robot transports the consumers to a commodity storage place; when commodities are purchased, the robot hand also canstretch and retract to grasp the commodities and put same into the shopping box so that the labor intensity of the consumers is greatly reduced and the comfort of shopping is improved.
title: Shopping robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robotic arm wrist joint, and belongs to the technical field of modular joints. The robotic arm wrist joint comprises a shell, a flexible wheel output shaft, a motor shaft anda split harmonic reducer, wherein the split harmonic reducer comprises a steel wheel, a flexible wheel and a wave generator; the steel wheel is in fastened connection with the shell; the flexible wheel is in fastened connection with the flexible wheel output shaft; a positioning hole is formed in the center of the motor shaft; the wave generator comprises a first end and a second end; the first end is embedded in the positioning hole and is fit with the inner wall of the motor shaft; the second end is arranged on the end surface of the motor shaft, and is in fastened connection with the motorshaft; a central hole for wiring is formed in the center of the wave generator. The overall weight and volume of the robotic arm wrist joint can be obviously reduced under the condition of ensuring torque.
title: Robotic arm wrist joint

abstract: The present invention relates to a multi-legged robot which comprises: a body; a plurality of legs provided on the body; a rail extended toward the outside of the body from a rear part of the body and provided with a gear on an outer circumference thereof; and a counter weight moving along the rail. The counter weight comprises: a weight; a first actuator placed on the weight; and a driving gear meshing with the gear and moving along the gear while rotating by the first actuator. The present invention provides a multi-legged robot which well utilizes a space inside the body and makes the body compact.
title: Multi-leg robot

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot motion control device capable of performing a plurality of tasks simultaneously such as a motion balance maintenance and an arm working.

SOLUTION: A task and a condition of constraint imposed on a legged robot according to a motion condition are given by an equality and an inequality concerning variations dx from the present condition, and a driving strategy of redundant flexibility is defined as an energy function. It is not necessary to constitute a control system specialized for each condition of constraint for the change of the condition of constraint, but by only changing matrices A and C, and vector b, d, the change of the condition of constraint can be coped with. Therefore, various and dynamic condition of constrains are easy to handle. Moreover, only by changing matrix W and vector u, a using process of the redundant flexibility can be coped with.

title: ROBOT MOTION CONTROL DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a walking robot used for gardens. The walking robot comprises a machine frame. A first rotary shaft, a second rotary shaft, a third rotary shaft and a fourth rotary shaft are sequentially arranged on the machine frame on the same horizontal plane from front to back. One side of the first rotary shaft and one side of the second rotary shaft are connected with a first walkingmechanism, and the other sides of the first rotary shaft and the second rotary shaft are connected with a second walking mechanism. One side of the third rotary shaft and one side of the fourth rotary shaft are connected with a third walking mechanism, and the other sides of the third rotary shaft and the fourth rotary shaft are connected with a fourth walking mechanism. The first walking mechanism comprises a first crank perpendicularly connected to one end of the first rotary shaft, a second crank perpendicularly connected to one end of the second rotary shaft, the first crank and the second crank are equal in length and parallel, and the other ends of the first crank and the second crank are connected through a first connecting rod. By the adoption of the robot, a walking function canbe achieved through output of a single motor, and the structural design is reasonable; and a mechanical hand device moves diversely, and various operation requirements can be met.
title: Walking robot used for gardens

abstract: The invention discloses a modular reconfigurable bionic wheel-legged robot which deeply integrates bionics, a dynamic ad hoc network and a multi-modal motion control technology and has all-terrain self-adaption and multi-modal motion capabilities. According to the technical scheme for solving the technical problems, the modular reconfigurable bionic wheel-leg type robot comprises a plurality of single modules which are connected with one another, and each single module comprises a trunk module, a front end connecting arm and a wheel-leg composite motion module; the trunk module comprises a frame, a main control unit, a battery bin and a sensor array are integrated in the frame, and a conical protrusion is arranged in the frame. A clamping jaw is arranged at the end part of the front-end connecting arm, and is matched with the conical bulge to realize rigid connection between the adjacent single modules; the wheel-leg composite motion modules comprise hip joint modules, thigh joint modules, shank joint modules and wheel-foot modules, the wheel-foot modules can advance in a wheel-type mode or a foot-type mode, and the two wheel-leg composite motion modules are arranged on the two sides of the trunk module respectively.
title: Modularized reconfigurable bionic wheel-legged robot

abstract: An operator controllable robotic device is disclosed. The robotic device comprises a support member, an upper robotic arm, a lower robotic arm, and a control arm. The upper robotic arm is coupled to the support member and has rotational movement in at least one degree of freedom relative to the support member. The lower robotic arm is coupled to the upper robotic arm and has rotational movement in at least one degree of freedom relative to the upper robotic arm. The control arm allows an operator to control the robotic device. The control arm is coupled to the upper robotic arm and has rotational movement in at least one degree of freedom relative to the upper robotic arm. The control arm allows a movement of the operator to control a movement of at least one of the upper robotic arm and the lower robotic arm.
title: Robotic lift device with human interface operation

abstract: PURPOSE: A charge cradle device of quadruped robot is provided to embody the movement test of a quadruped robot while charging by freely moving four legs of a quadruped robot with picking up from the floor. CONSTITUTION: A charge cradle device of quadruped robot an upside placing portion(110), a chargeable power terminal(120), a settlement detecting unit(130), a power circuit substrate(140), a cradle main body(150) and an external power connector(160). The upper side of the upside placing portion is formed according to the shape of the belly of a quadruped robot. The chargeable power terminal is touched with the charging terminal of a quadruped robot and provides the charging power. The settlement detecting unit detects the settlement of a quadruped robot. The power circuit substrate provides the charging power to the quadruped robot through the chargeable power terminal. The cradle main body has the height and width enough for four legs of the quadruped walking robot to move freely. The external power connector connects the external power to the power circuit substrate.
title: RECHARGE CRADLE DEVICE FOR FOUR FOOT WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The present invention relates to a device (1) forming a robotic hand, comprising: - a base forming a hand palm, - at least two articulated structures each forming a robotic finger, each articulated structure being connected to the base by at least one articulation, - at least one drive mechanism for each articulation, - at least one actuator arranged to actuate the at least one drive mechanism by means of at least one flexible drive link connecting and driving the at least one drive mechanism, - means for measuring the pivoting of the at least one actuator and one or more of the articulations, - a glove (102) covering the base and the at least two articulated structures, the glove being closed so as to form, inside the glove, a volume filled with oil between the wall of the glove and the base and the at least two articulated structures. The field of the invention is, in particular, that of robotic hands used in aquatic environments at great depths.
title: ROBOTIC HAND SENSITIVE TO FORCES IN AN AQUATIC ENVIRONMENT

abstract: The invention discloses a robot non-singular hand-eye calibration method based on a sequential rotation mechanism, relates to the technical field of visual calibration and robots, analyzes a hand-eye calibration analytic solution method based on modified Rodrigues parameters proposed by R.Y.Tsai, discovers inherent defects for the first time, and provides a method for calibrating the robot non-singular hand-eye calibration based on the R.Y.Tsai and the robot non-singular hand-eye calibration based on the R.Y.Tsai. Comprising the following steps: a user performs a virtual rotation motion on a rotation axis akBi of RBi obtained by actual measurement according to own preference, a corresponding rotation matrix is marked as Ruser, and at the moment, a vector group akBi is changed into Ruser kBi; and as long as the user matrix Ruser is properly selected, the rotation angle value of the rotation matrix determined by the measurement vector group {kAi, Ruser kBi} is no longer equal to the pi radian. According to the method, the inherent defects of hand-eye calibration analytic solutions proposed by R.Y.Tsai based on similar parameters are well overcome, and the safety and robustness of the transformer substation inspection robot hand-eye calibration analytic solution method based on modified Rodrigues parameters are improved to a certain extent.
title: Robot non-singular hand-eye calibration method based on sequential rotation mechanism

abstract: A robotic assistance device includes a robotic arm configured assist a human being and one or more sensors configured to receive input data. The input data includes information related to one or more activities being performed by the human being. The robotic assistance device further includes a processor operatively connected to the one or more sensors and the first robotic arm. The processor is configured to process data received from the sensor, and to determine, based on the processed data, that a task should be performed by the robotic assistance device based at least in part on the activities being performed by the human being. The processor is further configured cause the operative piece to perform the task.
title: ROBOTIC ASSISTANCE DEVICE USING REDUCTION OF COGNITIVE LOAD OF A USER

abstract: A method for generating a gait of a two-legged walking robot having a body, two articulated legs each connected to the body through a hip joint and each including a thigh link, a crus link connected to the thigh link through a knee joint and a foot connected to the crus link through an ankle joint, the robot being configured to drive the articulated legs as a foreleg and hind leg such that the hind leg kicks ground to walk in a direction. In the method, a position of the robot body at a time when the hind leg has kicked the ground is estimated, and an amount of lift, in the direction of gravity, of a heel of the foot of the hind leg is determined such that the robot body will reach at least the estimated position. Then a vertical amplitude of the robot body trajectory is temporarily determined and is then corrected such that the vertical acceleration becomes a desired value, and the gait is then determined or generated based thereon. The robot locomotion is then controlled based on the generated gait. <IMAGE>
title: Method of generating gait of legged walking robot and system for controlling its locomotion

abstract: The disclosure provides a motion control system of a robot and a robot, wherein the robot is a wheel-foot composite robot which comprises a robot body and a motion mechanism arranged on the robot body; the motion mechanism comprises two rear rollers and two front leg mechanisms; the system comprises a motion planning module configured to determine a first, second and third motion tasks based on the target task and the latest actual state information of the wheel-foot composite robot; the motion control module config to control the whole body motion of the wheel-foot composite robot based on the first, second and third motion tasks; the state perception module configured to determine actual state information of the wheel-foot composite robot, and sending the actual state information to the motion planning module, so that the motion planning module performs new motion planning based on the actual state information.
title: MOTION CONTROL SYSTEM OF ROBOT AND ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a single-loop closed-chain leg mechanism with three degrees of freedom, and relates to the technical field of quadruped walking robots. The single-loop closed-chain leg mechanism can be used as a leg mechanism of the quadruped robot, so that the quadruped robot has high flexibility, high moving speeds and large load capacity. The single-loop closed-chain leg mechanism comprises a base assembly (1), an equivalent cylindrical secondary drive mechanism assembly (2), a first branch chain assembly (3), a second branch chain assembly (4) and a foot assembly (5). The five assemblies of the single-loop closed-chain leg mechanism are integrally formed through bolt joint and hinge joint. By controlling movement of a first drive motor, a second drive motor and a third drive motor (2-1, 2-2, 4-1), the single-loop closed-chain leg mechanism can realize spatial three-dimensional translational motion, and the foot end can move along any three-dimensional trajectory.
title: Single-loop closed-chain leg mechanism with three degrees of freedom

abstract: Various stabilization devices for a robotic end of arm tool, such as a robotic gripper, are described. The stabilization device is provided in a palm area of the end of arm tool and serves as a backstop against which actuators of the end of arm tool can push a compliant or slick target object. The stabilization device may take many any of a variety of shapes, depending on the applications. Based on the shape of the stabilization device and the action of the robotic gripper on the target object, the target object can be moved or rotated in a more stable configuration, thus allowing the actuators to apply less force while still maintaining a firm grasp of the object.
title: STRUCTURE FOR A ROBOTIC END EFFECTOR

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand for playing a stringed instrument capable of securing a large amount of vibrato stroke without using an actuator with large output.

SOLUTION: This robot hand for playing a stringed instrument comprises a finger part having a finger part body and a swing link mechanism attached to the finger part body and having a contact for pressing a chord at the end. The finger part is so formed that when the finger part body is moved to press the contact against the chord, the swing link is swung while changing the position thereof relative to the chord. The robot hand also comprises a force imparting means for imparting a force in the direction against the swing of the swing link. Since the finger part body is moved in the direction of pressing the contact against the chord while keeping the contact of the contact with the chord, the swing link is swung, and moved in the longitudinal direction of the chord with the chord pressed by the contact.

title: ROBOT HAND FOR PLAYING STRINGED INSTRUMENT AND ROBOT FOR PLAYING STRINGED INSTRUMENT

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a legged robot hardly allowing a trunk link thereof to swing in the front-rear direction during walking.

SOLUTION: The legged robot 10 is formed with the trunk link 12 and a pair of leg portions 20L, 20R. The leg portions 20L, 20R have pitch joints 24L, 24R each capable of rotating mutually connected links in a plane intersecting a straight line extending in a body direction. Further, the rotation centers 24LP, 24RP of the pitch joints are located higher than the center G of gravity of the trunk link. The leg portions of the legged robot walk by swinging forward/backward mainly about the rotating centers, and therefore the trunk link 12 also walks in a manner swinging forward/backward mainly about the rotating center. Herein, the center G of gravity of the trunk link 12 is located lower than the rotating centers, and therefore gravity acting on the trunk link 12 is applied in a direction to prevent the trunk link 12 from swinging during walking. Thus the trunk link is hardly allowed to swing in the front-rear direction during walking.
