title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: A quick hand-eye calibration method about multi-camera cooperative positioning comprises the steps that 1, the tail end of a robot is moved three or more times, calibration pattern detection is conducted through the same camera after each time of movement, and the position and pose of the calibration pattern relative to the camera after each time of movement and the position and pose of the tail end of the robot relative to a substrate are recorded; 2, calculating a homogeneous transformation matrix of the tail end of the robot relative to a base coordinate system after each time of movement and a homogeneous transformation matrix of a camera coordinate system relative to a calibration pattern coordinate system after each time of movement; 3, calculating a homogeneous transformation matrix of the calibration pattern coordinate system relative to the robot tail end coordinate system; 4, calculating a homogeneous transformation matrix of each camera coordinate system relative to the base coordinate system; and 5, calculating the coordinates of the final target point obtained by the plurality of cameras under the substrate, obtaining the accurate position of the target point, and completing position calibration of coordination of the robot and the plurality of cameras. The robot hand-eye calibration method has rapidness in robot hand-eye calibration task, and the calibration efficiency can be remarkably improved.
title: Rapid hand-eye calibration method related to multi-camera cooperative positioning

abstract: A walking robot and a control method in which conversion between walking servo control methods is stably carried out. The walking robot includes a sensor unit to measure angles and torques of joints, and a control unit to calculate voltages applied in a Finite State Machine (FSM) control mode and a Zero Moment Point (ZMP) control mode according to the angles and torques of the joints to drive respective joint motors, to store last target joint angles in the FSM control mode during conversion from the FSM control mode to the ZMP control mode, and to perform a motion based on the FSM control mode by substituting the last target joint angles in the FSM control mode for target joint angles in the FSM control mode during conversion from the ZMP control mode to the FSM control mode, thereby performing stable conversion between walking servo control modes without joint sagging.
title: Walking robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and discloses a wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot. The wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot comprises a transformablewheel leg mechanism, a driving control unit and multiple functional module units, wherein the transformable wheel leg mechanism is used for realizing a gait driving function and a wheel type driving function; the driving control unit and the multiple functional module units are arranged in the transformable wheel leg mechanism; the transformable wheel leg mechanism comprises a serial mechanism which is formed by connecting a first supporting leg, a second supporting leg and a third supporting leg with different structures through corresponding rotating shafts and has three rotation freedom degrees; and the external edges of the first supporting leg, the second supporting leg and the third supporting leg are of circular arc structures with same diameters. According to the wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot, the integral structure is simple; the rigidity is high; the stability is reliable; the wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot takes both obstacle crossing ability and moving speed into considerations; multiple functional modules can be additionally arranged so that the wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot has complete functions; and very high practicability and broad application value are realized.
title: Wheel leg transformation type multi-legged robot

abstract: The disclosed robot hand (1), which has an attachment section (B) by which said robot hand will be held when incorporated into a robot, is provided with: CFRP layers (2 and 3) laminated to each other; and a vibration-damping elastic layer (4) disposed between the CFRP layers (2 and 3). The vibration-damping elastic layer (4) has viscoelastic resin regions (41), comprising a viscoelastic resin, and high-rigidity resin regions (42), comprising a high-rigidity resin. The viscoelastic resin regions (41) and the high-rigidity resin regions (42) are arranged in the attachment section (B) so as to alternate in a direction that intersects the long direction of the CFRP layers (2). The viscoelastic resin regions (41) improve the vibration-damping ability of the robot hand (1). Also, arranging the viscoelastic resin regions (41) and the high-rigidity resin regions (42) in the attachment section (B) so as to alternate in a direction that intersects the long direction of the CFRP layers (2) provides flexural rigidity in said intersecting direction.
title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention relates to a four-footed passive walking robot which comprises a square trunk, a left front leg, a right front leg, a left rear leg and a right rear leg, the left front leg, the right front leg, the left rear leg and the right rear leg are rotationally connected to the four corners of the trunk, and the left front leg, the right front leg, the left rear leg and the right rear leg are the same in structure and each comprise a leg unit and a foot unit; the leg units are rotatably connected with the trunk to form hip joints, the foot units are fixedly connected with the leg units, the bottom surface of each foot unit is a stepped cambered surface composed of an inner side cambered surface and an outer side cambered surface, and the inner side cambered surface is lower than the outer side cambered surface. According to the technical scheme, the walking continuity is good, the periodicity is good, and the gait stability is good.
title: Four-footed passive walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a steering device and a four-legged robot comprising the same. The steering device includes a supporting base, a hydraulic telescopic device is vertically arranged on the supporting base, a disc-shaped supporting shaft is installed at the top of the hydraulic telescopic device, and a stator core is arranged on the upper portion of the supporting shaft. A coil winding is arranged on the stator core, a rotor permanent magnet is arranged in the center of the stator core, and the rotor permanent magnet is fixed to the bottom of a machine body of the robot. The coil windingis controlled to be energized or cut off, a rotating magnetic field is formed, the rotor permanent magnet rotates under the action of the magnetic field, the permanent magnet is fixed together with the machine body of the robot, so that the machine body of the robot rotates at an angle when four feet are off the ground.
title: Steering device and four-legged robot comprising same

abstract: An independent tube position verification system includes a TV camera (16) mounted on an end effector (EE) of a robotic arm (20) mounted in a steam generator (10) beneath the tube sheet (12) to visually track changes in position as the end effector (EE) is moved across the tube sheet (12) by a robotic arm (20). The tube sheet (12) and the tube ends (14) thereof are illuminated by one or more light sources (18) at an oblique angle to cause the desirable presence of shadows in the field of view. The TV camera (16) outputs successive image frames so that displacement of an artifact in the image field in successive frames yields physical displacement information which is converted into velocity and direction information. Changes in position determined by the verification system are compared against position information maintained by the robotic arm (20); any mis-match indicates a loss of tracking integrity requiring a system re-calibration.
title: Visual tube position verification system

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: controlling the robot to move according to a first navigation mode; wherein the first navigation mode is a navigation mode under the condition that the target door is in an open state; detecting the opening and closing state of the target door; wherein the target detection position is located on a navigation path corresponding to the first navigation mode, and the target door is located in a detection range of the target detection position; and if the target door is in the closed state, controlling the robot to move according to a second navigation mode. By means of the method, navigation can be conducted according to the condition that the target door is in the open state, then whether the navigation mode of the robot needs to be replaced or not is determined according to the open-close state of the target door, and therefore the appropriate navigation mode is flexibly selected according to the real-time open-close state of the target door, and the flexibility and robustness of robot navigation are improved.
title: Robot control method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: A gripping device which simulates the action of a human finger comprises three pivotted sections 3, 5, 7 having the middle section 5 linked to the top section 7 by a bar 9 so that its rotation causes rotation of the tip section. Rotation of the lower section 3 is preferentially effected by a motor 11 via a sliding cross-head 15, an equaliser bar 18 and a rod 19. If this rotation is stopped by an object 25 to be gripped, the drive transfers via rod 20, crank 21 and rod 23 to the middle section 5, causing the middle and tip sections to rotate and grip the object against the lower portion as shown at 26. A robotic hand comprising four such fingers and a thumb is usable as a substitute for a human hand in a glove-box glove.
title: Gripping device.

abstract: A robot system is provided for moving and de-capping collection containers. The system can include a robotic arm having a plurality of grippers, where the plurality of grippers is configured to move a plurality of collection containers. Additionally, the system can include a decapper configured to remove a plurality of caps corresponding to the plurality of collection containers. The system further includes a computing device comprising a processor and a memory, and machine-readable instructions stored in the memory that, when executed by the processor, cause the computing device to align the plurality of grippers with the plurality of collection containers, where the plurality of grippers are connected to a distal end of the robotic arm. The instructions can further cause the computing device to cause the plurality of grippers to grip the plurality of collection containers, move the plurality of collection containers to the decapper, and de-cap the collection containers.
title: ROBOT FOR MOVING AND DE-CAPPING COLLECTION CONTAINERS

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand including a palm, a finger mechanism and a thumb mechanism and capable of stably holding an object with large to small size.

SOLUTION: The robot hand includes: the palm 2, the finger mechanism 30 extending from a main palm part 3 located at a leading edge region T of the palm 2 and bending inward of the main palm part 3; a center hand part 4 located at a base end region of the palm; and the thumb mechanism 40 connected with the center hand part 4. The thumb mechanism 40 bends inward of the palm 2 in the direction intersecting with a plane through which the finger mechanism 30 passes when the mechanism 30 is bent. The center hand part 4 rotates in the direction intersecting with a plane through which the thumb mechanism 40 passes when the mechanism 40 is bent.

title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: A robotic arm event triggering type control method based on joint external torque estimation solves the problem of robotic arm force/position control under the conditions that a constraint environment is unknown and a six-dimensional force/torque sensor is not used, and comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a robotic arm dynamic model; designing a high-order finite time external torque observer to estimate the external torque of the joint; then designing a reasonable event triggering condition; utilizing the evaluation neural network to approximate a proper performance index function, and solving an HJB equation to obtain a robot arm event triggering type dispersion force/position control strategy based on joint external torque estimation; and the working time is remarkably prolonged while the control precision of the robotic arm is ensured.
title: Machine arm event triggering type control method based on joint external torque estimation

abstract: A system for generating a model-free reinforcement learning policy for a robotic hand for grasping an object is provided, including a processor; a memory; and a simulator implemented via the processor and the memory, performing: sampling a plurality of stable grasps relevant to reorienting the grasped object about a desired axis of rotation and using stable grasps as initial states for collecting training trajectories; learning finger-gaiting and finger-grasping policies for each axis of rotation in the hand coordinate frame based on proprioceptive sensing in the robotic hand, wherein the finger-gaiting and finger-pivoting policy is implemented on the robotic hand.
title: ROBOTIC DEXTERITY WITH INTRINSIC SENSING AND REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve controllability so that one driving source moves a plurality of fingers to an object to be gripped including a different diameter material and the robot hand performs a behavior similar to an gripping operation of a living body. SOLUTION: This multi-fingered movable robot hand comprises two or more fingers (the little finger 12, the third finger 14, the middle finger 18, the forefinger 20) arranged in parallel having joints, the other finger (the thumb 30) disposed facing to these fingers, and flexible members (wires 11, 13, 17, 19, 21, 22) for being pulled to bend joints of two or more fingers. For contacting two or more fingers and one finger with the object W to be gripped including the different diameter material to allow the gripping operation, power generated from one driving source 1 is transmitted to two or more flexible members via one or more differential gears 4, 7, 8, and each flexible member is pulled. Thus, a gripping force is generated in two or more fingers.
title: MULTI-FINGERED MOVABLE ROBOT HAND AND ITS GRIPPING CONTROL METHOD

abstract: The invention discloses a coupling and self-adaptive robot finger device with cooperation of weak-pressure triggering and assistance power, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The coupling and self-adaptive robot finger device comprises a base, two finger sections, two joint shafts, two motors, a plurality of gears, a driving wheel, a driven wheel, two bumps, two shifting wheels, two springs and two triggering sensors. Through the coupling and self-adaptive robot finger device with cooperation of weak-pressure triggering and assistance power, a coupling and self-adaptive grabbing function of a double-joint robot finger is achieved; the first finger section and the second finger section can be driven to grab objects with different shapes and sizes; the triggering sensors are used for collecting information of the objects in contact with the finger sections; a second motor can be triggered to cooperate with assistance to carry out self-adaptive grabbing by only needing small extrusion force; the damage to the objects caused by excessively great extrusion force of the finger sections in the grabbing process is avoided; the device is large in grabbing range, compact in structure, small in size and low in manufacturing and maintenance cost; the shape of the device is similar to that of a human hand; and the device is applied to the robot hands.
title: Coupling and self-adaptive robot finger device with cooperation of weak-pressure triggering and assistance power

abstract: An apparatus comprising an interface, a light projector and a processor. The interface may be configured to receive pixel data. The light projector may be configured to generate a structured light pattern. The processor may be configured to process the pixel data arranged as video frames comprising the structured light pattern, perform computer vision operations to detect a size of a face area of the video frames, determine a scale ratio in response to the size of the face area, extract the structured light pattern from the video frames, generate a downscaled structured light image and generate a depth map in response to the downscaled structured light image and a downscaled reference image. A downscale operation may be performed in response to the scale ratio to generate the downscaled structured light image. The scale ratio may enable the generation of the downscaled structured light image with sufficient depth pixels.
title: Adaptive face depth image generation

abstract: An autonomous floor cleaner includes multiple occupiable space sensors for position and/or proximity sensing. Data from the occupiable space sensors can be used determine areas of occupiable space in proximity to the autonomous floor cleaner. Methods for exiting a trapped condition, obstacle avoidance, and path planning are disclosed.
title: AUTONOMOUS FLOOR CLEANER AND METHOD FOR AUTONOMOUS FLOOR CLEANING

abstract: The invention discloses a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm balance control system loaded on a robot dog. The system comprises a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm dynamic balance control signal matching module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm dynamic balance step determining module, a different-axial-direction dynamic calling module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm balance parameter formulating module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm robot dog demand affirming module and a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm operation optimizing module. The system comprises a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm monitoring platform, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm monitoring platform coordination management module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm data management module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm using module and a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm robot dog PID instruction circulation module. According to the system provided by the invention, the dynamic calling control program of the dynamic balance control signal instruction of the six-axis intelligent mechanical arm is defined through the machine specification, so that the missing report rate and the false report rate of dynamic calling supervision of the dynamic balance control signal instruction of the six-axis intelligent mechanical arm are reduced, the labor cost is reduced, and the efficiency of the six-axis intelligent mechanical arm is improved.
title: Six-axis intelligent mechanical arm balance control system loaded on robot dog

abstract: A module robot 100 is configured by connecting a plurality of modules 101, each module 101 having a first link 1, a second link 2 relatively movably connected to the first link 1, and a hydraulic cylinder 3 for relatively moving the first link 1 and the second link 2.
title: MODULE ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a path planning method, an amphibious unmanned platform, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of path planning, and the path planning method based on the amphibious unmanned platform comprises the steps: obtaining amphibious environment data; inputting the amphibious environment data into the target planning model to obtain a planning path output by the target planning model; wherein the target planning model is obtained by training a PPO algorithm based on reinforcement learning, and the PPO algorithm based on reinforcement learning is obtained after batch dominant function regularization, strategy entropy introduction and adaptive adjustment of cutting factors. Through the above mode, the PPO algorithm based on reinforcement learning is adopted to provide path planning for the amphibious unmanned platform, and improvements of batch dominant function regularization, strategy entropy introduction and adaptive adjustment of cutting factors are performed on the algorithm and the strategy, so that the obstacle avoidance capability in an amphibious environment is improved, and the safety is improved.
title: Path planning method, amphibious unmanned platform, storage medium and program product

abstract: The invention relates to a micro-grid intelligent safety secondary voltage control method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of power grids. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a micro-grid secondary control model under hybrid network attack; a DoS attack defense network based on deep learning is designed, a self-adaptive FDI attack compensation state observer is designed, compensation for unknown FDI attacks is established, a self-adaptive law of compensation signals is designed, and estimation of the system state under network attacks is achieved. An evaluation-execution structure is constructed based on reinforcement learning, a virtual optimal controller and an actual optimal controller are designed in combination with a backstepping method, unknown parts in a system model, an evaluation network and an execution network are approximated by using a neural network, and a weight adjustment law is given. And introducing a log type barrier function into the performance index function, and constraining the output in a fixed constant interval to meet the constraint condition. The method can cope with DoS attacks and FDI attacks, and ensures stable control and safe operation of the secondary voltage of the micro-grid.
title: Microgrid intelligent safety secondary voltage control method based on reinforcement learning

abstract: The invention provides a folding type industrial robot and relates to the technical field of industrial machinery. The folding type industrial robot comprises a rack. A hydraulic tank is fixedly arranged on the top of the rack. A hydraulic device is fixedly arranged on the top of the rack through a mounting frame. The hydraulic device comprises a push rod motor. The output end of the push rod motor is movably connected with a hollow shaft lever. The output end of the push rod motor is movably connected with a push spring. A first push rod is fixedly arranged at the end, far away from the motor, of the push spring. The upper and lower sides of the inner wall of the hollow shaft lever are both provided with slide rails. The first push rod is slidably connected with the corresponding slide rail. The folding type industrial robot can conduct rising and dropping. The working efficiency is improved. Mechanical operation is more convenient, easier and more reasonable. Accordingly, the robot achieves the folding effect and is suitable for various heights of operation during work. Manpower and material resources are saved. The robot can be stored in a smaller space.
title: Folding type industrial robot

abstract: The invention provides a big language model reasoning method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as natural language processing, big language models, voice recognition and cloud services. The reasoning method of the large language model comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of text segments obtained by performing streaming speech recognition on speech data input by a user; inputting the plurality of text segments into a large language model, and performing pre-filling processing on each text segment by the large language model to obtain a pre-filling result of each text segment; in response to determining that the user stops inputting the voice data, obtaining a target filling result according to pre-filling results of all the text segments; and inputting the target pre-filling result into the large language model, performing forward propagation processing and generation output processing on the target pre-filling result by the large language model to obtain a prediction text, and taking the prediction text as a reasoning result of the large language model.
title: Big language model reasoning method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to a rigid-flexible coupling type back assisting backpack structure for an exoskeleton robot. The backpack structure is characterized by comprising a back armor, an artificial spine part and a back frame part, wherein the back armor is fixed to the back of a human body, the left part and the right part of the back armor are used for being connected with the back frame part, and the middle part of the back armor is used for being connected with the artificial spine part; the artificial spine part comprises a back armor main board, a back armor auxiliary board, a spine section upper fixing box, a spine section upper fixing shaft, a spine section uppermost section, spine sections, a spine section lowermost section, a spine section lowermost section fixing plate and pneumatic tendons; and the back frame part comprises a plurality of flexible chains, the back frame, guide rails, a pulley fixing plate and a pulley, the plurality of flexible chains are sequentially connected, and every two adjacent flexible chains can rotate relative to each other. According to the structure, the pneumatic tendons and the spine sections of the artificial spine part can help people torealize the back assistance function, and the artificial spine part has a length-adjustable function and can be adapted to people with different heights, so that the structure is more suitable for being worn by the human body and convenient to operate.
title: Rigid-flexible coupling type back assisting backpack structure for exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a robot wheel-foot conversion device which comprises connecting legs, driving wheels, hydraulic cylinders and supporting plates. The tail ends of the connecting legs are connected with wheel shafts of the driving wheels; a first rotating lug is arranged on the connecting leg; grooves are formed in the tail ends of the connecting legs; the supporting plates comprise the first supporting plate and the second supporting plate, and the second supporting plate is obliquely connected with the first supporting plate. Asecond rotating lug is arranged on the first supporting plate; a third rotating lug is arranged at the tail end of the second supporting plate; one end of a cylinder body of the hydraulic cylinder isrotationally connected with the first rotating lug through a bolt, and one end of a piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder is rotationally connected with the second rotating lug through a bolt. And thethird rotating lug is rotationally connected with the groove through a bolt. According to the scheme, the conversion device is simple in structure, wheel and foot switching is rapid, and the action speed of the robot is guaranteed.
title: Robot wheel-foot conversion device

abstract: A robot arm of a wafer transfer apparatus is provided to perform smoothly a wafer absorbing process regardless of the damage of a wafer support unit by using an improved arrangement of a first exhaust line. A robot arm of a wafer transfer apparatus includes a blade, a wafer support unit, a first exhaust line and a second exhaust line. The blade(112) is used for supporting a wafer. The wafer support unit(114) is installed on the blade. The wafer support unit has at least one vacuum hole(115). The exhaust line(122) is installed under the wafer support unit. The first exhaust line is connected through the vacuum hole of the wafer support unit. The second exhaust line(124) is used for connecting the first exhaust line to a vacuum pump. The wafer support unit includes a wafer support region(114a) and an edge region(114b). The first exhaust line is installed under a predetermined portion of the wafer support region, wherein the predetermined portion is spaced apart from the edge region.
title: ROBOT ARM OF WAFER TRANSFER APPARATUS

abstract: A service robot operation evaluation strategy based on a discrete working space comprises two processes, namely an offline acquisition process and an online evaluation process. Wherein the online evaluation process is divided into four stages. The preparation stage is used for initializing relevant configuration. And an inner and outer layer method evaluation stage: constructing an inner layer dot matrix and an outer layer dot matrix based on the discrete working space to evaluate the operation feasibility and priority of the task area. In the key factor evaluation stage, the operation characteristics of a target object in an actual task and the operability of the robot are considered. And in the final decision-making stage, the feasible postures obtained after evaluation are arranged in a descending order according to evaluation scores, and the posture with the highest score is selected for subsequent operation. According to the strategy, operation modes are evaluated and decided by evaluating the feasibility and priority of operation postures in groups, and the evaluation strategy is expanded by taking an evaluation group as an independent stage. According to the method, robot operation evaluation and work space data can be closely combined, the problem that an existing operation evaluation strategy cannot fully use the work space data is solved, and effective evaluation of the robot on the operation task is achieved.
title: Service robot operation evaluation strategy based on discrete working space

abstract: The invention belongs to but not limited to the technical field of computer vision, and particularly relates to an end-to-end student behavior detection method and system based on a large convolution kernel, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the preprocessing of classroom video data, and obtaining the preliminary feature representation of student behaviors; a large convolution kernel backbone network is designed to carry out deep convolution operation on the extracted image features, upstream feature representation of a larger receptive field is obtained, and behavior features of different scales are fused in combination with a multi-scale feature fusion module; a coordinate attention mechanism is introduced, invalid information in the feature map is filtered, and the attention degree of the model on key behaviors is enhanced; the fused features are input into a Transform decoder, and global behavior prediction is carried out; and through constructing a joint loss function optimization model parameter, outputting a final frame-level prediction result of the classroom behavior, and accurately identifying the student behavior type in the classroom.
title: End-to-end student behavior detection method and system based on large convolution kernel

abstract: The invention provides a method and device for an anti-monitoring behavior identity system in a taxi industry. The device comprises a taxi, wherein a GPS antenna is mounted outside the taxi; a centercontrol table, a seat I, a seat II and a seat III are mounted in the taxi; a vehicle-mounted meter and vehicle-mounted terminal equipment are mounted at the top of the center control table through bolts; the vehicle-mounted terminal equipment is arranged on the side of the vehicle-mounted meter, and comprises a multimedia player and an anti-monitoring behavior identification APP; and the anti-monitoring behavior APP comprises a fault tolerance module, a taxi cover camera recognition algorithm logic module, a human face recognition algorithm resource library, and a vehicle speed monitoring module. The method and device for the anti-monitoring behavior identity system in the taxi industry are the first in the industry, through the application of an artificial intelligence algorithm and an internet of things technology to realize the interconnection and intercommunication between the vehicle-mounted terminal equipment, the vehicle-mounted camera and the taxi enterprise management platform, a brand-new anti-monitoring behavior identity system in the taxi industry is created to help taxi enterprises to move towards automation, intelligence and informatization of supervision.
title: Method and device for anti-monitoring behavior identity system in taxi industry

abstract: A conveyance system includes an in-feed conveyor for conveying a high density flow of a plurality of parcels. The system further includes a first pick conveyor configured for being selectively activated and deactivated in order to space out the plurality of parcels and turn the high density flow into a low density flow of parcels. A second pick conveyor is in series with and downstream of the first pick conveyor. The system further includes a first place conveyor and a second place conveyor in series with and downstream of the first place conveyor. A first robot is configured for transferring parcels from the first pick conveyor to the first place conveyor. A second robot is configured for transferring parcels from the second pick conveyor to the second place conveyor. As such, robots each have their own dedicated workspace and do not interfere with each other.
title: AUTOMATED MULTI-ARM ROBOTIC SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides an intelligent service robot based on 5G. The intelligent service robot based on 5G can enhance user experience, improve the spectrum resource utilization ratio, achieve real-time synchronization of data and play various roles in an airport. The intelligent robot is structured such that the intelligent service robot is arranged in the airport to store airport service businesses, and the intelligent service robot provides services to users with service needs in a D2D (equipment to equipment) mode; in a data interaction process, the intelligent service robot plays a role of a servo, users play a role of a client, and the roles of the intelligent service robot and the users cannot be interchanged; the intelligent service robot and App data of a user mobile phone are synchronized in real time; the intelligent service robot can achieve terminal interconnectivity with a plurality of users simultaneously; and the intelligent service robot can be summoned by the users bymobile phone APP software.
title: Intelligent service robot based on 5G

abstract: One or more devices, systems, methods, and storage mediums for performing robotic control and/or using support structure for avoiding/reducing buckling are provided herein. Examples include, but are not limited to, use with a continuum robot or catheter having at least one independently manipulatable, bendable section for advancement through a passage, without contacting fragile element(s) within the passage, where one or more driving wires of the robot or catheter have a support structure for driving wire kink/buckling prevention. The support structure may extend from a hub to the bendable section(s). Examples of applications include imaging, evaluating, and diagnosing biological objects, such as, but not limited to, for bronchial or other medical applications. Techniques provided herein also improve processing, imaging, and catheter control efficiency while achieving images that are more precise, and also achieve devices, systems, methods, and storage mediums that reduce mental and physical burden and improve ease of use.
title: MEDICAL APPARATUS WITH SUPPORT STRUCTURE AND METHOD OF USE THEREOF

abstract: An apparatus, system and method of operating an autonomous mobile robot having a height of at least one meter. The apparatus, system and method may include a robot body; at least two three-dimensional depth camera sensors affixed to the robot body proximate to the height, wherein the at least two three-dimensional depth camera sensors are both directed toward a major floor surface from the affixation and, in combination, comprise an at least substantially 360 degree field of view of the major floor surface around the robot body; and a processing system for receiving of data within the field of view from the at least one three-dimensional depth camera sensor, detecting the presence of a plurality of AR tags on the upper surface of the charging base, calculating a virtual alignment point associated with the center of the robot docking connector, calculating a virtual alignment point associated with the center of the charging base docking connector, and outputting a path of travel between the center of the charging base docking connector and the center of the robot docking connector, whereby a physical connection is made.
title: APPARATUS, SYSTEM, AND METHOD OF DOCKING FOR AUTONOMOUS ROBOT NAVIGATION

abstract: The invention relates to a real-time optimization operation method for an electricity-hydrogen coupling island micro-grid, belongs to the technical field of island micro-grid optimization operation, and solves the problems that a reinforcement learning method in the prior art is insufficient in intelligent agent division and cooperation capability in the process of controlling an electricity-hydrogen coupling system and is difficult to adapt to individual differences of complex power grid environments. Comprising the steps of obtaining historical data of an island micro-grid, and then generating a first sample data set; training an output prediction model based on the first sample data set to obtain an optimal output prediction model, and then generating a second sample data set; constructing a power grid multi-agent model; training the power grid multi-agent model based on a second sample data set to obtain an optimal power grid multi-agent model; and obtaining historical data and current data of the current island micro-grid, and then controlling each device based on the optimal output prediction model and the power grid multi-agent model, thereby realizing real-time optimization operation of the island micro-grid.
title: Real-time optimization operation method of electricity-hydrogen coupling island micro-grid

abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for position and posture control of a surgical robot in combination with obstacle avoidance joint limit. The method comprises the steps that 1, a mechanical arm and obstacle convex body model is established, and the shortest distance and direction between convex bodies in the model are calculated; 2, planning the speed of an end effector in real time according to the target pose and the distribution of the obstacles; and 3, controlling the movement of the surgical robot in combination with the end planning speed and the safety constraint. In order to realize safe and accurate position and attitude control of the robot, the speed of an end effector is planned for three stages in the autonomous operation of the robot, the speed is expressed as equality constraints, meanwhile, obstacle avoidance and joint limitation are expressed as inequality constraints, and a quadratic programming problem is formed by taking the minimum joint angular speed as a target function, so that the position and attitude of the robot can be accurately controlled. And finally, solving the quadratic programming problem by using the primal-dual neural network to ensure the real-time performance of the motion.
title: Method and system for controlling position and posture of surgical robot and combining obstacle avoidance joint limit

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a transfer robot motion planning method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a creation request of a transfer task; in response to the creation request, determining whether an available carrying resource meeting the carrying task exists in the carrying system at present; when available carrying resources meeting the carrying task exist, allocating exclusive target carrying resources for the carrying task; the target carrying resource comprises a position point and a carrying robot; planning a carrying path according to the position point; splitting the carrying task into a carrying sub-task sequence according to the carrying path; and the carrying subtask sequence is provided for the carrying robot to be executed. According to the embodiment of the invention, conflicts among a plurality of carrying tasks can be reduced or avoided.
title: Carrying robot motion planning method, device and equipment and storage medium

abstract: A human interface robot (100) that includes a controller (500), a camera (320, 320a, 320b, 450, 450a, 450b) in communication with the controller, and a display (310, 310a, 310b, 312) in communication with the controller. The controller displays received image data on the display as an image (1602), identifies at least one shape (1610, 1610a, 1610b) in the image, and displays a shape specific label (1620) on the image at least near the shape.
title: MOBILE HUMAN INTERFACE ROBOT

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and particularly relate to a hydraulic-driven biped robot lower limb mechanism. The hydraulic-driven biped robot lower limb mechanism comprises a trunk, aleft leg and a right leg, the left leg comprises a foot part, an ankle joint assembly, a shank, a knee joint assembly, a thigh and a hip joint assembly; the thigh is connected with the truck and theshank, the shank is hinged to the foot part, the hip joint assembly comprises a cantilever, a hip joint pitching hydraulic driving unit and a hip joint side hydraulic driving unit, the hip joint sidehydraulic driving unit is connected with the cantilever and the trunk, and the hip joint pitching hydraulic driving unit is connected with the cantilever and the thigh; and a knee joint hydraulic driving unit in the knee joint assembly is connected with the thigh and the shank; and the ankle joint assembly comprises two ankle joint hydraulic driving units which are arranged side by side, one endsof the ankle joint hydraulic driving units are hinged to a main body of the shank, and the other ends of the ankle joint hydraulic driving units are hinged to the foot part. The hydraulic-driven bipedrobot lower limb mechanism solves the problems that in the prior art, a motor-driven robot is small in moving speed, lacking of explosive force and difficult to adapt to complicated terrains.
title: Hydraulic-driven biped robot lower limb mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses adjustable artificial intelligence image recognition equipment, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The adjustable artificial intelligence image recognition equipment comprises a stand column, the upper surface of the stand column is provided with a groove, the groove is internally provided with a rack, the rack is engaged with a gear, the back of the gear is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the outer surface of the rotating shaft is sleeved with a bearing, the bearing is clamped to the back face of the stand column, and the upper surface of the rack is fixedly connected with a mounting plate. According to the adjustable artificial intelligence image recognition equipment, by arranging the rack, the gear, a rotating shaft and a rotating disc, when a worker needs to lower the height of a face recognition equipment body, the worker firstly rotates the rotating disc reversely, so that the rotating disc drives the gear to rotate through the rotating shaft, the gear drives the rack to move downwards, the rack drives a first sliding block to move downwards in a first sliding groove, and the worker can easily lower the height of the face recognition equipment body according to the height of the worker.
title: Adjustable artificial intelligence image recognition equipment

abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm control method, control module and device based on force feedback and a mechanical arm. Spatial position information of the mechanical arm and a mechanical arm operation area is collected according to a preset sampling frequency; for any sampling moment, state information of the mechanical arm in the mechanical arm operation area at the sampling moment is determined based on the spatial position information and a Kalman filtering algorithm; based on the state information, the input target position, an A star algorithm and a reinforcement learning algorithm, a target motion path of the mechanical arm at the sampling moment is determined; generating a mechanical arm control signal based on the target motion path and sending the mechanical arm control signal to the mechanical arm; and based on the state information of the sampling moment, the target motion path of the previous sampling moment and a force feedback control algorithm, a force feedback signal of the mechanical arm at the sampling moment is determined and sent to a force feedback module, so that the force feedback module outputs corresponding feedback force. In this way, through real-time motion path planning and force feedback control, the control accuracy of the mechanical arm can be improved.
title: Mechanical arm control method, control module and device based on force feedback and mechanical arm

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of clean energy, and provides an active power distribution network energy storage scheduling method based on imitation reinforcement learning, which is characterized by comprising the following specific steps: S1, constructing a power distribution network power flow optimization model, mathematical models of all modules and corresponding constraints; s2, constructing an energy storage scheduling problem of the power distribution network as a Markov decision process, and defining a corresponding state space, an action space and a reward function; s3, performing linearization processing on nonlinear terms in the power flow optimization model of the power distribution network, and converting an original power flow optimization problem into a mixed integer linear programming problem; and S4, solving the mixed integer linear programming problem by using a commercial solver to obtain a series of state action pairs with an expert guidance function, and storing the state action pairs in an expert database. Therefore, the energy storage scheduling calculation efficiency is improved.
title: Active power distribution network energy storage scheduling method and system based on imitation reinforcement learning

abstract: The invention discloses a seabed garbage cleaning robot. The robot comprises a box body structure, grabbing structures, foot structures, step-by-step transferring and conveying devices and a sensor; the mechanical grabbing part adopts a multi-joint mechanical arm, so that the freedom degree is flexible; aiming at the underwater grabbing stability, the design of a grabbing mechanical arm adopts theform of a three-jaw structure and a suction fan matched to work, so that the grabbing stability is improved; and mechanical feet adopt three degrees of freedom and multi-connection rod structures, rotation of a horizontal plane and rotation of two vertical planes to realize gait movement of the mechanical feet; according to the seabed garbage cleaning robot, elastic structures are added at foot ends, so that buffer is provided for the robot when the robot loses balance and falls due to disturbance underwater, the robot can adapt to complex terrains, and the stability of the robot is increased; the step-by-step transferring devices are provided for the design of a storage device for garbage in the box body, so that a plurality of working periods can be carried out at one time; and meanwhile, the limitation of the appearance and size of the robot on the total amount of grabbing garbage is broken, so that the garbage cleaning efficiency is improved.
title: Seabed garbage cleaning robot

abstract: The invention relates to a movable robot based on a paper folding structure and a snake-like robot. The movable robot comprises a motion module, a front load module and a rear load module; the motion module comprises a folding outer pipe and at least two folding inner pipes which are arranged in the folding outer pipe and are of the paper folding structure; the front load module and the rear load module are provided with one-way wheels; one or both of the front load module and the rear load module are provided with a drive module; the drive module is connected with the ends of the folding inner pipes; and synchronous or asynchronous torsion control over all the folding inner pipes is achieved through the drive module, and the movable robot can conduct peristaltic displacement in a specific posture. Compared with the prior art, the bionic robot capable of flexibly moving is designed through the folding tubular structure, the designed bionic robot can achieve stretching and bending motion under the drive of shape memory alloy or a motor, the overall size is smaller, the weight is lower, the drive efficiency is higher, and the effective load ratio is larger.
title: Movable robot based on paper folding structure and snake-like robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a behavior prediction method and system based on a generative visual large model. The method comprises the steps of collecting human body action video data, and extracting human body behavior action data; preprocessing the data; constructing a generative visual large model, performing feature extraction, and performing time sequence analysis by using a long-short-term memory network; performing end-to-end training, calculating a loss function, and obtaining a personnel behavior prediction model; and outputting prediction results of the human body behavior actions in a plurality of future time frames. According to the method, high-level features can be extracted by adopting the generative visual model, so that the efficiency and accuracy of feature extraction are improved; a long-short-term memory network is adopted to perform time sequence analysis on the feature vectors, so that the accuracy and stability of action prediction are improved, the dynamic change of the action can be captured, and the future action trend can be predicted; the performance of the whole model can be optimized by adopting an end-to-end training method, the efficiency and robustness are improved, and the method adapts to variable practical application environments.
title: Generative visual large model-based behavior prediction method and system

abstract: A method for use with an industrial robot comprises: searching a plurality of first possible positions of the industrial robot within a first area with a first searching step, wherein the industrial robot is configured to operate at the plurality of first possible positions; obtaining a performance parameter of the industrial robot at each of the plurality of first possible positions, the performance parameter being indicative to evaluate the performance of the industrial robot; searching a plurality of second possible positions of the industrial robot within a second area with a second searching step based on the performance parameter at each of the plurality of first possible positions, wherein the second searching step is smaller than the first searching step and the second area is within the first area; and presenting the performance parameter of the industrial robot at each of the plurality of the first and/or second possible positions. The user may determine the optimal tool assembly direction in a convenient way.
title: METHOD AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR USE WITH INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a multifunctional radar interference decision network coding method, which is based on the thought of mapping single-valued linear data codes to a high-dimensional nonlinear space to enhance the feature representation capability of data and improve the network fitting capability, and comprises the following steps of: designing a variational auto-encoder to carry out state coding to unify the input dimension; compared with the prior art, the learning and convergence speed is improved. In addition, a multifunctional radar interference decision generally lacks prior information in practical application, an unknown distribution function, an unknown transition probability and an unknown state space enable a reward function and a discount factor of reinforcement learning to be difficult to design, and some actions which are harmful for a short time but beneficial for a long time are difficult to learn. In order to solve the problem, a forward experience feedback mechanism is designed, and an experience accumulation reward return function is optimized by modifying an experience time sequence. Compared with the existing method, the method provided by the invention improves the network robustness under the condition of not reducing the learning speed.
title: Multifunctional radar interference decision network coding method

abstract: The invention discloses a precision-operation truss robot based on force feedback and a control method thereof. The precision-operation truss robot comprises a truss, a suspension arm and a clamping manipulator, wherein the truss is fixedly arranged on the ground and provided with a movable suspension beam, the axial direction of the suspension beam is a first direction, and the suspension beam can move in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction; the suspension arm is movably arranged on the suspension beam and is telescopic; the clamping manipulator is arranged at the lower end of the suspension arm and comprises a fixed clamping plate, a movable clamping plate and a drive mechanism, the fixed clamping plate is vertically fixed, the drive mechanism is arranged opposite to the fixed clamping plate, the movable clamping plate is arranged on the drive mechanism, is parallel to the fixed clamping plate and is driven by the drive mechanism to approach to or depart from the fixed clamping plate; and a pressure sensor is arranged on the movable clamping plate, and a distance sensor facing downwards is arranged on the movable clamping plate. By adoption of the precision-operation truss robot based on force feedback and the control method thereof, it is guaranteed that vulnerable objects in irregular shapes are safely grabbed and carried to the maximum extent.
title: Precision-operation truss robot based on force feedback and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a machine room inspection robot and an inspection method thereof, and relates to the technical field of machine room inspection, and the machine room inspection robot comprises a robot body, and a positioning module, a control module, a navigation module, a driving module and an identification camera module which are deployed on the robot body; the positioning module positions the position of the robot body in real time; an inspection map, an inspection route and inspection points are arranged in the control module, and the control module is used for acquiring the real-time position of the robot body and issuing an inspection task; the navigation module selects an inspection route according to the inspection task, and the control module controls the driving module according to the selected inspection route, so that the robot body moves along the inspection route and passes through all inspection points; the recognition camera module recognizes equipment at the inspection point and shoots the recognized equipment in real time; the control module stores a picture that the machine room equipment is in a safe state, identifies the machine room equipment with potential safety hazards in the video through calculation, and informs maintenance personnel of the machine room equipment. The inspection efficiency and accuracy can be improved.
title: Machine room inspection robot and inspection method thereof

abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for implementing a control system of selecting an action to be performed by a reinforcement learning agent, based on an observation characterizing a current state of an environment. The control system is trained based on a distribution of neural network model parameters derived using a database of previous experiences in the environment.
title: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING USING EPISTEMIC VALUE ESTIMATION

abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a robot system which can connect peripheral equipment without entering an operation scope of a robot movable part. CONSTITUTION:A robot controller 20 has data communication interface therein, and the data communication interface is connected to a relay 60 mounted on a safety fence 50 via a connection cable 40. A connector for connecting a data communication cable 44 is provided in the relay 60. Transmitter and receivers 62, 63, 65 are connected to peripheral equipment such as a programmable logic controller(PLC) 33 and personal computers 31, 32 via data communication cables 42, 43, 45. A data communication cable 44 connected to a transmitter and receiver 64 is connected to the relay 60 so that the robot controller 20 is connected to a network.
title: ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: The present invention relates to a follow robot system for a smart farm which is interlocked with a control server (300) connected using a wireless communication network. The follow robot system for a smart farm comprises: a harvesting device (100) stacking a container box (B) containing harvested agricultural products on a harvesting container box stacker (130); and a distribution device (200) receiving the container boxes (B) stacked on the harvesting container box stacker (130) from the rear and stacking the same on a distribution container box stacker (230). In addition, transmission and reception units (101, 201) are installed in the harvesting device (100) and the distribution device (200), respectively, and wirelessly interlocked with a control server (300) in real time to operate and control a function. The harvesting device (100) detects a distance from a worker harvesting the agricultural products and moves around the worker while maintaining a certain distance, and the distribution device (200) approaches the rear of the harvesting device (100) to automatically receive the container box (B). Accordingly, efficiency of harvesting the agricultural products by the worker is improved.
title: FOLLOW ROBOT SYSTEM FOR SMART FARM

abstract: The invention discloses an object recognition method and device based on ultrasonic echoes and a storage medium, and is applied to a computer vision technology of artificial intelligence. Transmitting an ultrasonic signal to the to-be-identified object through a sound wave transmitting device of the terminal; receiving an echo signal reflected by the object to be identified through a sound wave receiving device; extracting ultrasonic echo features of the echo signals; carrying out feature dimension conversion on the ultrasonic echo features to obtain target dimension features; and performing face translation processing to obtain face image information corresponding to the to-be-recognized object. Therefore, the object recognition process based on the ultrasonic signal is realized, the echo signal based on the ultrasonic signal corresponds to the to-be-recognized object, so that the object recognition process is suitable for different scenes, the accuracy of object recognition is ensured, and the security of the terminal is improved.
title: Object recognition method and device based on ultrasonic echoes and storage medium

abstract: Tensor decomposition can be advantageous for compressing deep neural networks (DNNs). In many applications of DNNs, reducing the number of parameters and computation workload is helpful to accelerate inference speed in deployment. Modern DNNs comprise multiple layers with multi-array weights where tensor decomposition is a natural way to perform compression-in which the weight tensors in convolutional layers or fully-connected layers are decomposed with specified tensor ranks (e.g., canonical ranks, tensor train ranks). Conventional tensor decomposition with DNNs involves selecting ranks manually, which requires tedious human efforts to finetune the performance. Accordingly, presented herein are rank selection embodiments, which are inspired by reinforcement learning, to automatically select ranks in tensor decomposition. Experimental results validate that the learning-based rank selection embodiments significantly outperform hand-crafted rank selection heuristics on a number of tested datasets, for the purpose of effectively compressing deep neural networks while maintaining comparable accuracy.
title: RANK SELECTION IN TENSOR DECOMPOSITION BASED ON REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FOR DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS

abstract: The invention discloses a shaving board target detection system and detection method based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a shaving board defect sample image data set; defining the state and action space of the Agent; designing a data set loader, and building a framework of a deep reinforcement learning target detection model; designing a target detection evaluation index and a reward function; and training a deep reinforcement learning target detection model by using the divided target detection data set, and selecting an optimal deep reinforcement learning target detection model in combination with a target detection evaluation index. According to the method, deep reinforcement learning is used, continuous morphological transformation is carried out on an initial candidate rectangular frame, and target defect position detection is completed; the method can act on the defect position detection task of the shaving board image, the calculation complexity is reduced, the self-adaptive detection capability is high, and the detection accuracy is high.
title: Shaving board target detection system and detection method based on deep reinforcement learning

abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for disinfecting and processing a collection robot collecting medical waste created in a negative-pressure hospital room or the like. The apparatus comprises: a medical waste collection robot having a collection container holding medical waste to collect and hold medical waste and a driving mechanism to autonomously drive the collection container; and a disinfection processor having a deck on which the collection robot is mounted and a sterilization/disinfection device distributing disinfectant to the collection robot mounted on the deck and emitting ultraviolet light for sterilization. The collection robot and the disinfection processor have a structure with an electric signal transceiver communicating by sending and receiving electric signals. The apparatus of the present invention safely disinfects and processes a robot for collection through the disinfection processor before the collection robot leaves a negative-pressure isolation room as the collection robot collects medical waste discharged from the room to leave the room to prevent problems such as contamination or secondary infection of surroundings caused by the robot for medical waste collection.
title: An apparatus for disinfecting a medical robot for transporting medical waste

abstract: The invention provides a robot joint which comprises a driving device used for providing driving force; the harmonic reducer comprises a wave generator, and the driving device is connected to the wave generator so as to transmit driving force to the harmonic reducer; the shell part forms at least part of the outer surface of the robot joint, and the driving device and the harmonic reducer are both arranged in the shell part; one end of the transmission shaft is used for receiving the driving force of the driving device, the other end of the transmission shaft is connected to a wave generator of the harmonic reducer, and the transmission shaft is rotatably supported on the shell part through a first bearing.
title: Robot joint

abstract: A motion target direction angle obtaining method and a robot using the same. The method includes: creating an absolute coordinate system, and obtaining an absolute position coordinate of at least one point after the first point in the absolute coordinate system; creating a relative coordinate system with the first point as an origin, and obtaining a relative position coordinate corresponding to the at least one point In the relative coordinate system; calculating matrix parameters of a transformation matrix based on the absolute position coordinate of the at least one point and the relative position coordinate corresponding to the at least one point; and determining a direction angle of the motion target at the first point based on the matrix parameters. Combines an absolute portioning method and a relative positioning method to calculate the direction angle.
title: Motion target direction angle obtaining method, apparatus and robot using the same

abstract: The invention discloses a stable multi-degree-of-freedom holder which comprises a base, a yaw axis mechanism, a pitch axis mechanism and a vertical lifting mechanism. The invention further discloses a mobile robot. The mobile robot comprises the stable multi-degree-of-freedom holder. The device has the beneficial effects that the whole vertical stable mechanism is simulated into a second-order damping system comprising a virtual spring and a virtual damper, and different damping ratios and resonant frequencies can be obtained by adjusting different parameters, so that interference caused by the environment is effectively dealt with, and the stability of the device is improved. And the influence on the load during running on a low bumpy road surface is effectively reduced, and the advantage of relatively good stability is achieved.
title: Stable multi-degree-of-freedom holder and mobile robot with same

abstract: The invention relates to an indoor intelligent distribution service robot, and effectively solves the problems that the distribution efficiency is inconvenient to improve, and a special auxiliary person needs to place an article on a corresponding part or take down the article from the upper part, so that the article is inconvenient to distribute; according to the technical scheme, the indoor intelligent distribution service robot is provided with a transverse bracket assembly, a first limiting mechanism, a placement frame and a second limiting mechanism, so that articles needing to be distributed can be conveniently placed on the placement frames of different heights or taken out of the placement frames and moved to the height where people can take the articles conveniently; the work intensity of delivery personnel is relieved, the first limiting mechanism and the second limiting mechanism can protect articles placed on the transverse bracket assembly and the placement frames, the articles are prevented from sliding off when the robot moves, the safety during article delivery is guaranteed, multiple articles can be delivered at the same time through the arrangement of the multiple placement frames, and the labor intensity of the delivery personnel is reduced. And the distribution efficiency is effectively improved.
title: Indoor intelligent distribution service robot

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a snake arm robot, which includes: a base disk; a rotary unit rotatably connected to the base disk and having multiple sub-disks sequentially arranged in a predetermined arrangement direction and rotatably connected to each other; a wire connector having multiple wires connected to the base disk or a plurality of disks selected from the sub-disks and sequentially disposed in the arrangement direction or disposed to partially face each other in a circumferential direction of the sub-disks; and a wire operator operating the wires to rotate the sub-disks by a predetermined angle.According to the snake arm robot of the present disclosure, since wires connected to disks to rotate the disks are arranged in a similar type to the muscle structure of a nematode, there is the advantage that rigidity and payload are increased.
title: SNAKE ARM ROBOT

abstract: The present invention provides a method for determining an action policy using a plurality of agents, which is to determine an optimal action policy. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method comprises the steps of: acquiring a first reception characteristic information value extracted from sensory information observed by a first agent among a plurality of agents and representing characteristic information required for determining action of the first agent; acquiring a plurality of reception characteristic information values extracted from sensory information observed by each of the agents and representing characteristic information observed by each of the agents; determining a weight of each of a plurality of pieces of sensor information based on the first reception characteristic information and a plurality of pieces of transmission characteristic information; and determining the action of the first agent through a state action value function artificial intelligence neural network previously learning reward information of the actions calculated by a state action value function based on the plurality of pieces of sensor information and the weight corresponding to each of the environments.
title: Apparatus and method for action policy using multi-agent

abstract: The invention provides a distribution decision-making method for unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary cache content in an emergency scene. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring scene information in the emergency scene; performing iterative training according to the scene information and a reinforcement learning algorithm to determine a parameter network model; wherein the reinforcement learning algorithm is an algorithm formed according to a strategy network and an evaluation network; making a decision according to the scene information and the parameter network model, and determining scene strategy parameters of the emergency scene; wherein the scene strategy parameter is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle in the emergency scene to work. According to the technical scheme, the parameter network model is determined through iterative training of the algorithm and the real-time scene information of the emergency scene, the scene information of the emergency scene is predicted based on the parameter network model, the current scene strategy parameter of the emergency scene is determined, and the unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary cache content is subjected to distribution decision making based on the scene strategy parameter. The working efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the working process is improved, and the communication delay of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the emergency scene is effectively reduced.
title: Distribution decision-making method for unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary cache content in emergency scene

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of injection molding manipulators, in particular to an intelligent injection molding manipulator. The injection molding manipulator comprises a rear frame plate, a supporting mechanism is arranged in the middle of one side of the rear frame plate, a mounting plate is vertically arranged on the other side of the rear frame plate, the mounting plate and the rear frame plate are connected through a transverse driving mechanism, a fixing frame is horizontally connected to the side, away from the rear frame plate, of the mounting plate, two reinforcing plates are connected between one end of the bottom of the fixing frame and the mounting plate, dovetail sliding plates are horizontally connected to the two sides of the exterior of the fixing frame, sliding sleeves are slidably arranged on the outer sides of the dovetail sliding plates in a sleeving mode, a sliding base is fixedly mounted between the tops of the two sliding sleeves, a longitudinal driving mechanism is arranged between the sliding base and the fixing frame, and an adsorption clamping mechanism is arranged at the bottom of a cross-shaped bottom plate. The injection molding manipulator has an automatic suction and suction clamping function, and compared with the prior art, an air supply device is omitted, so that the manufacturing cost is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the working efficiency is improved.
title: Intelligent injection molding manipulator

abstract: The invention specifically discloses a wall-climbing detection robot, belonging to the field of mechanical automation engineering. According to the invention a driving wheel part and a driven wheel assembly are respectively installed on the front and rear ends of a flat plate located at the bottom of a vehicle; the driving wheel part is connected with a driving motor through a transmission device;a video detection system is installed on the front end of the flat plate located at the bottom of the vehicle; a flaw detection and thickness detection system is located behind the video detection system and comprises a detection dead plate, an elastic supporting assembly, a thickness gauge assembly and a magnetic particle detector; the detection dead plate is connected with the flat plate located at the bottom of the vehicle through the elastic supporting assembly and is extendable and retractable relative to the flat plate located at the bottom of the vehicle; the thickness gauge assembly and the magnetic particle detector separately penetrate the flat plate located at the bottom of the vehicle and are then installed on the detection dead plate; and the magnetic particle detector alwaysadheres to a detection plane with the expansion and retraction of the detection dead plate. The wall-climbing detection robot of the invention can accomplish the task of surface detection of equipment in the case that an operator is away from a detection site; a wheeled mobile platform is employed, so the wall-climbing detection robot can perform detection, inspection and other operations on complex working interfaces such as curved and arc interfaces.
title: Wall-climbing detection robot

abstract: The robotic end-effector system comprises a mounting bracket assembly attached to a manipulator arm of a robot. A dual shaft motor is attached to the mounting bracket assembly. The motor has first and second rotatable output shafts. The first shaft is for mounting an encoder for providing position data. A mechanical drive mechanism is connected to the motor and to the mounting bracket assembly. The mechanical drive mechanism converts rotational motion of the second output shaft to translational motion. A passive compliance system is connected to the mechanical drive mechanism. A load sensor system is supported by the compliance system for providing force data. An end-effector end piece is connected to the load sensor system. A closed loop computer control system is in communication with the motor for processing the position data and the force data for providing micro positioning of the end-effector end piece and for providing an active system compliance, thereby achieving the desired end-effector function.
title: Robotic end-effector with active system compliance and micro-positioning capability

abstract: Provided is a robot including: a wrist unit that has a tool attached to a distal end face thereof and that changes the orientation of the tool, the tool performing work on a work target device secured to an installation surface; and a movable unit that changes the three-dimensional position of the wrist unit. The movable unit includes an arm that has a longitudinal axis and the wrist unit is attached to the distal end thereof, and a visual sensor that has a field of view oriented in a direction intersecting the longitudinal axis of the arm is attached to the a position closer to the base end than the distal end face of the wrist unit is.
title: Robot and robot system

abstract: The invention discloses a mobile robot sudden stop response time testing method and system. The test method comprises the following steps: installing an acceleration sensor, a force sensor and an emergency stop switch automatic pressing device at corresponding positions of a to-be-tested robot, and carrying out calibration; setting an emergency stop test speed of the to-be-tested robot, and controlling the to-be-tested robot to move; values collected by the acceleration sensor are analyzed, and whether the motion of the robot reaches a stable state or not is judged; an emergency stop pressing signal is triggered, an emergency stop switch automatic pressing device is controlled to press an emergency stop switch, a data acquisition signal is triggered, and data of an acceleration sensor and a force sensor are acquired and stored; and aligning and analyzing the collected and stored data of the acceleration sensor and the force sensor to obtain the sudden stop response time of the to-be-tested robot. According to the method, the sudden stop switch is controlled to be automatically pressed, data of the pressing process and the sudden stop movement process of the robot are collected, and accurate sudden stop corresponding time is obtained through analysis.
title: Mobile robot sudden stop response time testing method and system

abstract: The invention provides an efficient path planning method based on scene understanding and an AMR robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a standard transportation path of a material transportation task, carrying out the material transportation task according to the standard transportation path, determining an occurrence place of a traffic retardation event when the traffic retardation event is detected in a material transportation process, and carrying out the execution of the material transportation task according to the determined occurrence place. Performing congestion scene analysis on the occurrence place of the traffic blocking event, and judging whether the traffic blocking event is a path congestion event according to a congestion scene analysis result, the path congestion event being that the current transportation path cannot pass, the method comprises the following steps of: when an event that materials cannot be delivered to a target location within a time limit required range is detected, or the passing time is too long, and when the passing blocking event is a path blocking event, re-executing transportation path planning on the material transportation task, so that the reliability and timeliness of material transportation in a hospital can be fully ensured, and the transportation efficiency of the hospital is improved.
