And efficient and reliable material transportation capability support is provided for each functional module of a hospital.
title: Efficient path planning method based on scene understanding and AMR robot

abstract: A mobile collaborative robot includes a force sensor which is provided on a robot support on a carriage, a robot information acquisition unit which acquires robot information including posture information of the robot main body and load information of a load acting on the robot main body, a force calculation unit which calculates the external force acting on the robot support based on the robot information, and a judgment unit which judges that the mobile collaborative robot has come into contact with a human when a difference between the external force detected by the force sensor and the external force calculated by the force calculation unit is above a predetermined value α or when a difference between the amount of change in the detected external force and the amount of change in the calculated external force is above a predetermined value α1.
title: Mobile collaborative robot

abstract: The invention discloses an ROS-based multifunctional intelligent medical service robot system. The ROS-based multifunctional intelligent medical service robot system comprises a main control module and a bottom layer control module which are connected through a communication module, and a power supply module for supplying power to the main control module and the bottom layer control module separately, wherein the main control module comprises a visual SLAM module and a laser SLAM module; the main control module is connected with a depth camera and a laser radar separately; the depth camera obtains three-dimensional information of a surrounding environment and uploads the three-dimensional information of the surrounding environment to the main control module; the main control module converts the three-dimensional information into a sparse point cloud picture through the visual SLAM module, and then converts the sparse point cloud picture into a 2D grid picture; the laser radar obtains distance values of the surrounding environment and uploads the distance values of the surrounding environment to each main control module; and the main control module constructs a laser local map through the laser SLAM module, carries out map fusion by adopting an improved Bayesian rule, and carries out path planning on the basis of the fused map.
title: ROS-based multifunctional intelligent medical service robot system

abstract: The invention discloses a guide robot path planning control system and a control method thereof, belongs to the technical field of guide robots, and aims to solve the problems that multiple robots cannot be controlled at the same time, singleness is achieved, obstacle avoidance and resetting of the robots are inconvenient in the control process, and the control effect is poor in the prior art. According to the guide robot path planning control system, a background server, a signal connection antenna and robot terminals are arranged, and the robot terminals are remotely controlled; According to the guide robot path planning control system, multiple groups of robot terminals are controlled by one group of background server, the number of system control units is N, all system control units correspond to different robot terminals, the different robot terminals have different identification code groups, and the identification code groups are respectively input by using an identification code input module; and in other words, one group of background server can control the multiple groups of robot terminals, the identification code groups generated by the matched robot terminals have uniqueness, the system control units do not interfere with one another, namely, the multiple groups of robot terminals do not interfere with one another, and operation is convenient.
title: Guide robot path planning control system and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a robot for indoor transformer substation routing inspection. The robot comprises a cylindrical robot body capable of freely moving in any direction and rotating in situ, a lifting rod is arranged at the top of the robot body, and a lifting motor is arranged in the lifting rod. A camera is arranged at the top of the lifting rod, the lifting motor and the camera are both connected with a PLC, and the PLC is provided with a wireless local area network interface. The outer circumferential wall of the robot body is provided with a double-layer electrode and an insulation cover located above the double-layer electrode, and the length of the insulation cover is larger than that of the double-layer electrode. The robot for indoor transformer substation routing inspection has the technical effects that the robot adapts to the characteristic of the narrow space of an indoor transformer substation, collision between the robot and equipment in the substation can be avoided, and the operation condition of the indoor transformer substation can be subjected to image collection.
title: Robot for indoor transformer substation routing inspection

abstract: The invention discloses a device for improving the hip joint extension assisting efficiency of a flexible exoskeleton robot. The device comprises a base, the cam-like pressing rod mechanisms, a rotating block, a telescopic rod outer sleeve, a telescopic rod inner rod, a telescopic rod limiting screw, a telescopic rod locking sleeve and a Bowden cable guide pipe. One end of the rotating block is installed in the base through one cam-like pressing rod mechanism, the other end of the rotating block is connected with one end of the telescopic rod outer sleeve, and the other end of the telescopic rod outer sleeve sleeves one end of the telescopic rod inner rod; the telescopic rod locking sleeve sleeves the joint of the telescopic rod outer sleeve and the telescopic rod inner rod, a radial through hole is formed at the tail end of the other end of the telescopic rod inner rod, and the Bowden cable guide pipe is mounted in the radial through hole through a positioning screw. According to thedevice, the angle between a Bowden cable and the thigh is increased, the power assisting efficiency is improved, and the safety is higher.
title: Device for improving hip joint extension assisting efficiency of flexible exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a nursing bed based on near-infrared active stereoscopic vision and brain wave technology and a method thereof. The nursing bed comprises a near-infrared active stereoscopic vision module, a brain wave control module and an autonomous nursing module. A master control system of the autonomous nursing module is connected with the near-infrared active stereoscopic vision module, the brain wave control module, a bed board, a table board and a mechanical arm respectively. The master control system controls the movement of the bed plate, the table plate and the mechanical armaccording to the spatial positions and postures of the nursed nose and mouth, the tail end of the mechanical arm and an object to be grabbed and brain wave signals; and the master control system of the autonomous nursing module performs heart rate detection according to near-infrared face video images of a nursed person. Free, convenient and dignity care is provided for disabled patients, the common needs of doctors and patients are met, human resources of hospitals are liberated, and the working efficiency of hospital nursing is improved.
title: Nursing bed based on near-infrared active stereoscopic vision and brain wave technology and method thereof

abstract: An autonomous vehicle and methods of using same is disclosed. The vehicle includes one or more sensors (102, 103, 104, 105, 106) arranged on at least one of a dashboard (110), a roof (112), and a center console of the vehicle, or one or more image capturing devices (6) for capturing one or more images from a left side and a right side of the vehicle. The vehicle may also include an electronic control unit (ECU) (220) configured to communicate with the one or more sensors (102, 103, 104, 105, 106) or the one or more image capturing devices (6), and at least one of a morphing surface (236), a windshield display, and one or more displays (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 900) configured to be controlled by the ECU (220).
title: AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES AND METHODS OF USING SAME

abstract: The invention relates to a constellation design method and device based on evolutionary reinforcement learning, equipment and a memory. The method comprises the following steps: converting a constellation design task problem into a multi-satellite earth observation task planning problem; modeling a multi-satellite earth observation task planning problem into a multi-target combinatorial optimization problem; a double-layer circulation model of a double-layer architecture based on a multi-target genetic algorithm and a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm is adopted to solve a multi-target combinatorial optimization problem, and a constellation deployment design scheme is optimized; the double-layer circulation model is used for realizing task planning of dynamic target observation through inner-layer circulation based on multi-agent reinforcement learning and feeding back awards and loss of a mobile network to outer-layer circulation; through outer layer circulation based on a multi-target genetic algorithm, a group of satellite constellation parameters which are maximum in return and minimum in loss and meet constraint conditions are searched as a target, and a constellation deployment design scheme is optimized. According to the method, the scheme design efficiency and the representation capability of the time window data are improved.
title: Constellation design method and device based on evolutionary reinforcement learning, equipment and memory

abstract: The invention discloses a flexible wrist joint for a robot. The flexible wrist joint comprises a shell, an end cover and a floating block. A cavity is formed in the shell, and the shell is provided with an input opening communicated with the cavity and used for external pneumatic or hydraulic equipment. The end cover is fixedly connected with an opening of the cavity of the shell, an open groove is formed in the end cover, and a plurality of grooves are formed in the side, towards the interior of the cavity, of the end cover. A sealed cavity is formed between the floating block and the shell,the floating block comprises a sleeve ring and a movable body, the sleeve ring is arranged in the cavity, is attached to the inner wall of the shell and is in axial sliding connection with the shell.The inner wall of the sleeve ring is arranged to be spherical. One end of the movable body stretches into the sleeve ring, the end stretching into the sleeve ring is matched with the shape of the inner wall of the sleeve ring to be spherical, the other end of the movable body stretches out of the end cover from the open groove, a movable clearance is reserved between the movable end and the open groove, a plurality of thimbles matched with the grooves are arranged on the movable body, and the inner diameter of the grooves is larger than the outer diameter of the thimbles. The flexible wrist joint can move to multiple freedom degrees.
title: Flexible wrist joint for robot and robot

abstract: The present invention provides a pipe inspection apparatus having a reduced weight and volume and capable of efficiently inspecting the inside of the pipe. A pipe inspection robot for inspecting defects inside the pipe according to one aspect of the present invention includes: a support frame extendable in a longitudinal direction; a first driving part coupled to one end of the support frame in the longitudinal direction and having a plurality of first wheels; and a second driving part coupled to the other end of the support frame in the longitudinal direction and having a plurality of second wheels. The first driving part further includes a sensor module in which a sensor for detecting a defect by magnetic force is installed, and driving motors for rotating the first wheels are installed in the first wheels so that the first driving part that travels by itself can detect a defect.
title: PIPE INSPECTION ROBOT AND PIPE INSPECTION METHOD USING THE SAME

abstract: The invention relates to a guide rail type stair climbing and old people helping shared robot, belongs to the field of old people helping mechanical equipment technology and community intelligent infrastructure construction, and the manned stair climbing robot is put and used in a corridor of a community building based on a sharing mode. The robot is composed of a guide rail, a rack, auxiliary parts, an advancing mechanism, a butt joint mechanism and a climbing mechanism. The guide rail is fixedly erected on a wall body on one side, close to a wall, of a corridor; the rack is a basic frame of the robot, and a main body is used for bearing and protecting a single user; the accessory parts comprise electronic parts and a storage battery of the robot; the advancing mechanism is composed of four Mecanum wheels and matched motors of the Mecanum wheels and is responsible for driving the robot to move on the flat ground and the corridor platform. The butt joint mechanism comprises a lead screw installed on one side of the robot, and a butt joint sleeve specially designed is used for achieving butt joint of the robot and the guide rail. The climbing mechanism comprises a gear and a climbing motor and is used for providing movement for the robot to advance on the guide rail.
title: Guide rail type stair climbing and old people helping shared robot

abstract: The invention relates to an automatic marching robot system. The automatic marching robot system comprises an upper computer, a moving robot equipped with a GPS module and a communication peripheral which is used for transferring information between the upper computer and the moving robot. The upper computer is used for receiving an automatic patrol route, generating a discrete route sequence containing longitude and latitude information according to the automatic patrol route and sending the discrete route sequence to the moving robot; and the moving robot achieves one-by-one point-to-point marching by taking self position collected by the GPS module as a current position and taking the discrete route sequence as a target position. The automatic marching robot system is achieved at a low cost, mechanical arms are container for controlling and achieving grabbing action, and the automatic marching robot system faces a civilian intelligent patrol monitoring market. According to the robot, on the basis of the creeper truck design, more complex terrains such as stairs and slopes can be overcome, and the automatic marching robot system can effectively respond to outdoor marching tasks of special occasions such as factories, schools, communities and parks.
title: Automatic marching robot system

abstract: An autonomous mobile object control method according to the present disclosure is a method for controlling an autonomous mobile object that controls a drive unit for moving the body thereof, the method comprising: a first step for determining an approach path that is a path of the autonomous mobile object to a start point outside an elevator and controlling the drive unit so as to move the body according to the approach path; and a second step for determining a boarding path that is a path of the autonomous mobile object from the start point to an end point inside the elevator and controlling the drive unit so as to move the body according to the boarding path.
title: AUTONOMOUS MOBILE OBJECT CONTROL METHOD

abstract: Proposed is a mobile robot capable of learning risk-aware traversability via accumulated navigation experience. The mobile robot includes a point cloud sensor which acquires point cloud data, an elevation map generation part which generates a grid-based elevation map by using the point cloud data, an attribute data generation part which calculates a plurality of types of terrain attribute values for each of grid cells from the elevation map and generates attribute data sets having the plurality of types of terrain attribute values for each of the grid cells, a training data generation part which generates a plurality of traversability training data sets and a plurality of non-traversability training data sets by labeling whether each of the attribute data sets is in traversable condition, a risk calculation part which calculates a traversal risk, and a risk-aware self-training part which trains a traversability evaluation model for traversability evaluation through self-training.
title: MOBILE ROBOT CAPABLE OF LEARNING RISK-AWARE TRAVERSABILITY VIA ACCUMULATED NAVIGATION EXPERIENCE

abstract: The invention provides a planar multi-degree-of-freedom three-legged piezoelectric robot and a driving method.The planar multi-degree-of-freedom three-legged piezoelectric robot comprises a robot base body, a plurality of driving feet are distributed on the lower surface of the robot base body in an annular array mode, the ends, away from the robot base body, of the driving feet make contact with the ground, and each driving foot is provided with a plurality of sets of inertia driving piezoelectric ceramics; each group of inertia driving piezoelectric ceramics is respectively mounted on the side walls of one ends, close to the center of the robot base body and far away from the center of the robot base body, of the driving feet, and the inertia driving piezoelectric ceramics are used for being externally connected with alternating current voltage, so that the inertia driving piezoelectric ceramics generate deformation along the central axis direction of the robot base body. Main components of the whole robot comprise the robot base body, the inertia driving piezoelectric ceramic and the resonance driving piezoelectric ceramic, the structure of the robot is simplified, assembling and repairing of the robot are facilitated, under driving of the applied alternating voltage, inertia stepping motion and resonance motion are achieved, and the motion precision of the robot is improved.
title: Planar multi-degree-of-freedom three-legged piezoelectric robot and driving method

abstract: A braking assembly for a strain wave gearing of a surgical robotic manipulator, the braking assembly including a first braking member fixedly coupled to an input portion of a strain wave gearing of a surgical robotic manipulator; and a second braking member fixedly coupled to an output portion of the strain wave gearing, and wherein during a braking operation the first braking member contacts the second braking member to mechanically brake the input portion to the output portion.
title: STRAIN WAVE GEARING WITH INPUT TO OUTPUT BRAKING

abstract: The invention provides a power distribution room intelligent inspection method and device, and belongs to the field of intelligent inspection, and the method comprises the steps: responding to a received first instruction, and controlling an inspection robot to inspect a target area in a first inspection mode; in response to the received second instruction, controlling the inspection robot to inspect the target area in a second inspection mode; wherein the first inspection mode is an intelligent inspection mode, the second inspection mode is a partition inspection mode, and the inspection precision of the first inspection mode is smaller than that of the second inspection mode. According to the invention, the fineness and reliability of the distribution room inspection method can be improved.
title: Intelligent routing inspection method and device for power distribution room

abstract: The invention provides a shoulder structure of a robot. The shoulder structure is composed of a chest frame, a shoulder skeleton and an upper arm skeleton. The shoulder skeleton is fixedly mounted on the chest frame, a motor is mounted on the shoulder skeleton, a transmission wheel at an output end of the motor is connected to a transmission wheel at an input end of a reducer through a synchronous belt, a transmission wheel at an output end of the reducer is connected to a transmission wheel at an input end of a rotating shaft through a transmission belt, the rotating shaft is hinged to the upper arm skeleton through a dowel II, a rotary supporting rack is fixedly connected to the other end of the rotating shaft, the rotary supporting rack is hinged to a motor connecting rack through a dowel III, a built-in nut motor is mounted on the motor connecting rack, and the built-in nut motor is hinged to the upper arm skeleton through a lead screw. The horizontal up-down swinging movement speed of the robot arm and the front-back up-down swinging movement speed of the robot arm, the sensitivity and the simulation degree of the robot arm are improved by means of the shoulder structure.
title: Shoulder structure of robot

abstract: A method of wood shingle classification and sawing using machine vision comprises the steps of taking an image of a wood slab in a wood block and identifying a defect in that slab; comparing an image of this defect to images of confirmed defects in a database of confirmed defects to find a match of the defect in these images. If a match is not found, sawing a shingle from the slab and classifying the shingle while making abstraction of the defect. In a second aspect, when images of two consecutive shingles are identical, a third and subsequent shingles can be sawn from a block without taking images thereof. In another aspect, the comparing of images is done by an artificial intelligence system that is trained on a database of images that are associable to the subjectivity of experienced shingle sawyers.
title: Classification and sawing of wood shingles using machine vision

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of disinfection equipment, and provides a disinfection robot which comprises a top plate, a chassis and a swing mechanism, the top plate is located above the chassis, the swing mechanism is located between the top plate and the bottom plate, and the swing mechanism comprises a swing arm, a hinge shaft, a swing gear, two swing units and a driving unit. The swing arm is hinged to the chassis through a hinge shaft, the outer wall of the hinge shaft is sleeved with the swing gear, the two swing units are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the swing gear, each swing unit comprises a swing shaft, an incomplete gear and a linear driver, and the driving unit is used for driving the swing shafts of the two swing units to rotate reversely at the same time. By further improving the structure of the swing mechanism, the disinfection robot can adjust the swing amplitude of the swing arm according to the size of a disinfection place, so that the practicability of the disinfection robot is improved, and disinfection places with different sizes can be disinfected by using the disinfection robot.
title: Disinfection robot

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent recommendation precision marketing method and system based on a large model, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and retail, and the method comprises a data perception layer which is used for collecting user related information and comprises a face recognition terminal, an Internet of Things sensor, a CRM system and transaction POS data; the intelligent decision-making layer is used for performing fusion modeling and recommendation strategy generation on the sensing data and comprises a dynamic image engine, a demand prediction large model and a recommendation strategy generator; and the execution feedback layer is used for sending the recommendation result to the user in a multi-channel manner and recycling feedback data, and comprises a shop assistant PAD push module, an electronic price tag updating module and a self-service terminal guide module. The repurchase rate and customer unit price of a retail scene can be remarkably improved, and the technical problem that a traditional retail robot cannot adapt to complex requirements of customers is solved.
title: Intelligent recommendation precision marketing method and system based on large model

abstract: The invention discloses a robot motion trajectory generation method and device. A proper cut motion trajectory is cut from an existing history motion trajectory; a target motion trajectory can be generated based on the cut motion trajectory; and at this time, users can control a robot to move according to a new motion trajectory through operation of the target motion trajectory. Technicians have no need to write new frame codes and guide the robot to move according to the new motion trajectory in actual scenes to generate project files of the target motion trajectory; and only through reuse ofthe cut motion trajectory in the project files of the existing history motion trajectory, the project files of the target motion trajectory can be simply and flexibly generated.
title: Robot motion trajectory generation method and device

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a defensive path planning method and device and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: determining a rasterized map, a starting node and a plurality of candidate target nodes according to a given path planning task; constructing and training a path planning model based on reinforcement learning based on the rasterized map to obtain a trained shortest path model; using the trained shortest path model to initialize an intelligent agent to obtain an initialized intelligent agent; training the initialized agent based on the obtained observer prediction result to obtain a defensive path planning agent; and performing path planning based on the intelligent agent to obtain a target path. According to the method, a defensive path planning agent capable of self-adapting to a learning observer can be obtained, and the agent not only considers the shortest path, but also considers the defensiveness of the path when planning the path, so as to avoid the prediction of external observers. The method can be expanded and applied to other planning tasks involving privacy protection and confrontation strategies.
title: Defensive path planning method and device and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention provides top assembly equipment and method for solving the technical problem of simulation training of students on industrial robot application technologies. The top assembly equipment and method comprise two practical training tables, a finished product warehouse, a four-axis robot unit, a conveying unit, a six-axis robot unit, a visual detecting module, a transition frame, a raw material tray, a movable robot unit and a raw material tray shelf. The scientific and reasonable top assembly method is innovatively designed; multiple industrial robot related technologies are applied;and through comprehensive practical training, the students master related knowledge more quickly.
title: Top assembly equipment and method

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-leg switching robot which comprises a base, wheel-leg devices, a first driving device and a second driving device, the wheel-leg device comprises a supporting body, a wheel disc unit, a connecting rod assembly and a reset body, the two ends of the connecting rod assembly are rotationally connected with the wheel disc unit and the supporting body correspondingly, and the reset body abuts against the connecting rod assembly and the wheel disc unit; each wheel-leg device is connected with the first driving device, a driving wheel is used for driving the supporting body to rotate, the second driving device comprises a driving unit and a plurality of driving ropes, and the driving unit is used for winding and unwinding the driving ropes so that the connecting rod assembly can be unfolded or folded under the abutting action of the reset body. According to the wheel-leg switching robot, the first driving device is used for driving the wheel-leg devices to walk, the second driving device drives the wheel-leg devices to conduct wheel-leg switching through winding and unwinding the ropes, all the driving ropes can be wound and unwound through the second driving device, the number of the driving units is small, control is convenient, and the structure of the wheel-leg switching robot is greatly simplified.
title: Wheel-leg switching robot

abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic module self-cleaning device and method, and the device comprises a manipulator which is used for automatically cleaning different positions of a photovoltaic module; a cleaning tool is arranged at one end of the manipulator, various cleaning tools are matched with one another to quickly and effectively clean various smudginess, and the applicability of the self-cleaning device is improved; an automatic optical detection module is arranged in the intelligent control system, can be matched with the recognition device to automatically recognize the smudginess type, and controls the manipulator and the cleaning tool to automatically clean smudginess on the frame and the surface of the photovoltaic module; according to the photovoltaic module cleaning method, after one side of the photovoltaic module is cleaned, automatic overturning can be achieved, the other side of the photovoltaic module is cleaned, the detection and cleaning process of the whole photovoltaic module is automatically completed, the labor cost is saved, meanwhile, the working efficiency is improved, the intelligent control system and the recognition device are matched to recognize and count the smudginess type of the photovoltaic module, and the cleaning efficiency is improved. And the production yield of the photovoltaic module is further improved.
title: Photovoltaic module self-cleaning device and cleaning method

abstract: The invention provides a human-machine interaction method and an intelligent robot which belongs to the intelligent robot technology field and solves the problem that in prior art, the interaction service provided by a robot is not people-oriented enough. The method comprises the following steps: recognition step in which the facial part of a target is recognized so as to identify which group the target belongs to and interaction step in which a corresponding interaction mode is adopted for the interaction between the robot and the target based on the group the target belongs to. The invention can be used in scenarios where an intelligent robot is used to provide an interaction service.
title: Human-machine interaction method and intelligent robot

abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method of an intelligent cold stamping production line integrated with an MES system, and the method comprises the steps: S1, installing at least one fisheye lens for detecting a stamping workpiece, collecting data, preprocessing the data, and building a three-dimensional scene, S2, carrying out the further processing of the preprocessed data in S1 through a flexible sensor network, the method comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out cross-modal fusion and feature extraction on data, S3, transmitting the data extracted in S2 to a digital twinborn body for dynamic updating and prediction, S4, carrying out deformation with the assistance of quantum entanglement and carrying out over-distance early warning, and S5, carrying out data storage and knowledge management. According to the data processing method of the intelligent cold stamping production line integrated with the MES system, a digital twinborn dynamic updating and predicting technology is utilized, quantum-classical hybrid simulation modeling and reinforcement learning algorithms are combined, precise prediction and optimization adjustment can be conducted on mold abrasion, process parameters and the like, the production efficiency and the product quality are improved, and the production cost is reduced. The production cost and the energy consumption are reduced.
title: Data processing method of intelligent cold stamping production line integrated with MES system

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot type wall-climbing robot, and the robot comprises a machine shell, a visual identification camera, four wheel-foot adsorption assemblies, a vacuum pump and a buffer vacuum cavity, wherein the visual identification camera and the four wheel-foot adsorption assemblies are connected to the machine shell, and the vacuum pump and the buffer vacuum cavity are arranged in the machine shell and communicated. According to the invention, the visual identification camera is adopted to collect wall surface images, so that obstacle-avoiding walking on the wall surface is realized; according to the four wheel foot adsorption assemblies, stepping motors are adopted to drive hollow wheel hubs to rotate through first-stage speed reducers, the hollow wheel hubs drive wheel feet to rotate to achieve the wall climbing function, the single wheel feet, facing the wall face, on the hollow wheel hubs are continuously communicated with negative pressure cavities of hollow wheel shafts one by one to achieve negative pressure adsorption of suction cups, and the stability of wall climbing walking is guaranteed.
title: Wheel foot type wall-climbing robot

abstract: A method for controlling a robotic device based on observed object locations is presented. The method includes observing objects in an environment. The method also includes generating a probability distribution for locations of the observed objects. The method further includes controlling the robotic device to perform an action when an object is at a location in the environment with a location probability that is less than a threshold.
title: Fall detection and assistance

abstract: The invention discloses an AUV submarine petroleum pipeline inspection risk identification system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of ocean engineering, and the system comprises an inspection risk management center, and the inspection risk management center is in communication connection with the following modules: an AUV autonomous inspection module, which is used for deploying an AUV to carry out an inspection task of a submarine petroleum pipeline, and the control instruction of the AUV is dynamically adjusted according to the seabed environment and the pipeline state, and the inspection path and speed are optimized. The abnormal pipeline identification model is constructed by combining the deep learning algorithm, the pipeline image data can be efficiently classified, the submarine petroleum pipeline area in the abnormal state can be identified, the identified abnormal state area is further analyzed, the pipeline risk trend index is calculated, and the potential risk level of the pipeline is evaluated. Potential safety hazards can be found and treated in time, accidents are prevented, and safe operation of the submarine petroleum pipeline is guaranteed.
title: AUV submarine petroleum pipeline inspection risk identification system based on deep learning

abstract: The invention discloses a path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning-fast exploration random tree. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring a starting point and an ending point; s2, calculating candidate path points, and selecting an action in the action state according to the Q value; s3, calculating a reward value and a new action state after the action is executed; s4, the action state, the action, the reward value and the new action state are stored in an experience pool, an experience value of the batch size is randomly selected in response to the fact that the storage number in the experience pool is larger than the batch size, and the Q value and the time sequence difference error are updated through a strategy network; s5, strategy network parameters are updated through mean square error loss, and the target network updating step length is calculated according to the time sequence difference error; s6, judging whether the searched path reaches the end point or meets the set maximum path point search number, and if so, outputting the current path; and if not, returning to S2. According to the method, the algorithm searching efficiency is improved, and the algorithm searching time is not increased.
title: Path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning-fast exploration random tree

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent face recognition access control gate management system which comprises a login system, a face recognition system, an information management system and an equipment management system, wherein a login module is integrated on the login system; a face recognition module is integrated on the face recognition system; a personnel management module, a department management module, a record management module and a message management module are integrated on the information management system; the personnel management module is used for querying, adding, editing anddeleting personnel; the department management module is used for querying, adding, editing and deleting departments; the record management module is used for querying entry and exit records of registered personnel; the message management module is used for recording special information; the equipment management system comprises a camera management module and a gate management module; the camera management module is used for adding, editing, modifying and starting/deactivating a camera; and the gate management module is used for adding/deleting a gate. The intelligent face recognition access control gate management system has the advantages that users are comprehensively managed through face recognition, thereby further improving the security.
title: Intelligent face recognition access control gate management system

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent recruitment process optimization and talent mining method, which comprises the steps of generating a data set according to acquired human resource data, and further performing data preprocessing on the data set; continuously training the data set by adopting a deep learning method to obtain a corrected interview analysis model, deploying the interview analysis model, and continuously collecting real-time recruitment interview data; inputting the real-time recruitment interview data into an interview analysis model to generate an interview analysis result; and according to an interview analysis result, the emotions of the job seekers are classified, matched emotion scores are given, and then recruitment evaluation information is generated according to combination of the emotion scores and interview evaluation indexes. According to the intelligent recruitment process optimization and talent mining method, the interview evaluation of the job seeker can be objectively given, and the talent mining process is optimized.
title: Intelligent recruitment process optimization and talent mining method and system

abstract: The invention provides an intelligent home control system based on internet of things. The system can recognize identity information of different users in a single image by setting a dual face image recognizing mode, so that a high recognition rate under the lower similarity situation is achieved; thus, security and efficiency of human face recognition are improved, the problem of low recognitionefficiency caused by single face recognition is avoided, and effects to the recognition environment are reduced. In addition, the intelligent home control system disclosed by the invention is providedwith a plurality of second users matched with personnel recognition and verification, flexibility in a recognition process is improved, and user access control safety is further ensured.
title: Intelligent home control system based on internet of things

abstract: [Problem] To provide an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a program whereby a response can be given to a device that is preferred by a user among a plurality of devices. [Solution] An information processing apparatus comprising: an input unit for obtaining information relating to a user's voice and device information for each of a plurality of devices; and a selection unit for selecting a device from the plurality of devices on the basis of the voice-related information, a mode specified from at least one of the sets of device information, and the device information, which are obtained by the input unit.
title: INFORMATION PROCESSING APPARATUS, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND PROGRAM

abstract: A face recognition system is provided, which is incorporated as part of traditionally worn items, so as to allow for face recognition assistance without being obvious to the person whose face is being recognized. The face recognition system includes a viewfinder, which has an image capture module and a display module, and includes a user actuatable selector. The face recognition system further includes a data storage element, which includes a data structure, having one or more images of faces of people, and associated identification information. The face recognition system still further includes a controller, where the controller is communicatively coupled to the viewfinder, the user actuatable selector, and the data storage element. The controller includes a pattern matching module, wherein when the user actuatable selector is activated the pattern matching module of the controller is adapted for comparing an image being currently captured by the image capture module with the one or more images of faces in the data structure, and wherein when the pattern matching module detects a match, the controller is adapted to retrieve the identification information associated with the matched image, and convey the identification information to the user.
title: A FACE RECOGNITION SYSTEM AND CORRESPONDING METHOD

abstract: The invention discloses an adjustable assistance type mechanical connecting piece which comprises a limiting joint type hinge connecting mechanism, a liquid pressure equalizing type assistance adjusting mechanism, a hinge locking assembly, a thigh fixing assembly and a shank fixing assembly. The invention belongs to the technical field of hinged connecting pieces, and particularly relates to an adjustable assisting type mechanical connecting piece. On the basis of the hydraulic transmission principle, the liquid pressure-equalizing type power-assisted adjusting mechanism is creatively provided, through mutual locking between the hinge locking assembly and the limiting joint type hinge connecting mechanism, the liquid pressure-equalizing type power-assisted adjusting mechanism can be driven, and when a piston pressing block is extruded, the piston pressing block can be driven to rotate; the pre-pressing amount and the assisting power level of the assisting spring body can be increased through transmission of liquid, and the technical effect of rapidly and conveniently adjusting assisting power is achieved.
title: Adjustable assistance type mechanical connecting piece

abstract: PURPOSE: A falling detecting method using image processing and an image processing device thereof are provided to process an image transmitted through a web camera, thereby determining whether a patient falls. CONSTITUTION: An image processing device sets a security area in a background image(S2). The image processing device distinguishes a patient from a background(S3). The image processing device simplifies an irregular boundary between the patient and the background(S4). The image processing device determines whether the patient gets hurt from a fall by distinguishing a location and motion of the patient(S5). [Reference numerals] (S1) Background image is set; (S2) An image processing device sets a security area in a background image; (S3) The image processing device distinguishes a patient from a background; (S4) The image processing device simplifies an irregular boundary between the patient and the background; (S4-1) Warning detection; (S4-2) Making square; (S4-3) Trimming; (S4-4) Making curve; (S5) Fall verification; (S5-1) Component calculation; (S5-2) Location identification; (S5-3) Fall decision; (S6) Color comparing; (S7) Background image control
title: falldown detecting method using the image processing image processing apparatus for the same

abstract: The invention provides a sliding mode iteration control method and device for a mechanical arm and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a mechanical arm dynamic model according to mechanical arm parameters, and adding the model uncertainty into the mechanical arm dynamic model; the model uncertainty comprises known disturbance and unknown disturbance; constructing a sliding mode surface based on the convergence rate and the singular characteristic; an equivalent control law and a switching control law are constructed, the equivalent control law is suitable for counteracting known disturbance, and the switching control law is suitable for counteracting unknown disturbance; generating a closed-loop iterative controller based on the trajectory deviation; determining a system control equation according to the closed-loop iteration controller, the equivalent control law and the switching control law; and the mechanical arm is controlled according to the system control equation, and a preset task is executed. According to the invention, iterative learning is carried out on the tracking error signal of the expected trajectory, so that high-precision tracking of the expected trajectory is realized on the basis of sliding mode control.
title: Sliding mode iteration control method and device of mechanical arm and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention discloses a micro-expression feature extraction method based on a motion unit prototype template, and the method comprises the steps: employing an organ-based face position correction and cutting method for the face difference problem between different subjects and the head translation problem of the same subject in a video in preprocessing, and guaranteeing the accuracy of optical flow feature extraction; in order to accurately analyze a motion unit in a micro expression, a motion unit-oriented prototype template is provided. Each prototype template records representative dynamic information of a facial motion unit, and has relatively strong robustness on AU identification of facial actions with certain differences; in order to accurately capture micro-expression actions, an optical flow graph sequence of a micro-expression video is matched with an AU motion template, deep analysis of complex micro-expression actions in the video is obtained, and the accuracy and interpretability of micro-expression features are improved. The method has the advantages that fine facial actions can be effectively captured when the micro-expression occurs, and the method can be used for micro-expression detection, recognition and generation.
title: Micro-expression feature extraction method based on motion unit prototype template

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent voice interaction method and a related device. The intelligent voice interaction method comprises the following steps: calling a first process engine interface to obtain voice information input by a user through the first process engine interface; calling a first process engine interface to recognize the voice information through a first process engine to obtain recognition information of the voice information; calling a second process engine interface to obtain a corresponding response event of the identification information through the second process engine interface; and executing a corresponding response event of the identification information. According to the scheme, the maintainability and reusability of the script file can be improved.
title: Intelligent voice interaction method and related device

abstract: Provided are a voice control system, a voice processing method and a terminal device. The voice control system is carried on a terminal device, and the terminal device is also carried with a plurality of different voice service applications. The voice control system comprises: a configuration module and a plurality of voice engine modules. The configuration module is arranged to bind a voice service application to at least one voice engine module according to binding requests from different voice service applications; and the voice engine module is arranged to process input information input into the voice service application, and output a processing result to a corresponding voice service application, so that the voice service application conducts voice control by utilizing the processing result. The embodiments of the present invention provide uniform voice service support for a plurality of voice service applications carried on the same terminal device by means of providing a voice control system, so as to satisfy different diverse demands of various voice service applications, and achieve the purposes of reducing resource occupation and improving efficiency at the same time.
title: VOICE CONTROL SYSTEM, VOICE PROCESSING METHOD AND TERMINAL DEVICE

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium for acquiring a user portrait. The method comprises the following steps of: acquiring the facialfeature information of the current user in each application system; Acquiring a current user portrait of the current user in each application system according to the face feature information of the current user in each application system; A target us portrait of that current user is determine based on the current user portrait of the current user in each application system. The user portrait canbe obtained more comprehensively, and the user characteristics can be described more accurately.
title: Method, device, electronic device and storage medium for acquiring user portrait

abstract: The invention is suitable for the field of pattern recognition, and provides an automatic alarm method and system based on pattern recognition, and the system comprises a video home pet action mark extraction module, an action mark recognition and classification module, a home pet activity mode risk judgment module, and a risk auditing and alarm module. The object position information is continuously updated by comprehensively interpreting the relationship between the home, the pet and the environment, and the dynamic safety cognition is displayed by analyzing and calculating the distance between the home, the pet and the risk object in the environment in real time. And after the security interval threshold value is configured, the system can adopt active early warning, so that the security and instantaneity are further improved, and simple mobile tracking and image recognition are greatly surpassed.
title: Automatic alarm method and system based on pattern recognition

abstract: A system and a method for recognition hand indication in a three dimension are provided to recognize the position indicated by a user and a home appliance placed in the position without additional equipment. A 3D position recognition system includes an image acquisition part(110), a camera correlation information DB(141), a central processing unit(CPU)(120) and a display module(150). The image acquisition part(110) acquires an image from the two cameras. The camera correlation information DB(141) stores correlation information between two cameras. The central processing unit(CPU)(120) recognizes a 3-D position indicated by the hand of a user based on the correlation information and the acquired image. The display module(150) displays the recognition result.
title: 3D position recognition through hand pointing command

abstract: The present invention provides a method and apparatus for detecting a red eye in an image. The method comprises steps of: calculating a skin color reference vector for said image; identifying a candidate for red eye region in said image; identifying skin color pixels in said candidate for red eye region; removing skin color pixels from said candidate for red eye region; deciding whether said candidate for red eye region is a red eye or not. The present invention also provides a method and apparatus for detecting a human face in an image. Moreover, the present invention provides corresponding storage medium including instructions for causing a processor to implement the methods. According to the present invention, red eyes and/or human faces can be detected with consideration of skin color pixels. The speed and accuracy of detecting red eyes and human faces are greatly increased.
title: Detecting human faces and detecting red eyes

abstract: A computer-implemented method of learning a policy for an agent. The method includes: receiving an initialized first neural network, in particular a Q-functionor value-function, an initialized second neural network, auxiliary parameters, and the initialized policy; repeating the following steps until a termination condition is fulfilled: sampling a plurality of pairs of states, actions, rewards and new states from a storage. Sampling actions for the current states, and actions for the new sampled states; computing features from a penultimate layer of the first neural network based on the sampled states and actions and updating the second neural network and the auxiliary parameters as well as updating parameters the first neural network using a re-weighted loss.
title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR IMPROVED POLICY LEARNING FOR ROBOTS

abstract: A method for conducting an automated interview session between a candidate and an automated chat resource includes analyzing a candidate resume to identify a first personality trait; generating a first resume-based question based on the first personality trait; presenting, by the automated chat resource, the first resume-based question to the candidate during the automated interview session based on the identified first personality trait; generating a first trait score based on a first response received from the candidate, wherein the first trait score is indicative of a relevance of the identified first personality trait; generating a first question-answer score based on the first resume-based question and the first response, wherein the first question-answer score is indicative of a first question-answer relevance and is used to determine whether to present a second resume-based question to the candidate; analyzing a communication transcript to identify a second personality trait; generating a first transcript-based question based on the second personality trait; presenting, by the automated chat resource, the first transcript-based question to the candidate during the automated interview session based on the identified second personality trait; analyzing a second response from the candidate to determine whether the candidate possesses the identified second personality trait; generating a second trait score based on the second response in response to determining whether the candidate possesses the identified second personality trait, wherein the second trait score is indicative of a relevance of the identified second personality trait; and generating a second question-answer score based on the first transcript-based question and the second response, wherein the second question-answer score is indicative of a second question-answer relevance and is used to determine whether to present a second transcript-based question to the candidate.
title: System and method for conducting an automated interview session

abstract: The invention discloses a face detection method based on Hough forest integration learning. The method based on the Hough decision forest can be used for self-adaptively learning the local image blockcharacteristics of the target image and randomly selecting the characteristics during each split, the leaf node set of each tree in the Hough forest can be regarded as a discriminant codebook, each leaf node can carry out a probability hypothesis on the local image blocks belonging to the human face or the background, the probability voting is carried out on the center position of the image block; the supervised training and fast matching is carried out, and the local image block features and the mapping relation of the local image block features in the Hough voting space are acquired. The method provided by the invention has good robustness on the images with geometric distortion, noise and partial shielding, the effectiveness of the method is proved by an experimental result on the CMU+MIT database; and the problem that the position of a face image is detected by Hough forest under an integrated learning framework is solved.
title: Face detection method based on Hough forest integration learning

abstract: When handling objects made of flexible materials by means of holding members, a frequently encountered problem is that the objects have to be transported between supports having differently shaped surfaces, for example they have to be picked up from an even surface and set down on a convexly or concavely curved surface. This is carried out by using grippers which are movable on a deformable holding device by means of a supporting element, it being possible for the holding device to be displaced alternately from a relaxed state with low deformation resistance into a braced state in which it is dimensionally stable as a result of a blocking of its components. According to the invention, it is proposed to construct the holding device (2) from movably interconnected bar elements (3) which can be locked relative to one another via clamping elements (4) acting on them and are arranged at least linearly. <IMAGE>
title: Manipulating device, particularly for handling objects made of a flexible matter.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, in particular to a fan control method and system based on an image recognition technology. The method comprises the following steps that fan area image collection is carried out through a camera module, so that fan area image data are obtained, user detection is carried out on the fan area image data, user detection data are obtained, and the user detection data comprise single-person detection data and multi-person detection data; when it is determined that the user detection data is single-person detection data, user posture feature extraction and user environment feature extraction are conducted on the fan area image data, and user posture feature data and user environment feature data are obtained; and performing user posture recognition on the user posture feature data to obtain first primary fan control parameter data, and performing user environment comfort recognition on the user environment feature data to obtain user environment comfort data. The wind speed and the running state are adjusted according to actual requirements, energy consumption is reduced, and the energy-saving and environment-friendly effects are achieved.
title: Fan control method and system based on image recognition technology

abstract: Systems and methods for a wearable exoskeleton include an inflatable actuator with a reduced operation volume for faster operation. The inflatable actuator may include a first paddle connectable to the human body, a second paddle connectable to the human body, and an inflatable fabric coupled between the first paddle and the second paddle. In response to the inflatable fabric being filled with compressed air, the rigidity of the inflatable fabric increases, causing the angle between the first paddle and the second paddle to change to provide an assistive force for a movement of the human body. A portable pneumatic source is provided for quickly supplying a compressed air to the inflatable actuator. The portable pneumatic source may include a double acting piston and a cylinder defining a first chamber and a second chamber, and a valve assembly, for compressing air at both the upstroke and downstroke of the piston.
title: Low-volume inflatable actuator composites for wearable applications and portable pneumatic source

abstract: The invention discloses a fault detection method and system based on a large model, and belongs to the technical field of fault detection, and the method specifically comprises the steps: collecting multi-source fault data from an industrial system, carrying out the preprocessing, and extracting fault features to form a data set; loading a pre-trained large language model, and performing fine tuning according to the fault feature data set; constructing a fault detection model by using the fine-tuned model and the fault feature data set, and performing training and evaluation in combination with an adaptive optimization strategy to obtain a trained model; fault data collected in real time are input into the model, a preliminary fault detection result is output, fault types, positions and probability information are further obtained through a multi-level fault analysis method, meanwhile, the result is fed back to optimize the model, and the accuracy and efficiency of fault detection are improved.
title: Fault detection method and system based on large model

abstract: The present invention is intended to solve the above problems and/or limitations, and to provide a soft gripper capable of holding various objects by controlling the pressure of gas while having a simple structure. The present invention includes: a body portion extending in a first direction; a handle portion arranged adjacent to the body portion and moving along the first direction; a soft valve connecting the body portion and the handle portion; and a grip portion which is connected to the body portion and whose actuation is controlled through the soft valve, wherein the soft valve includes an outer tube having elasticity; an inner tube having elasticity and arranged inside the outer tube and having a first channel formed through which gas can flow; and at least one spiral thread that spirally wraps around the outside of the inner tube along the length of the inner tube. The soft gripper according to embodiments of the present invention can be operated without being connected to an external power source or control device, and is therefore not subject to restrictions in the usable space. In addition, it can operate stably in extreme environments that require greater stability, such as environments with flying sparks or a lot of dust, in vivo environments, high radiation environments, and underwater environments.
title: soft gripper

abstract: A facial recognition method for video conferencing requiring a reduced bandwidth and transmitting video and audio frames synchronously first determines whether a 3D body model of a first user at a local end has been currently retrieved or is otherwise retrievable from a historical database. Multiple audio frames of first user are collected and audio frequency at a specific range are filtered out. An envelope curve of the first audio frames and multiple attacking time periods and multiple releasing time periods of the envelope curve is calculated and correlated with lip movements of first user. Information packets of same and head-rotating and limb-swinging images of the first user are transmitted to a remote second user so that the 3D body model can simulate and show lip shapes and other movement of the first user.
title: Facial recognition method for video conference and server using the method

abstract: The invention provides a face recognition method and a face recognition system, belonging to the technical field of face recognition. The method is applied to an electronic device, and the electronicequipment stores the original pictures of a plurality of persons and the pictures collected on the spot. The method comprises: when a human face is detected within the recognition distance, getting face images, performing facial feature extraction, the extracted facial features being compared with multiple original images and scene images respectively, when the comparison between the two methods fails, the face features being extracted again and compared with the original pictures in the electronic equipment, and then the face being recognized again, and the face pictures being stored in the electronic equipment as a new scene collection picture through the recognition. The face recognition method and the face recognition system effectively improve the accuracy of face recognition.
title: A face recognition method and a face recognition system

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of auxiliary exoskeletons, in particular to an upper limb picking auxiliary exoskeleton. The upper limb picking auxiliary exoskeleton comprises a back supporting mechanism, two shoulder supporting mechanisms, two upper arm supporting mechanisms and two upper arm adjusting mechanisms. The shoulder supporting mechanisms comprise shoulder supporting plates. The upper arm supporting mechanisms comprise upper arm supporting plates. The upper arm adjusting mechanisms comprise racks and connecting rods; the racks comprise lower sawtooth parts and upper smooth parts; sliding blocks are arranged on the racks and connected with connecting blocks; and the connecting blocks are provided with tooth-shaped ends, and the connecting blocks are movably connectedwith the connecting rods. The upper limb picking auxiliary exoskeleton is simple in structure, small in size, convenient to operate and capable of helping fruit farmers to conveniently and easily pick fruit in the high positions, and the picking bearing ability and picking efficiency are improved so that people can complete picking work in a more labor-saving mode, the labor time is saved for thefruit farmers, physical power is saved, and more economic benefits are provided.
title: Upper limb picking auxiliary exoskeleton

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a gender and age identification method and device, a storage medium and a server, and belongs to the technical field of video analysis. The method comprises steps that according to N kinds of cutting rules, face images of a to-be-identified pedestrian are respectively cut to acquire N local face images, whereinN is a positive integer greater than 1; for each local face image, the local face image is input into a recognition model corresponding to the cutting rule of the local face image in an optimal model combination, the optimal model combination comprises N recognition models with different model structures, and each recognition model corresponds to one cutting rule after being trained; and gender information and age information of the pedestrian are determined according to an output result of the optimal model combination. According to the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of gender identification and age identification can be improved, and the storage space and program running time are reduced.
title: Gender and age identification method and device, storage medium and server

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information interaction method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a face image of a user when detecting that the user enters a set environment; according to the face image, obtaining the identity characteristic information of the user, wherein, the identity characteristic information comprises age attribute information and/or user identity information; determining auxiliary reference information according to the identity characteristic information and/or the current system time; according to the identity characteristic information and the auxiliary reference information, the interaction information matched with the user is determined, and the interaction information is presentedin at least one media form in the setting environment. The technical proposal provided by the embodiment of the invention realizes the intelligent interaction of the information of the user in the setting environment, does not require the user to carry out additional input operation, improves the initiative of the information interaction, makes the interactive information more intelligent, and improves the user's use experience.
title: Information interaction method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a power distribution network control model training method and device, an optimization method and device, equipment and a medium. Interacting with a preset power distribution network simulation environment by using an original strategy network in the power distribution network control model to generate sample data; based on the sample data, updating the original strategy network by using a value network in the power distribution network control model to obtain an initial strategy network; determining the power grid loss at the current updating moment based on the output value of the initial strategy network; based on the power grid loss at the current updating moment and the original power grid loss, updating the initial strategy network by using a preset objective function and a preset constraint condition to obtain a target strategy network; and determining a target power distribution network control model according to the target strategy network. The practicability, generalization and robustness of the model are effectively enhanced, and the calculation complexity is reduced.
title: Power distribution network control model training method, optimization method, device, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention relates to a robust predefined time path following formation control method for unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target path curve of a moving object, and determining a target course angle rate of the moving object based on the target path curve, a preset course angle function, a first lumped interference parameter and a preset time performance function; based on the total error of the projection arc length, the expected forward movement speed and the second lumped interference parameter, the target forward movement speed of the moving object is determined, and the total error of the projection arc length comprises a first projection arc length error between the moving object and an adjacent target and a second projection arc length error between the moving object and a preset virtual leader target; and adjusting the moving object based on a preset kinematic model, the target course angular rate and the target forward moving speed, so that the moving object moves based on the target path curve. By adopting the method, the control precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the driving process can be improved.
title: Robust predefined time path following formation control method of unmanned aerial vehicle

abstract: The invention discloses a face image reconstruction method, system and device based on adaptive texture and frequency domain perception, and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the self-attention calculation of rough features through an adaptive texture perception module, searching a part with strong correlation in fine features through an attention matrix, and carrying out the fine self-attention calculation. And a multi-dimensional sensing module is adopted to enhance the cross-space and cross-channel expression ability of the features. And meanwhile, a multi-frequency fusion module based on wavelet transform is used for fusing the low and medium frequency characteristics from the encoder and the high frequency characteristics from the decoder. The self-adaptive texture sensing module enables the model to recover a complex area in an image more finely, the multi-dimensional sensing module enhances important channel information in features, and the multi-frequency fusion module eliminates high-frequency noise in original features and fuses effective features of low and medium frequencies and recovered high-frequency details, so that the image quality is improved. Therefore, the recovery capability and generalization capability of the model to the face image are improved.
title: Face image reconstruction method, system and device based on adaptive texture and frequency domain perception, and medium

abstract: The present application discloses a face recognition method and an electronic device. The method comprises: in response to receiving a face recognition starting operation, generating M image frames on the basis of a first exposure parameter; performing face recognition on the basis of the first image frame among the M image frames; when the face recognition fails, generating N image frames on the basis of a second exposure parameter, wherein N is a positive integer greater than zero; performing frame drop processing on some of the M image frames to obtain M1 image frames, wherein M1 is a positive integer less than M; and performing face recognition on the basis of the M1 image frames, and then performing face recognition on the basis of a target image frame among the N image frames. In this way, by performing frame drop processing on some of the M image frames, the processing time of face recognition performed on the basis of the image frames collected on the basis of the first exposure parameter is shortened, so that a face recognition TA can perform, as soon as possible, face recognition processing on image frames having better image quality, so as to increase the unlocking speed.
title: FACE RECOGNITION METHOD AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE

abstract: A first video of a first individual performing an exercise movement is received, wherein the first video is associated with a first guidance label. A modified version of a video is generated at least in part by passing the first video to a pose data change model. The modified version of the video is associated with a second guidance label. A guidance classifier model is trained using the modified version of the video.
title: Synthesis of exercise guidance training data

abstract: Provided are an automatic travel method, a work vehicle, and an automatic travel system with which it is possible to improve the accuracy of automatic travel by suppressing separation from a turning path. A combine (1) is a work vehicle that automatically travels on the basis of a preset travel path (53), and is provided with a control device (30) and a storage amount detection unit (26). The control device (30) functions as an automatic travel control unit (35) for controlling automatic travel on the basis of a travel path (53) including a turning path (55). A storage amount detection unit (26) detects the storage amount of grains (harvest) stored in a storage unit (6) of a combine harvester (1). The automatic travel control unit (35) changes a turning parameter relating to travel on the turning path (55) on the basis of the stored amount.
title: Automatic travel method, work vehicle, and automatic travel system

abstract: A method comprising: receiving an interactive voice response (IVR) tree configured to implement one or more tasks, each associated with one or more IVR node paths comprising a plurality of IVR nodes arranged in a hierarchical relationship; analyzing the IVR tree to identify one or more intent IVR nodes, each associated with one of the tasks; with respect to each of the intent IVR nodes, identifying a plurality of corresponding entity IVR nodes included within the IVR node path associated with the intent IVR node; assembling one or more task-specific chatbot skills, each comprising (i) one of the intent IVR nodes, and (ii) at least some of the plurality of corresponding entity IVR nodes, wherein each of the task-specific chatbot skills is configured to perform one of the tasks by conducting a dialog with a user; and generating a chatbot comprising at least one of the task-specific chatbot skills.
title: Automated chatbot generation from an interactive voice response tree

abstract: The invention discloses a teaching bench of a space multi-degree-of-freedom parallel driving force loading system. A support column is fixed in the center of a base; the top of the support column is connected with a turning plate, a six-dimensional force sensor and a movable platform in sequence; the two ends of a hydraulic cylinder A are connected with the base and one end of the turning plate through plane hinges; the two ends of six hydraulic cylinders B are connected with the base and the movable platform through hooke joints; servo valves are mounted at the middle parts of the hydraulic cylinders A and B; the bottoms of the hydraulic cylinders A and B are connected with the bottoms of displacement sensors; piston rods of the hydraulic cylinders A and B are connected with the tops of the displacement sensors; the tops of the hydraulic cylinders A and B are connected with one ends of tension and pressure sensors; the other ends of the tension and pressure sensors connected with thehydraulic cylinder A are connected with the plane hinges; the other ends of the tension and pressure sensors connected with the hydraulic cylinders B are connected with the hooke joints; and a signalacquisition control system acquires data of a parallel mechanism electro-hydraulic servo driving force loading system. The teaching bench can provide fundamental basis for development of high-precision and high-frequency-response space multi-degree-of-freedom parallel driving force loading system.
title: Teaching bench of space multi-degree-of-freedom parallel driving force loading system

abstract: One or more input/output devices accept user-inputted path instructions that specify a set of multiple deposition paths for an extruder to travel. An actuator actuates motion of the extruder along a trajectory that includes each of the deposition paths and also includes multiple non-deposition paths. For each deposition path: (a) the user-inputted path instructions specify a thickness of an object; and (b) the extruder extrudes the object in accordance with fabrication instructions computed by a computer based at least in part on the thickness. As the extruder moves over the entire trajectory, the extruder extrudes a set of objects, one object per deposition path. The objects adhere to each other to form an integral 3D structure. In some cases, the objects include functionally graded material.
title: Methods and apparatus for additive manufacturing along user-specified toolpaths

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a system and a device for automatically marking course patrol video data and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring classroom voice features in the course patrol video data and a corresponding video data frame sequence; identifying teaching features in the video data frame sequence through a first preset algorithm; determining an interest frame sequence in the course patrol video data based on the classroom voice features, the video data time periods and teaching features in the video data frame sequence; and based on the interest frame sequence, generating a quality analysis result of the course patrol video data, and labeling the course patrol video data.
title: Method, system and device for automatically marking course patrol video data and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal emotion emergency decision-making system based on a multi-level long short-term memory (LSTM) network, and belongs to the field of natural language processing multi-modal emotion analysis. The invention provides a multi-modal emotion emergency decision-making system based on a multi-level LSTM network, which is used for monitoring group emotions in indoor public places, and performing risk assessment on emergencies in scenes by integrating group emotional atmosphere fields in the public places and individual extreme emotions. The implementation method comprises the following steps: performing emotion recognition on audio and image information; establishing a multi-level LSTM network, and performing decision-level fusion for time relevance of multi-modal information; the output results of the LSTMs of all levels are fused in the time dimension; carrying out outlier processing on the fusion result; the risk level probability of public place emergencies is calculated by enhancing individual extreme emotion monitoring, constructing an emotional atmosphere field, performing overall assessment on collective emotions in a public place environment and integrating a prediction result of the emotional atmosphere field and an individual extreme emotion state.
title: Multi-modal emotion emergency decision-making system based on multi-stage long short-term memory network

abstract: The invention discloses a marking method for facial skin lesion images, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a plurality of facial images containing various artificially marked skin lesions as a first training set, and inputting the first training set into a first yolo5 neural network to complete the training; constructing and training a parallel encoder for multi-task learning, inputting skin lesion features, and outputting a plurality of small target features; storing training parameters of the first yo5 neural network and a parallel encoder; migrating the training parameters of the first yolo5 neural network to a second yolo5 neural network, and splicing a parallel encoder in front of an output layer of the second yolo5 neural network; and inputting the unmarked facial skin lesion image into the second yolo5 neural network, outputting a plurality of small target features by the parallel encoder, and outputting a marking result of the facial skin lesion image by the second yolo5 neural network. According to the method, the accuracy of automatic identification and classification of the facial skin lesion is improved, an automatic image marking process is realized, the requirement of manual marking is remarkably reduced, and the adaptability of the model to illumination change is effectively improved.
title: Marking method for facial skin lesion image
